sources.title: Almohad Caliphate
supports: The Almohad movement under Ibn Tumart and Abd al-Mu'min
Conquest of Marrakesh in 1147 and unification of al-Andalus by 1172
The defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212
The end of the caliphate in 1269

sources.title: 穆瓦希德王朝
supports: 伊本·图马特与阿卜杜勒·慕敏领导的穆瓦希德运动
1147年攻占马拉喀什、1172年统一安达卢斯
1212年托洛萨会战失败
1269年王朝灭亡

politics.zh: 穆瓦希德运动由伊本·图马特在12世纪初发起，主张严格的认主独一，反对穆拉比特的宗教实践，以阿特拉斯山的Tinmel为基地。阿卜杜勒·慕敏继任后建立哈里发政权，1147年攻占马拉喀什，灭穆拉比特；1172年统一安达卢斯。1212年托洛萨会战失败后由盛转衰，1269年被马林王朝灭亡。
politics.en: The Almohad movement was launched by Ibn Tumart in the early twelfth century, preaching a strict doctrine of divine unity against Almoravid practice from a base at Tinmel in the Atlas. His successor Abd al-Mu'min built a caliphate, took Marrakesh in 1147 and ended Almoravid rule, unifying al-Andalus by 1172. The defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 began the decline, and the Marinids ended the caliphate in 1269.

economy.zh: 王朝控制跨撒哈拉黄金与盐的商路，并在马格里布和安达卢斯经营灌溉农业、橄榄与谷物种植。马拉喀什、塞维利亚和突尼斯是行政与商业中心，铸币与税收体系支撑军队和建设。地中海航运与内陆商队贸易同时存在。
economy.en: The caliphate controlled trans-Saharan gold and salt routes and oversaw irrigated agriculture, olives and grain in the Maghreb and al-Andalus. Marrakesh, Seville and Tunis were administrative and commercial centres, and coinage and taxation supported the army and building programmes. Mediterranean shipping and inland caravan trade operated side by side.

culture.zh: 宫廷赞助哲学、医学与法学，伊本·鲁世德（阿威罗伊）和伊本·图费勒在此时期写作。库图比亚清真寺、塞维利亚吉拉尔达与拉巴特哈桑塔代表其建筑风格。宗教统一政策改变了犹太教徒与基督徒的处境，部分群体被迫迁徙或改宗。
culture.en: The court patronised philosophy, medicine and law, and Ibn Rushd (Averroes) and Ibn Tufayl wrote in this period. The Koutoubia in Marrakesh, the Giralda in Seville and the Hassan Tower in Rabat represent its architecture. The policy of religious unity changed the position of Jews and Christians, some of whom emigrated or converted.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约1121年伊本·图马特被拥立为马赫迪、1147年攻占马拉喀什、1172年统一安达卢斯、1212年托洛萨会战失败，以及1269年马林王朝攻占马拉喀什、哈里发国终结。
events.en: Key moments include Ibn Tumart's recognition as Mahdi around 1121, the capture of Marrakesh in 1147, the unification of al-Andalus in 1172, the defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, and the Marinid capture of Marrakesh in 1269 that ended the caliphate.

value.zh: 1147年阿卜杜勒·慕敏攻占马拉喀什，灭穆拉比特王朝，定都于此。
value.en: Abd al-Mu'min took Marrakesh in 1147, ended the Almoravids and made it his capital.

value.zh: 1212年穆瓦希德军队在托洛萨会战中被卡斯蒂利亚等国联军击败，王朝此后衰落。
value.en: In 1212 the Almohad army was defeated at Las Navas de Tolosa by a Christian coalition, after which the caliphate declined.

value.zh: 1269年马林王朝攻占马拉喀什，穆瓦希德哈里发国灭亡。
value.en: The Marinids took Marrakesh in 1269, ending the Almohad caliphate.

sources.title: Hafsid dynasty
supports: Hafsid rule over Ifriqiya from 1229 to 1574 with Tunis as capital
Abu Zakariya's declaration of independence from the Almohads
The Eighth Crusade against Tunis in 1270
Sixteenth-century rivalry between Spain and the Ottomans and the dynasty's end

sources.title: 哈夫斯王朝
supports: 哈夫斯王朝1229至1574年统治易弗里基叶，都于突尼斯
阿布·扎卡里亚脱离穆瓦希德独立
1270年第八次十字军进攻突尼斯
16世纪西班牙与奥斯曼争夺与王朝灭亡

politics.zh: 哈夫斯王朝是柏柏尔人建立的逊尼派王朝，前身为穆瓦希德在易弗里基叶的总督。阿布·扎卡里亚约1229年独立，以突尼斯为都，其子穆斯坦绥尔时期（1249—1277）势力扩张。此后王朝一度分裂为突尼斯与贝贾亚两支，14世纪遭马林王朝入侵。16世纪在西班牙与奥斯曼之间摇摆，1574年被奥斯曼军队灭亡。
politics.en: The Hafsids were a Sunni dynasty of Berber origin, descended from the Almohad governors of Ifriqiya. Abu Zakariya declared independence around 1229 with Tunis as his capital, and under his son al-Mustansir (1249-1277) the realm expanded. The dynasty later split between Tunis and Bejaia and suffered Marinid invasions in the fourteenth century. Caught between Spain and the Ottomans in the sixteenth century, it was ended by an Ottoman conquest in 1574.

economy.zh: 经济依托地中海贸易与内陆农业：突尼斯、比塞大等港口连接意大利、马格里布与黎凡特，输出橄榄油、谷物、皮革与珊瑚，输入纺织品和金属制品。跨撒哈拉商路在的黎波里与加贝斯方向汇入，城市手工业与犹太人、热那亚和威尼斯商人共同参与贸易。
economy.en: The economy rested on Mediterranean trade and inland agriculture. Ports such as Tunis and Bizerte linked Italy, the Maghreb and the Levant, exporting olive oil, grain, leather and coral and importing textiles and metal goods. Trans-Saharan routes reached the coast through Tripoli and Gabes, and urban crafts traded alongside Jewish, Genoese and Venetian merchants.

culture.zh: 突尼斯的扎伊图纳清真寺是马立克学派的教育中心，宫廷也接纳安达卢斯移民带来的学术与艺术。建筑以清真寺、经学院与城门著称，阿拉伯语文学与历史编纂延续。苏非教团在城市与乡村传播，16世纪奥斯曼统治前夕宗教与法律机构已相当完备。
culture.en: The Zaytuna mosque in Tunis was a centre of Maliki learning, and the court absorbed the scholarship and arts brought by Andalusian migrants. Mosques, colleges and city gates mark its architecture, and Arabic literature and historiography continued. Sufi orders spread in town and countryside, and religious and legal institutions were well developed on the eve of Ottoman rule.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约1229年阿布·扎卡里亚独立、1270年第八次十字军围攻突尼斯未果、14世纪马林王朝入侵与内部分裂、1535年西班牙占领突尼斯，以及1574年奥斯曼灭哈夫斯王朝。
events.en: Key moments include Abu Zakariya's independence around 1229, the failed Eighth Crusade against Tunis in 1270, Marinid invasions and internal division in the fourteenth century, the Spanish occupation of Tunis in 1535, and the Ottoman conquest that ended the dynasty in 1574.

value.zh: 阿布·扎卡里亚约1229年脱离穆瓦希德哈里发国独立，以突尼斯为都。
value.en: Abu Zakariya declared independence from the Almohad caliphate around 1229, ruling from Tunis.

value.zh: 1270年第八次十字军进攻突尼斯，围攻未果，法王路易九世在军中去世。
value.en: The Eighth Crusade attacked Tunis in 1270; the siege failed and King Louis IX of France died on campaign.

value.zh: 1574年奥斯曼军队攻占突尼斯，哈夫斯王朝灭亡。
value.en: Ottoman forces took Tunis in 1574, ending the Hafsid dynasty.

sources.title: Cape Colony
supports: Dutch East India Company settlement of 1652 and British occupation from 1795
Formal British possession after 1806 and the 1814 Anglo-Dutch Treaty
Frontier expansion and the Xhosa wars, with the eastern boundary at the Great Fish River
Abolition of slavery in 1834, the Great Trek and self-government in 1872

sources.title: 開普殖民地
supports: 1652年荷兰东印度公司建立定居点，1795年起英国占领
1806年英国再度占领，1814年英荷条约确认
向东扩张与科萨战争，东界至大鱼河
1834年废奴、大迁徙与1872年自治

politics.zh: 开普殖民地最初是荷兰东印度公司1652年在好望角建立的补给站，1795年英国首次占领，1802年依亚眠条约归还，1806年再度占领，1814年英荷条约确认归属。此后英国设总督治理，边界向东推进至大鱼河并经历多次科萨战争。1872年获责任政府，1910年与另外三个殖民地组成南非联邦。
politics.en: The Cape Colony began as a Dutch East India Company refreshment station at the Cape in 1652. Britain occupied it in 1795, returned it under the Peace of Amiens in 1802, occupied it again in 1806 and secured it by the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814. A British governor then administered the colony, whose frontier advanced east to the Great Fish River through several Xhosa wars. It gained responsible government in 1872 and joined three other colonies in the Union of South Africa in 1910.

economy.zh: 开普敦港为欧洲至亚洲航线提供补给，出产小麦、葡萄酒和牲畜。19世纪羊毛成为主要出口品，内陆牧场与港口贸易相连。殖民地实行奴隶制与学徒制，1834年废奴后劳动力关系重组；铁路与港口建设在19世纪后期加快。
economy.en: The port of Cape Town supplied ships on the Europe-Asia route and the hinterland produced wheat, wine and livestock. Wool became the leading export in the nineteenth century, linking inland ranches to the port. Slavery and apprenticeship shaped labour until abolition in 1834 reorganised the workforce, and railway and harbour works accelerated later in the century.

culture.zh: 殖民地社会由荷兰归正教会、英语行政与多族群居民构成，包括科伊桑人、被贩卖的奴隶后裔、英国移民和1820年定居者。荷兰语逐步形成南非语，英语在行政与教育中扩展。传教站、学校与报刊推动了公共文化，种族与身份界限也随法律和土地政策固化。
culture.en: Colonial society combined the Dutch Reformed church, English administration and a population of Khoisan, enslaved and freed people, British officials and the 1820 settlers. Dutch gradually evolved into Afrikaans while English expanded in administration and schooling. Mission stations, schools and newspapers shaped public culture, even as law and land policy hardened racial and status boundaries.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1652年建站、1795年与1806年英国两度占领、1814年条约确认、1834年废奴及随后的大迁徙、1872年获自治，以及1910年加入南非联邦。
events.en: Key moments include the founding of the station in 1652, the British occupations of 1795 and 1806, the treaty confirmation of 1814, the abolition of slavery in 1834 and the Great Trek that followed, self-government in 1872, and union in 1910.

value.zh: 1806年英国再次占领开普殖民地，1814年英荷条约正式确认其归属。
value.en: Britain reoccupied the Cape Colony in 1806 and the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 formally confirmed its possession.

value.zh: 1834年殖民地废除奴隶制，此后部分布尔农户向北迁徙，史称大迁徙。
value.en: Slavery was abolished in the colony in 1834, after which many Boer farmers moved north in the Great Trek.

value.zh: 1872年开普殖民地获得责任政府，1910年与另外三个殖民地组成南非联邦。
value.en: The Cape Colony gained responsible government in 1872 and joined three other colonies in the Union of South Africa in 1910.

sources.title: Ethiopia
supports: Ethiopia after the 1941 restoration, the 1974 revolution and the Derg
Federation and later annexation of Eritrea, and Eritrean independence in 1993
The 1998-2000 border war and the 2018 political opening
The 2020-2022 Tigray war and the federal system

sources.title: 埃塞俄比亚
supports: 1941年复国后的埃塞俄比亚与1974年革命、德尔格政权
与厄立特里亚的联邦、合并及1993年独立
1998—2000年边界战争与2018年政治转型
2020—2022年提格雷战争与联邦制

politics.zh: 埃塞俄比亚在1941年复国后由海尔·塞拉西一世统治，1952年与厄立特里亚组成联邦，1962年将其改为省份。1974年军官发动政变，德尔格政权上台并推行社会主义政策，1991年被人民革命民主阵线取代。1993年厄立特里亚独立，1998至2000年两国爆发边界战争。1995年宪法确立多民族联邦制，2018年后政治松动，2020至2022年爆发提格雷战争。
politics.en: After its restoration in 1941 Ethiopia was ruled by Haile Selassie I, federated with Eritrea in 1952 and annexed it as a province in 1962. A military coup in 1974 brought the Derg to power with socialist policies; it was replaced in 1991 by the EPRDF. Eritrea became independent in 1993 and the two states fought a border war from 1998 to 2000. The 1995 constitution created an ethnic federal system; politics opened after 2018 and the Tigray war was fought from 2020 to 2022.

economy.zh: 经济以农业为主，咖啡是最重要的出口品，苔麸、玉米和牲畜支撑大多数生计。国家长期主导发展与工业化，2011年起在青尼罗河修建复兴大坝，并建设工业园区与铁路。人口增长和城市化加快，外汇与债务压力随投资周期波动。
economy.en: Agriculture dominates the economy, with coffee the leading export and teff, maize and livestock supporting most livelihoods. The state long directed development and industrialisation, began the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam on the Blue Nile in 2011 and built industrial parks and railways. Population growth and urbanisation have accelerated while foreign exchange and debt pressures move with investment cycles.

culture.zh: 埃塞俄比亚正教会与阿克苏姆传统塑造了国家认同，吉兹字母与阿姆哈拉语、提格里尼亚语、奥罗莫语等多语并存。咖啡仪式、音乐与长跑传统广为人知；博物馆与考古遗址保存了露西化石和阿克苏姆方尖碑等遗产。各民族地区的语言与习俗在联邦制下获得不同形式的承认。
culture.en: The Ethiopian Orthodox church and the Aksumite tradition shape national identity, and Ge'ez script serves Amharic, Tigrinya, Oromo and other languages. Coffee ceremony, music and distance running are widely known, while museums and archaeological sites preserve heritage such as the Lucy fossil and the Aksum obelisks. Under the federal system the languages and customs of the regions receive differing degrees of recognition.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1941年复国、1974年德尔格政变、1991年政权更替、1993年厄立特里亚独立、1998—2000年边界战争、2018年阿比·艾哈迈德上台后的改革，以及2020—2022年提格雷战争与停火。
events.en: Key moments include the 1941 restoration, the 1974 Derg coup, the 1991 change of government, Eritrean independence in 1993, the border war of 1998-2000, the reforms after Abiy Ahmed took office in 2018, and the Tigray war and ceasefire of 2020-2022.

value.zh: 1974年军官政变推翻海尔·塞拉西一世，德尔格政权上台。
value.en: A military coup in 1974 overthrew Haile Selassie I and brought the Derg to power.

value.zh: 1993年厄立特里亚独立，埃塞俄比亚成为内陆国家。
value.en: Eritrea became independent in 1993, leaving Ethiopia landlocked.

value.zh: 2020至2022年联邦政府与提格雷力量交战，2022年签署停火协议。
value.en: Federal forces and Tigrayan forces fought from 2020 to 2022, when a ceasefire agreement was signed.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 7 条记录，年份范围为公元1942 年至公元2024 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录自1942年起，未覆盖1941年复国与更早的帝国时期；本条以战后至今的联邦国家为范围。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 7 territory records for this polity, covering 1942 CE to 2024 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records here begin in 1942 and do not cover the 1941 restoration or the earlier empire; this entry covers the post-war state.

sources.title: Nigeria
supports: Independence in 1960 and republican status in 1963
The 1967-1970 civil war and the Biafra secession
Military rule and the return to elected government in 1999
Oil, population and the federal system of 36 states

sources.title: 奈及利亞
supports: 1960年独立、1963年成为共和国
1967—1970年内战与比亚夫拉分离
军人执政与1999年恢复民选
石油、人口与36州联邦制

politics.zh: 尼日利亚1960年独立，1963年成为共和国，实行联邦制。1966年政变后军人执政，1967年东南部宣布成立比亚夫拉，引发至1970年的内战。此后军政交替，1999年恢复民选政府并延续至今，联邦由36个州和联邦首都区组成。族群、地区与宗教差异深刻影响政党与资源分配。
politics.en: Nigeria became independent in 1960 and a republic in 1963 with a federal system. Coups brought military rule in 1966, and the south-east's declaration of Biafra in 1967 led to a civil war that lasted until 1970. Military and civilian governments alternated until elected rule returned in 1999 and has continued since, with a federation of 36 states and a federal capital territory. Ethnic, regional and religious differences strongly shape parties and revenue sharing.

economy.zh: 石油和天然气是出口与财政收入的主要来源，产区集中在尼日尔三角洲。农业仍吸纳大量劳动力，木薯、可可、花生和芝麻是重要作物。拉各斯是西非金融与港口中心，服务业与电信发展较快，但油价波动、基础设施不足和就业压力长期存在。
economy.en: Oil and gas dominate exports and government revenue, produced mainly in the Niger Delta. Agriculture still employs a large share of workers, with cassava, cocoa, groundnuts and sesame as key crops. Lagos is a West African financial and port centre and services and telecommunications have grown, though oil price swings, infrastructure gaps and unemployment persist.

culture.zh: 尼日利亚有数百个族群，豪萨-富拉尼、约鲁巴和伊博是最大的三支，英语为官方语言，豪萨语、约鲁巴语和伊博语广泛使用。诺莱坞电影、非洲节拍音乐与当代文学影响超出国界；小说家钦努阿·阿契贝等作家使尼日利亚文学广为人知。宗教上伊斯兰教与基督教并存，节庆与饮食因地区而异。
culture.en: Nigeria has hundreds of ethnic groups, the largest being Hausa-Fulani, Yoruba and Igbo; English is official while Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo are widely spoken. Nollywood films, Afrobeats music and contemporary writing reach beyond the country, and novelists such as Chinua Achebe made Nigerian literature widely known. Islam and Christianity coexist, and festivals and food vary by region.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1960年独立、1967—1970年比亚夫拉内战、1970年代石油收入增长、1999年恢复民选政府，以及2014年前后成为非洲最大经济体。
events.en: Key moments include independence in 1960, the Biafra civil war of 1967-1970, the oil revenue boom of the 1970s, the return to elected government in 1999, and the rebasing that made Nigeria Africa's largest economy around 2014.

value.zh: 尼日利亚1960年10月1日独立，1963年成为共和国。
value.en: Nigeria became independent on 1 October 1960 and a republic in 1963.

value.zh: 1967至1970年的内战源于东南部比亚夫拉的分离，造成严重伤亡与饥荒。
value.en: The 1967-1970 civil war followed the secession of Biafra in the south-east and caused heavy casualties and famine.

value.zh: 1999年尼日利亚恢复民选政府，联邦制延续至今。
value.en: Elected government returned in 1999 and the federation has continued since.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 3 条记录（公元1961 年至公元2024 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 3 territory records for this polity (1961 CE to 2024 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change.

sources.title: Egypt
supports: Egypt as a republic after the 1952 revolution and the 1953 abolition of the monarchy
Nasser, the Suez crisis of 1956 and the wars with Israel
Sadat, the 1979 peace treaty and the Mubarak era
The 2011 uprising, the 2013 transition and the present state

sources.title: 埃及
supports: 1952年革命与1953年废除君主制后的共和国
纳赛尔、1956年苏伊士危机与对以色列的战争
萨达特、1979年和约与穆巴拉克时期
2011年起义、2013年过渡与当前政体

politics.zh: 埃及1952年由自由军官组织发动革命，1953年废除君主制建立共和国，纳赛尔执政后推行国有化与阿拉伯民族主义，1956年苏伊士运河危机后成为地区强国。萨达特转向与以色列和谈，1979年缔结和约。穆巴拉克自1981年执政至2011年民众起义下台，此后经历军方过渡与2013年政权更替，2014年宪法确立总统制。
politics.en: A 1952 coup by the Free Officers ended the monarchy in 1953 and made Egypt a republic. Under Nasser, nationalisation and Arab nationalism culminated in the 1956 Suez crisis and regional prominence. Sadat turned to negotiations with Israel and signed a peace treaty in 1979. Mubarak ruled from 1981 until the 2011 uprising, after which a military transition and the 2013 change of government led to the 2014 constitution and a presidential system.

economy.zh: 尼罗河灌溉农业仍是基础，棉花、谷物与果蔬供养庞大人口。苏伊士运河通行费、旅游、天然气出口与海外侨汇是主要外汇来源。国家在能源、银行与基础设施中占重要地位，开罗与亚历山大集中工业和服务业，人口增长与水资源压力长期存在。
economy.en: Irrigated agriculture along the Nile remains the base, with cotton, grain, fruit and vegetables feeding a large population. Suez Canal tolls, tourism, gas exports and remittances from abroad are the main sources of foreign currency. The state is a major actor in energy, banking and infrastructure, while Cairo and Alexandria concentrate industry and services and population growth keeps water pressure high.

culture.zh: 埃及是阿拉伯世界人口最多的国家，开罗的艾资哈尔是逊尼派重要学术中心。科普特正教会是最大的宗教少数派。埃及电影、音乐与电视节目在阿拉伯世界影响广泛，乌姆·库勒苏姆等歌手成为跨地区文化符号。尼罗河沿岸的考古遗址与博物馆构成国家文化记忆的重要部分。
culture.en: Egypt is the most populous Arab country and Al-Azhar in Cairo is a leading Sunni centre of learning. The Coptic Orthodox church is the largest religious minority. Egyptian cinema, music and television have long reached the wider Arab world, with singers such as Umm Kulthum becoming regional cultural figures. Archaeological sites and museums along the Nile form a central part of national memory.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1952年革命与1953年共和国成立、1956年苏伊士运河危机、1967与1973年对以色列的战争、1979年埃以和约、2011年民众起义，以及2013年政权更替与2014年宪法。
events.en: Key moments include the 1952 revolution and the republic of 1953, the Suez crisis of 1956, the wars with Israel in 1967 and 1973, the 1979 peace treaty, the 2011 uprising, and the 2013 change of government with the 2014 constitution.

value.zh: 1952年自由军官组织发动革命，1953年埃及废除君主制成为共和国。
value.en: The Free Officers' coup of 1952 led to the abolition of the monarchy and a republic in 1953.

value.zh: 1956年埃及将苏伊士运河公司国有化，随后爆发苏伊士运河危机。
value.en: Egypt nationalised the Suez Canal Company in 1956, triggering the Suez crisis.

value.zh: 1979年埃及与以色列签署和约，成为首个与以色列媾和的阿拉伯国家。
value.en: Egypt signed a peace treaty with Israel in 1979, the first Arab state to do so.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 6 条记录，年份范围为公元1953 年至公元2024 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录自1953年起，未覆盖1922年名义独立至1952年革命之间的王国时期；本条以1953年以来的共和国为范围。

The territory records begin in 1953 and do not cover the kingdom of 1922-1952; this entry covers the republic since 1953.

sources.title: Morocco
supports: The Alawite dynasty from the seventeenth century to the present
The French and Spanish protectorate of 1912 and independence in 1956
The 1975 Green March and the Western Sahara dispute
Agriculture, phosphates, tourism and the constitutional monarchy

sources.title: 摩洛哥
supports: 阿拉维王朝自17世纪延续至今
1912年法国与西班牙保护国与1956年独立
1975年绿色进军与西撒哈拉争端
农业、磷酸盐、旅游与君主立宪制

politics.zh: 摩洛哥自17世纪起由阿拉维王朝统治，1631年建立，1666年定都并统一大部分地区。1912年成为法国与西班牙的保护国，1956年获得独立，穆罕默德五世与哈桑二世重建君主权威。1975年组织绿色进军并实际控制西撒哈拉大部，该地主权仍有争议。2011年修宪后议会与首长的权力有所扩大，国王仍掌握宗教与安全事务的核心权力。
politics.en: Morocco has been ruled by the Alawite dynasty since the seventeenth century; it was established in 1631 and unified much of the country from 1666. It became a French and Spanish protectorate in 1912 and regained independence in 1956, after which Mohammed V and Hassan II rebuilt royal authority. The 1975 Green March led to Moroccan control of most of Western Sahara, whose sovereignty remains disputed. A 2011 constitutional revision widened the role of parliament and the government while the king retains core religious and security powers.

economy.zh: 农业吸纳大量劳动力，粮食、柑橘、橄榄与渔业产品面向欧洲市场。磷酸盐储量居世界前列，是国家收入与工业的重要支柱；纺织、汽车装配与航空零部件成为新兴出口部门。旅游与侨汇带来外汇，卡萨布兰卡是金融与港口中心，城市与沿海地区发展快于内陆山地。
economy.en: Agriculture employs many workers, with grain, citrus, olives and fisheries oriented to European markets. Phosphate reserves rank among the world's largest and underpin state revenue and industry, while textiles, car assembly and aerospace parts have become new export sectors. Tourism and remittances bring foreign currency, Casablanca is the financial and port centre, and the coast and cities develop faster than the interior mountains.

culture.zh: 摩洛哥文化融合阿拉伯、柏柏尔、安达卢斯与撒哈拉传统，阿拉伯语与柏柏尔语同为官方语言，法语广泛使用。伊斯兰教为国教，苏非教团与圣徒崇拜在民间影响深远。非斯、马拉喀什与拉巴特的老城、清真寺和经学院构成建筑遗产，音乐、地毯与饮食传统延续至今。
culture.en: Moroccan culture blends Arab, Amazigh, Andalusian and Saharan traditions; Arabic and Amazigh are both official and French is widely used. Islam is the state religion and Sufi orders and saint veneration remain influential. The medinas, mosques and colleges of Fez, Marrakesh and Rabat form an architectural heritage, and music, carpets and cuisine continue older traditions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1666年阿拉维王朝统一、1912年成为保护国、1956年独立、1975年绿色进军与西撒哈拉冲突，以及2011年修宪与随后的政治调整。
events.en: Key moments include the Alawite unification of 1666, the establishment of the French and Spanish protectorate in 1912, independence in 1956, the Green March of 1975 and the long dispute over Western Sahara, and the 2011 constitutional revision with the political adjustments that followed it.

value.zh: 摩洛哥1912年成为法国与西班牙保护国，1956年重获独立。
value.en: Morocco became a French and Spanish protectorate in 1912 and regained independence in 1956.

value.zh: 1975年摩洛哥组织绿色进军进入西撒哈拉，此后实际管辖该地大部，主权争议延续至今。
value.en: The 1975 Green March brought Moroccan administration over most of Western Sahara, where the sovereignty dispute continues.

value.zh: 2011年修宪扩大议会与政府权限，摩洛哥维持君主立宪制。
value.en: The 2011 constitutional revision widened parliamentary and government powers within a constitutional monarchy.

sources.title: United States
supports: Independence in 1776, the 1787 constitution and federal union
Territorial expansion and the Civil War of 1861-1865
Industrialisation, immigration and the world wars
Post-1945 leadership, the civil rights movement and the present federal republic

sources.title: 美国
supports: 1776年独立、1787年宪法与联邦制
领土扩张与1861—1865年内战
工业化、移民与两次世界大战
1945年后的地位、民权运动与当代联邦共和国

politics.zh: 美国1776年宣布独立，1787年制定宪法，建立联邦制共和国，行政、立法与司法分权，各州保留广泛权力。19世纪通过购买、条约与战争向西扩张，1861至1865年内战废除了奴隶制并确立了联邦不可分裂。20世纪成长为全球强国，战后主导国际组织与同盟体系，民权运动扩展了选举与公民权利。
politics.en: The United States declared independence in 1776 and adopted its constitution in 1787, creating a federal republic with separated executive, legislative and judicial powers and strong states. It expanded westward in the nineteenth century through purchase, treaty and war, and the Civil War of 1861-1865 abolished slavery and settled that the union could not be divided. In the twentieth century it became a global power, led post-war institutions and alliances, and the civil rights movement widened voting and citizenship rights.

economy.zh: 经济以市场机制为主，农业、制造业与服务业先后成为支柱。19世纪的铁路、钢铁与石油工业推动增长，20世纪汽车、航空、电子与信息技术领先。美元与纽约金融市场具有国际地位，联邦与州政府通过税收、监管和基础设施投资影响经济，收入与地区差距长期存在。
economy.en: The economy is mainly market-based, with agriculture, manufacturing and services leading in turn. Railways, steel and oil drove nineteenth-century growth, and the twentieth century saw leadership in automobiles, aviation, electronics and information technology. The dollar and New York financial markets hold international weight, federal and state governments shape the economy through taxation, regulation and infrastructure, and income and regional gaps persist.

culture.zh: 美国社会由来自世界各地的移民构成，英语使用最广，西班牙语等语言通行。宪法传统、大众媒体、好莱坞电影、爵士与摇滚乐、体育联盟与高等教育体系具有全球影响。宗教多元，基督教各派影响较大；原住民、非洲裔、拉美裔与亚裔群体的文化与权利运动塑造了公共生活。
culture.en: American society is built from immigration from around the world, with English dominant and Spanish and other languages widely spoken. Constitutional traditions, mass media, Hollywood, jazz and rock music, sports leagues and universities have global reach. Religion is diverse with several large Christian traditions, and the cultures and rights movements of Indigenous, African American, Latino and Asian communities shape public life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1776年《独立宣言》、1787年宪法、1861—1865年内战与废奴、19世纪末的工业与领土扩张、1941年参加第二次世界大战、1960年代民权立法，以及冷战结束后至今的联邦共和国。
events.en: Key moments include the Declaration of Independence in 1776, the constitution of 1787, the Civil War and abolition of slavery in 1861-1865, industrial and territorial expansion at the end of the nineteenth century, entry into the Second World War in 1941, civil rights legislation in the 1960s, and the federal republic through the post-Cold War decades.

value.zh: 1776年7月4日大陆会议通过《独立宣言》，1787年制定联邦宪法。
value.en: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on 4 July 1776, and the federal constitution followed in 1787.

value.zh: 1861至1865年内战以联邦获胜告终，奴隶制被废除。
value.en: The Civil War of 1861-1865 ended with a Union victory and the abolition of slavery.

value.zh: 1964年民权法案与1965年投票权法案结束了法律上的种族隔离与选举歧视。
value.en: The Civil Rights Act of 1964 and the Voting Rights Act of 1965 ended legal segregation and voting discrimination.

sources.title: Mexico
supports: The federal republic after the reform era and the 1910 revolution
The 1917 constitution, land reform and the PRI's long rule
Industrialisation, oil and the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement
Federalism, migration and the present republic

sources.title: 墨西哥
supports: 改革时期后的联邦共和国与1910年革命
1917年宪法、土地改革与革命制度党的长期执政
工业化、石油与1994年北美自由贸易协定
联邦制、移民与当代共和国

politics.zh: 墨西哥1821年独立后经历帝制与共和制的反复，19世纪中期改革战争确立世俗联邦国家。1910年革命推翻迪亚斯政权，1917年宪法规定土地、劳工与国家资源权利。1929年成立的革命制度党长期执政至2000年，此后政党轮替常态化。国家实行联邦制，32个州与首都各具权限，军队在政治中的作用逐步下降。
politics.en: After independence in 1821 Mexico alternated between empire and republic, and the mid-century reform wars established a secular federal state. The 1910 revolution overthrew Diaz and the 1917 constitution set out rights over land, labour and national resources. The party founded in 1929 ruled until 2000, after which alternation in office became normal. The federation has 32 states with the capital as its own entity, and the army's political role has gradually declined.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、服务业和石油为支柱，北部边境的出口加工区与汽车、电子产业面向美国市场。农业种植玉米、小麦与龙舌兰作物，白银与铜矿开采历史悠久。1994年北美自由贸易协定深化了与美加的贸易联系，侨汇与旅游也是重要外汇来源，非正规就业和地区差距仍然显著。
economy.en: Manufacturing, services and oil underpin the economy, with export assembly plants and car and electronics industries in the northern border region serving the United States market. Agriculture grows maize, wheat and agave crops, and silver and copper mining has a long history. The 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement deepened trade with the United States and Canada, remittances and tourism bring foreign currency, and informal work and regional gaps remain large.

culture.zh: 墨西哥文化融合原住民与西班牙传统，西班牙语为通用语言，另有数十种原住民语言。玉米、辣椒与可可塑造饮食，亡灵节、瓜达卢佩圣母节等节庆广泛流行。壁画运动、小说与电影具有国际影响，人类学与考古机构保存了特奥蒂瓦坎、玛雅与阿兹特克遗址。
culture.en: Mexican culture combines Indigenous and Spanish traditions; Spanish is the common language alongside dozens of Indigenous languages. Maize, chilli and cacao shape the cuisine, and festivals such as the Day of the Dead and the feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe are widely observed. The muralist movement, literature and cinema have international reach, and anthropological and archaeological institutions care for Teotihuacan, Maya and Aztec sites.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1821年独立、19世纪中期的改革与反改革战争、1910—1920年革命、1917年宪法、1938年石油国有化、1994年北美自由贸易协定生效，以及2000年首次政党轮替。
events.en: Key moments include independence in 1821, the mid-nineteenth-century reform wars, the revolution of 1910-1920, the constitution of 1917, the oil nationalisation of 1938, the entry into force of the North American Free Trade Agreement in 1994, and the first alternation in the presidency in 2000.

value.zh: 1910年革命推翻波菲里奥·迪亚斯政权，1917年颁布现行宪法。
value.en: The 1910 revolution overthrew Porfirio Diaz and the current constitution was promulgated in 1917.

value.zh: 1938年墨西哥将外国石油公司收归国有，成立国家石油公司。
value.en: Mexico nationalised foreign oil companies in 1938 and created the state oil company.

value.zh: 1994年北美自由贸易协定生效，墨西哥与美加形成紧密贸易区。
value.en: The North American Free Trade Agreement took effect in 1994, tying Mexico closely to the United States and Canada.

sources.title: Brazil
supports: The republic proclaimed in 1889 and the First Republic
Vargas, industrialisation and the 1946 and 1988 constitutions
The 1964-1985 military governments and redemocratisation
Agriculture, mining, Amazonia and the present federation

sources.title: 巴西
supports: 1889年共和国与第一共和国时期
瓦加斯、工业化与1946年、1988年宪法
1964—1985年军人政府与民主化
农业、矿业、亚马孙与当代联邦

politics.zh: 巴西1889年废除帝制建立共和国，第一共和国由咖啡寡头与各州政治主导。1930年瓦加斯上台后推行中央集权、劳工立法与进口替代工业化，1945年后经历民主与军政交替，1964至1985年为军人政府，1988年宪法恢复并扩大民主权利。联邦由26州与联邦区组成，总统制与多党格局延续至今。
politics.en: Brazil abolished the empire and became a republic in 1889, and the First Republic was dominated by coffee oligarchies and state politics. Vargas came to power in 1930 and pursued centralisation, labour legislation and import-substituting industrialisation; after 1945 democracy alternated with military rule, and the military governed from 1964 to 1985 until the 1988 constitution restored and widened democratic rights. The federation has 26 states and a federal district under a presidential, multi-party system.

economy.zh: 咖啡、大豆、甘蔗、牛肉与铁矿石是主要出口品，农业与矿业长期占重要地位。20世纪中叶起钢铁、汽车、石化与航空工业发展，圣保罗与里约热内卢成为工业与金融中心。1970年代开发亚马孙与水电、乙醇燃料计划并行，近年服务业占比上升，收入与地区差距、森林砍伐问题突出。
economy.en: Coffee, soy, sugar, beef and iron ore lead exports, and agriculture and mining have long been central. From the mid-twentieth century steel, automobiles, petrochemicals and aviation developed, with Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro as industrial and financial centres. Amazonian development and hydropower expanded in the 1970s alongside the ethanol programme; services now dominate, while income and regional gaps and deforestation remain prominent issues.

culture.zh: 巴西文化融合葡萄牙、非洲与原住民传统，葡萄牙语为唯一官方语言，天主教与新教、非洲裔宗教并存。桑巴、博萨诺瓦、足球与狂欢节具有世界影响，文学、建筑与影视形成独特风格。利亚·德·卡斯特罗等作家与奥斯卡·尼迈耶的建筑记录了现代国家形象。
culture.en: Brazilian culture blends Portuguese, African and Indigenous traditions; Portuguese is the sole official language and Catholicism, Protestant churches and Afro-Brazilian religions coexist. Samba, bossa nova, football and carnival have global reach, and literature, architecture and film developed distinctive styles. Writers such as Joao Ubaldo Ribeiro and the buildings of Oscar Niemeyer gave the modern state its imagery.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1889年建立共和国、1930年瓦加斯执政、1960年首都迁往巴西利亚、1964—1985年军人统治、1988年宪法，以及1990年代后的经济开放与政治轮替。
events.en: Key moments include the republic of 1889, Vargas coming to power in 1930, the move of the capital to Brasilia in 1960, military rule from 1964 to 1985, the 1988 constitution, and the economic opening and political alternation after the 1990s.

value.zh: 1889年巴西废除帝制，建立共和国；1891年颁布第一部共和宪法。
value.en: Brazil abolished the monarchy in 1889 and became a republic, adopting its first republican constitution in 1891.

value.zh: 1960年首都由里约热内卢迁至新建的巴西利亚。
value.en: The capital moved from Rio de Janeiro to the newly built Brasilia in 1960.

value.zh: 1988年宪法恢复民主制度，扩大公民权利与地方自治。
value.en: The 1988 constitution restored democracy and widened civil rights and local autonomy.

sources.title: Peru
supports: Independence from Spain in 1821 and the republic of 1822
The guano era, the War of the Pacific and the twentieth century
Military rule, the Shining Path conflict and the 1993 constitution
Mining, fisheries, agriculture and the present republic

sources.title: 秘鲁
supports: 1821年脱离西班牙与1822年共和国
鸟粪时代、太平洋战争与20世纪
军人执政、光辉道路冲突与1993年宪法
矿业、渔业、农业与当代共和国

politics.zh: 秘鲁1821年宣布独立，1822年建立共和国，独立初期政局动荡，军事首领长期执政。19世纪中期鸟粪出口带来财政繁荣，1879至1883年太平洋战争失败后失去塔拉帕卡与阿里卡。20世纪经历文人政府与军人政权的交替，1980年代光辉道路冲突造成严重伤亡，1993年宪法确立总统制，2000年后政权轮替常态化。
politics.en: Peru declared independence in 1821 and became a republic in 1822; early politics were unstable and military leaders often ruled. Guano exports brought revenue in the mid-nineteenth century, and defeat in the War of the Pacific of 1879-1883 cost Peru Tarapaca and Arica. The twentieth century alternated civilian and military rule, the Shining Path conflict of the 1980s caused heavy casualties, the 1993 constitution set up a presidential system, and alternation in office became normal after 2000.

economy.zh: 矿业是经济支柱，铜、金、银与锌产量居世界前列，安第斯山区与南部矿区集中生产。沿海渔业与鱼粉出口、平原棉花与甘蔗、山区马铃薯与藜麦构成农业格局。利马集中工业与金融，非正规就业和地区差距较大，基础设施与教育投入仍是发展议题。
economy.en: Mining anchors the economy, with copper, gold, silver and zinc among the world's largest outputs concentrated in the Andes and the south. Coastal fisheries and fishmeal, cotton and sugar on the coast, and potatoes and quinoa in the highlands shape agriculture. Lima concentrates industry and finance, informal work and regional gaps are wide, and infrastructure and education remain development issues.

culture.zh: 秘鲁文化以安第斯原住民与西班牙传统为基础，西班牙语与克丘亚语、艾马拉语等并存。印加遗址马丘比丘、纳斯卡线条与殖民时期教堂构成遗产体系，利马的博物馆保存前哥伦布时期文物。饮食融合安第斯、西班牙、非洲与亚洲元素，文学与音乐在拉美具有影响。
culture.en: Peruvian culture rests on Andean Indigenous and Spanish traditions, with Spanish alongside Quechua, Aymara and other languages. Inca sites such as Machu Picchu, the Nazca lines and colonial churches form a heritage system, and Lima's museums hold pre-Columbian collections. The cuisine blends Andean, Spanish, African and Asian elements, and its literature and music have regional influence.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1821年独立与1824年阿亚库乔战役、19世纪中期的鸟粪繁荣、1879—1883年太平洋战争、1980—2000年前后的国内冲突、1993年宪法，以及2000年后的民主轮替。
events.en: Key moments include independence in 1821 and the battle of Ayacucho in 1824, the guano boom of the mid-nineteenth century, the War of the Pacific of 1879-1883, the internal conflict around 1980-2000, the 1993 constitution, and democratic alternation after 2000.

value.zh: 1821年秘鲁宣布独立，1824年阿亚库乔战役结束西班牙在南美的统治。
value.en: Peru declared independence in 1821 and the battle of Ayacucho in 1824 ended Spanish rule in South America.

value.zh: 1879至1883年太平洋战争中秘鲁战败，失去塔拉帕卡与阿里卡。
value.en: Peru lost the War of the Pacific of 1879-1883 and ceded Tarapaca and Arica.

value.zh: 1993年宪法确立总统制框架，2000年后政权轮替常态化。
value.en: The 1993 constitution set the presidential framework, and alternation in office became normal after 2000.

sources.title: Canada
supports: The Statute of Westminster 1931 and full legislative independence
Participation in the Second World War and post-war expansion
Quebec, bilingualism and the 1982 constitution
Immigration, resources and the present federation

sources.title: 加拿大
supports: 1931年威斯敏斯特法令与立法独立
参加第二次世界大战与战后发展
魁北克、双语制与1982年宪法
移民、资源与当代联邦

politics.zh: 加拿大1867年组成联邦，1931年威斯敏斯特法令获得完整立法权。联邦制下十个省与三个地区分享权力，议会由众议院与参议院组成，总督代表国王。魁北克法语社群的地位与主权运动是长期议题，1982年宪法法案加入权利与自由宪章，未获魁北克签署。移民与多元文化政策塑造了政党与人口格局。
politics.en: Canada confederated in 1867 and gained full legislative independence under the Statute of Westminster in 1931. Ten provinces and three territories share powers in a federation, with a parliament of Commons and Senate and a governor general representing the crown. The place of the French-speaking Quebec and its sovereignty movement has been a lasting issue, and the 1982 constitution added a charter of rights without Quebec's signature. Immigration and multicultural policy have shaped parties and population.

economy.zh: 经济以服务业为主，能源、矿业、林业与农业提供大量出口。石油与天然气、钾盐、铀、黄金和木材面向美国市场，汽车与航空制造集中在安大略与魁北克。渔业与大西洋、太平洋港口支撑沿海地区，与美国和墨西哥的自由贸易协定是外贸框架的核心。
economy.en: Services dominate the economy, while energy, mining, forestry and agriculture supply many exports. Oil and gas, potash, uranium, gold and timber go mainly to the United States, and car and aerospace manufacturing is concentrated in Ontario and Quebec. Fisheries and Atlantic and Pacific ports support the coasts, and free trade with the United States and Mexico anchors external trade.

culture.zh: 加拿大社会由原住民、法裔、英裔与来自世界各地的移民构成，英语与法语同为官方语言。因纽特与第一民族的文化与权利在宪法和土地协定中得到承认。公共医疗、广播与冰球等制度与活动成为国家认同的一部分，文学、音乐与电影具有多元面貌。
culture.en: Canadian society comprises Indigenous peoples, French and British descendants and immigrants from around the world, with English and French as official languages. The cultures and rights of Inuit and First Nations are recognised in the constitution and land agreements. Public health care, broadcasting and ice hockey form part of national identity, and literature, music and film reflect the country's diversity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1931年威斯敏斯特法令、1939—1945年参加第二次世界大战、1949年纽芬兰加入联邦、1960年代魁北克静默革命、1982年宪法法案，以及1988年美加自由贸易协定与后续的北美自由贸易协定。
events.en: Key moments include the Statute of Westminster in 1931, participation in the Second World War from 1939 to 1945, Newfoundland joining the federation in 1949, Quebec's Quiet Revolution in the 1960s, the 1982 constitution act, and the 1988 free trade agreement with the United States and the later North American agreement.

value.zh: 1931年威斯敏斯特法令使加拿大获得完整立法独立。
value.en: The Statute of Westminster of 1931 gave Canada full legislative independence.

value.zh: 1982年宪法法案加入《权利与自由宪章》，但魁北克未签署。
value.en: The 1982 constitution act added the Charter of Rights and Freedoms, which Quebec did not sign.

value.zh: 1988年加拿大与美国签署自由贸易协定，后扩展为北美自由贸易协定。
value.en: Canada signed a free trade agreement with the United States in 1988, later extended into the North American Free Trade Agreement.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元1932 年至公元2024 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录自1932年起（5 条），未覆盖1867年联邦成立至1931年的自治领时期；本条以1932年以来的联邦国家为范围。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (1932 CE to 2024 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records begin in 1932 (five records) and do not cover the dominion from 1867 to 1931; this entry covers the federation since 1932.

sources.title: Spanish Empire
supports: The composite monarchy of Castile and Aragon and the conquests in the Americas
Habsburg rule, the Iberian Union and the silver economy
Bourbon reforms, independence movements and the loss of the mainland empire
The 1898 war and the empire's final years

sources.title: 西班牙帝國
supports: 卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡的复合君主国与美洲征服
哈布斯堡统治、伊比利亚联盟与白银经济
波旁改革、独立运动与大陆帝国的丧失
1898年战争与帝国的最后阶段

politics.zh: 西班牙帝国源于1479年卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡的联合，1492年哥伦布抵达美洲后迅速扩张，1521年征服阿兹特克、1533年征服印加，建立新西班牙与秘鲁总督区。1580至1640年与葡萄牙组成伊比利亚联盟，哈布斯堡时期在欧洲与地中海多线作战。波旁王朝改革后中央集权加强，19世纪初美洲独立运动使大陆帝国瓦解，1898年战败后仅余非洲领地。
politics.en: The Spanish Empire grew out of the union of Castile and Aragon in 1479. After Columbus reached the Americas in 1492 conquest followed quickly, with the Aztec defeated in 1521 and the Inca in 1533 and viceroyalties set up in New Spain and Peru. From 1580 to 1640 Spain and Portugal formed the Iberian Union, and the Habsburgs fought on many European and Mediterranean fronts. Bourbon reforms centralised administration, the independence movements of the early nineteenth century broke up the mainland empire, and defeat in 1898 left only African possessions.

economy.zh: 白银是帝国财政的核心，波托西与萨卡特卡斯矿区产出经塞维利亚运往欧洲，并跨太平洋经马尼拉连接亚洲。大庄园、米塔劳役制与种植园组织美洲生产，输出白银、糖、可可与染料，输入纺织品、金属制品与奴隶。18世纪波旁改革调整税制与贸易垄断，殖民地经济逐渐多元化。
economy.en: Silver was the core of imperial finance: Potosi and Zacatecas output passed through Seville to Europe and crossed the Pacific through Manila to Asia. Haciendas, the mita labour system and plantations organised American production, exporting silver, sugar, cacao and dyes and importing textiles, metal goods and enslaved people. Bourbon reforms of the eighteenth century changed taxation and trade monopolies as colonial economies diversified.

culture.zh: 帝国推行天主教传教与西班牙语行政，同时保留各地语言与习俗。巴洛克建筑、宗教艺术与城市网格在美洲城市中普及，萨拉曼卡与墨西哥大学培养行政与神职人才。混血社会形成新的族群与文化层次，原住民典籍与传教记录留下重要文献。
culture.en: The empire promoted Catholic missions and Spanish administration while local languages and customs persisted. Baroque architecture, religious art and grid-plan towns spread through American cities, and universities in Salamanca and Mexico trained officials and clergy. A mestizo society produced new ethnic and cultural layers, and Indigenous codices and missionary records left major sources.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1492年抵达美洲、1521年与1533年征服阿兹特克和印加、1580—1640年伊比利亚联盟、1700年波旁王朝入主、19世纪初美洲独立战争，以及1898年战败与帝国终结。
events.en: Key moments include the arrival in the Americas in 1492, the conquests of the Aztec in 1521 and the Inca in 1533, the Iberian Union of 1580-1640, the Bourbon accession of 1700, the American independence wars of the early nineteenth century, and the defeat of 1898 that ended the empire.

value.zh: 1521年西班牙征服阿兹特克，1533年征服印加，随后建立新西班牙与秘鲁总督区。
value.en: Spain conquered the Aztec in 1521 and the Inca in 1533 and then established the viceroyalties of New Spain and Peru.

value.zh: 1580至1640年西班牙与葡萄牙共戴一王，组成伊比利亚联盟。
value.en: From 1580 to 1640 Spain and Portugal shared a monarch in the Iberian Union.

value.zh: 1898年西班牙在美西战争中战败，失去古巴、波多黎各、关岛与菲律宾。
value.en: Defeat in the Spanish-American War of 1898 cost Spain Cuba, Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 157 territory records for this polity, covering 1516 CE to 1931 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover 1516-1931; the earlier expansion from 1492 and the residual territories before 1976 appear as background.

sources.title: Portuguese Empire
supports: Exploration from 1415 and Vasco da Gama's route to India in 1498
Trading posts in Asia, Africa and Brazil in the sixteenth century
The Iberian Union, Dutch and English competition and the gold of Brazil
The nineteenth century, the 1822 independence of Brazil and the 1910 republic

sources.title: 葡萄牙帝國
supports: 1415年起的航海探索与1498年达·伽马到达印度
16世纪在亚洲、非洲与巴西的商站与据点
伊比利亚联盟、荷英竞争与巴西黄金
19世纪、1822年巴西独立与1910年共和国

politics.zh: 葡萄牙帝国自1415年占领休达开始海上扩张，1488年迪亚士绕过好望角，1498年达·伽马抵达印度，1500年卡布拉尔到达巴西。16世纪在印度洋与东南亚建立果阿、马六甲、澳门等据点，1580至1640年与西班牙共戴一王。1640年复国后重心转向巴西与非洲，1822年巴西独立，19世纪保留非洲殖民地，1910年葡萄牙建立共和国。
politics.en: Portuguese overseas expansion began with the capture of Ceuta in 1415; Dias rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488, Vasco da Gama reached India in 1498 and Cabral reached Brazil in 1500. In the sixteenth century Portugal held Goa, Malacca, Macau and other posts in the Indian Ocean and Southeast Asia, and from 1580 to 1640 shared a monarch with Spain. After 1640 it focused on Brazil and Africa; Brazil became independent in 1822, African colonies remained in the nineteenth century, and Portugal became a republic in 1910.

economy.zh: 帝国经济以海上贸易与据点网络为主，香料、丝绸、黄金、象牙与奴隶经印度洋航线运往里斯本，再由王室垄断或承包给商人。巴西的甘蔗、黄金与钻石在17至18世纪成为主要财源，非洲的安哥拉与莫桑比克提供奴隶与象牙。18世纪后英国商人介入，贸易结构逐步改变。
economy.en: The imperial economy centred on maritime trade and a network of fortified posts: spices, silk, gold, ivory and enslaved people moved through the Indian Ocean to Lisbon under crown monopoly or merchant contracts. Sugar, gold and diamonds from Brazil became the main revenue in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, while Angola and Mozambique supplied slaves and ivory. British merchants entered the trade after the eighteenth century and the structure changed.

culture.zh: 葡萄牙语随商站、传教与移民扩散，成为巴西与非洲部分地区的通用语言，并与当地语言形成克里奥尔语。天主教传教团在亚洲与非洲建立教堂与学校，澳门与果阿成为欧洲、亚洲与非洲文化交流的节点。葡萄牙建筑、音乐与饮食在各地留下混合传统。
culture.en: Portuguese spread with trading posts, missions and settlement and became the common language of Brazil and parts of Africa, mixing into creole languages. Catholic missions built churches and schools in Asia and Africa, and Macau and Goa became nodes of exchange between Europe, Asia and Africa. Portuguese architecture, music and cuisine left hybrid traditions in many places.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1415年占领休达、1498年达·伽马抵达印度、1500年到达巴西、1580—1640年伊比利亚联盟、1822年巴西独立，以及1910年葡萄牙共和国建立。
events.en: Key moments include the capture of Ceuta in 1415, Vasco da Gama's arrival in India in 1498, the reaching of Brazil in 1500, the Iberian Union of 1580-1640, Brazilian independence in 1822, and the Portuguese republic of 1910.

value.zh: 1498年达·伽马率船队抵达印度，打通欧洲与印度洋的直接航线。
value.en: Vasco da Gama reached India in 1498, opening a direct sea route between Europe and the Indian Ocean.

value.zh: 1500年卡布拉尔到达巴西，巴西后来成为帝国最重要的殖民地。
value.en: Cabral reached Brazil in 1500 and the colony later became the empire's most important possession.

value.zh: 1910年葡萄牙废除君主制建立共和国，帝国进入最后阶段。
value.en: Portugal abolished the monarchy and became a republic in 1910, entering the empire's final phase.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 146 territory records for this polity, covering 1502 CE to 1910 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover 1502-1910; the 1415 capture of Ceuta and earlier exploration appear as background.

sources.title: New France
supports: Exploration from Cartier in 1534 and the founding of Quebec in 1608
The fur trade and alliances with Indigenous nations
The five colonies of the viceroyalty at its height
The Seven Years' War, the 1763 Treaty of Paris and the Quebec Act

sources.title: 新法蘭西
supports: 1534年卡蒂埃探索与1608年魁北克建城
毛皮贸易与和原住民族群的联盟
总督区鼎盛时期的五个殖民地
七年战争、1763年巴黎条约与1774年魁北克法案

politics.zh: 新法兰西是法国在北美大陆的殖民地，1534年卡蒂埃探索圣劳伦斯湾，1608年尚普兰建立魁北克。总督区下分加拿大、阿卡迪亚、纽芬兰、哈得孙湾与路易斯安那，由总督与主权委员会治理。法国通过与阿贡昆人等原住民族群的联盟维持毛皮贸易与军事平衡。七年战争失败后，1763年巴黎条约将新法兰西割让给英国与西班牙，1774年魁北克法案保留了法裔居民的天主教与民法。
politics.en: New France was the French colony in mainland North America. Cartier explored the Gulf of Saint Lawrence in 1534 and Champlain founded Quebec in 1608. The viceroyalty comprised Canada, Acadia, Newfoundland, Hudson Bay and Louisiana under a governor and sovereign council, and France relied on alliances with Indigenous nations such as the Algonquin to sustain the fur trade and a military balance. After defeat in the Seven Years' War the Treaty of Paris of 1763 ceded New France to Britain and Spain, and the Quebec Act of 1774 preserved the Catholic religion and civil law of French inhabitants.

economy.zh: 毛皮贸易是殖民地经济的核心，海狸皮经圣劳伦斯河运往法国，换取制成品、武器与酒类。农业以圣劳伦斯河谷的农户（habitants）为主，种植小麦并饲养牲畜；渔业、木材与后来的路易斯安那烟草、靛蓝也提供出口。殖民人口增长缓慢，贸易依赖与原住民族群和法国商人的网络。
economy.en: The fur trade was the core of the colonial economy: beaver pelts moved down the St Lawrence to France in exchange for manufactures, weapons and alcohol. Farming by habitants in the St Lawrence valley grew wheat and raised livestock, while fisheries, timber and later tobacco and indigo from Louisiana also produced exports. Population grew slowly and trade depended on networks with Indigenous nations and French merchants.

culture.zh: 殖民地以天主教为官方宗教，教区、修会与学校承担教育与社会服务。法语与天主教习俗在加拿大延续，coureurs des bois 与传教士学习原住民语言并记录其习俗。建筑以石砌房屋与教堂为特色，魁北克与蒙特利尔形成城市文化中心，法裔与英裔并存格局由此奠定。
culture.en: Catholicism was the established religion and parishes, religious orders and schools provided education and welfare. French language and Catholic custom persisted in Canada, while coureurs des bois and missionaries learned Indigenous languages and recorded their customs. Stone houses and churches mark the architecture, Quebec and Montreal became urban centres, and the coexistence of French and British populations dates from this period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1534年卡蒂埃到达圣劳伦斯湾、1608年魁北克建城、1663年王室直接统治、1713年乌得勒支条约割让阿卡迪亚、1759年亚伯拉罕平原战役，以及1763年巴黎条约与1774年魁北克法案。
events.en: Key moments include Cartier's arrival in the Gulf of Saint Lawrence in 1534, the founding of Quebec in 1608, direct royal rule from 1663, the cession of Acadia by the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713, the battle of the Plains of Abraham in 1759, the Treaty of Paris of 1763 and the Quebec Act of 1774.

value.zh: 1608年尚普兰建立魁北克，成为新法兰西的行政中心。
value.en: Champlain founded Quebec in 1608 as the administrative centre of New France.

value.zh: 1763年巴黎条约将新法兰西割让给英国与西班牙，法国失去北美大陆殖民地。
value.en: The Treaty of Paris of 1763 ceded New France to Britain and Spain, ending French rule in mainland North America.

value.zh: 1774年魁北克法案承认天主教与法国民法，保留法裔社会结构。
value.en: The Quebec Act of 1774 recognised Catholicism and French civil law, preserving the French-speaking society.

sources.title: Haudenosaunee
supports: The confederacy of Iroquoian-speaking nations in what is now upstate New York
The Five Nations before 1722 and the Six Nations after the Tuscarora joined
Consensus government under the Great Law and matrilineal clans
The fur trade, colonial wars and the American Revolution

sources.title: 易洛魁聯盟
supports: 易洛魁语诸族在今纽约州一带结成的邦联
1722年前的五族同盟与塔斯卡洛拉人加入后的六族同盟
《大和平法》与母系氏族下的议事制度
毛皮贸易、殖民战争与美国独立战争

politics.zh: 易洛魁联盟由莫霍克、奥奈达、奥农达加、塞内卡与卡尤加五族在16世纪或更早结成，1772年前后塔斯卡洛拉人加入成为六族。联盟以奥农达加为议事中心，由各族首领组成的议事会按共识决策，母系氏族决定首领的产生。各族在内部事务上保持自主，联盟主要处理对外战争、条约与贸易关系。
politics.en: The Haudenosaunee Confederacy was formed by the Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga and Seneca, in the sixteenth century or earlier, and the Tuscarora joined around 1722 to make six nations. The confederacy council met at Onondaga and decided by consensus, with matrilineal clans selecting chiefs. Each nation kept autonomy in internal affairs while the council handled war, treaties and trade with outsiders.

economy.zh: 经济以玉米、豆类与南瓜种植为基础，妇女管理农田与收成，狩猎和捕鱼补充食物。17世纪起毛皮贸易成为与欧洲人交往的核心，海狸皮换取金属工具、武器、布匹与酒。联盟控制今纽约州与俄亥俄河谷之间的通道，贸易与外交网络远及五大湖和圣劳伦斯河。
economy.en: The economy rested on maize, beans and squash grown by women, supplemented by hunting and fishing. From the seventeenth century the fur trade became central to relations with Europeans, exchanging beaver pelts for metal tools, weapons, cloth and alcohol. The confederacy controlled routes between what is now New York and the Ohio valley, and its trade and diplomatic networks reached the Great Lakes and the St Lawrence.

culture.zh: 易洛魁社会以母系氏族和长屋为组织基础，《大和平法》以口头传统传承联盟的起源与议事规则。宗教仪式围绕农耕节令与感恩展开，医药会社和梦占在社会生活中占重要位置。长屋、假面会社与玉米种植习俗延续至今，联盟的象征与礼仪仍是当代易洛魁社群认同的一部分。
culture.en: Iroquois society was organised through matrilineal clans and longhouses, and the Great Law was transmitted orally as the confederacy's founding and procedural charter. Religious observance followed the agricultural calendar and thanksgiving ceremonies, while medicine societies and dream interpretation held important social roles. Longhouses, masked societies and maize cultivation continue, and the confederacy's symbols remain part of contemporary Haudenosaunee identity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪或更早结盟、17世纪的毛皮战争与和约、1722年前后塔斯卡洛拉人加入、1754年奥尔巴尼会议，以及美国独立战争中联盟内部分裂、1784年后的土地割让。
events.en: Key moments include the founding of the confederacy in the sixteenth century or earlier, the fur trade wars and treaties of the seventeenth century, the admission of the Tuscarora around 1722, the Albany Congress of 1754, and the split within the confederacy during the American Revolution followed by land cessions after 1784.

value.zh: 易洛魁联盟由五个易洛魁语民族在16世纪或更早结成，议事中心在奥农达加。
value.en: Five Iroquoian-speaking nations formed the confederacy in the sixteenth century or earlier, with its council at Onondaga.

value.zh: 约1722年塔斯卡洛拉人加入，联盟由五族变为六族。
value.en: The Tuscarora joined around 1722, turning the Five Nations into the Six Nations.

value.zh: 美国独立战争期间联盟内部分裂，战后大量土地被割让。
value.en: The confederacy divided during the American Revolution and ceded much land afterwards.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 24 territory records for this polity, covering 1450 CE to 1782 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Teotihuacan
supports: Teotihuacan as a major pre-Columbian city in the Valley of Mexico
The Pyramid of the Sun and Pyramid of the Moon and the city's grid plan
Its wide influence in Mesoamerica and its mixed population
The city's decline and burning in the sixth or seventh century

sources.title: 特奧蒂瓦坎
supports: 特奥蒂瓦坎是墨西哥谷的大型前哥伦布城市
太阳金字塔、月亮金字塔与网格状城市布局
对中美洲的广泛影响与多元人口
6至7世纪的衰落与焚毁

politics.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎位于墨西哥谷东北部，约在公元前1世纪形成城市，公元1至5世纪达到鼎盛，人口估计超过十万，是当时美洲最大的城市。其政治结构尚未确定，未见可辨识的王名与王朝记录，学界多认为由贵族集团或集体机构统治。城市影响远及玛雅低地与墨西哥各地，约在6至7世纪焚毁并衰落。
politics.en: Teotihuacan lies in the north-east of the Valley of Mexico. It took shape around the first century BCE and peaked between about 100 and 500 CE, when its population may have exceeded 100,000, making it the largest city in the Americas at the time. Its political structure is still uncertain: no royal names or dynastic records have been identified, and scholars usually infer rule by noble factions or corporate bodies. Its influence reached the Maya lowlands and much of Mexico before the city was burned and declined in the sixth or seventh century.

economy.zh: 城市经济依靠墨西哥谷的农业、黑曜石开采与加工，以及远距离贸易。特奥蒂瓦坎控制黑曜石来源并输出工具与武器，输入玉石、贝壳、羽毛和可可等奢侈品。城区划分为手工业作坊区与居住区，外来人口聚居的街区表明移民与商贸网络的存在。
economy.en: The urban economy depended on agriculture in the Valley of Mexico, obsidian extraction and working, and long-distance trade. Teotihuacan controlled obsidian sources and exported tools and weapons while importing jade, shell, feathers and cacao. The city was divided into craft workshop and residential quarters, and neighbourhoods of foreign origin point to migration and commercial networks.

culture.zh: 城市以太阳金字塔、月亮金字塔与羽蛇神庙为核心，沿南北向的亡者大道排列，壁画与雕塑形成公共艺术体系。宗教崇拜涉及雨神、羽蛇与战神等神祇，人祭与建筑奉献见于考古记录。特奥蒂瓦坎的影响体现在中美洲各地的陶器、建筑与历法元素中，但其文字与语言归属仍无定论。
culture.en: The city centred on the Pyramid of the Sun, the Pyramid of the Moon and the Temple of the Feathered Serpent along the north-south Avenue of the Dead, with murals and sculpture forming a public art system. Cult practice involved gods such as the storm deity, the feathered serpent and war deities, and sacrifice and building dedication appear in the archaeological record. Teotihuacan influence shows in pottery, architecture and calendar elements across Mesoamerica, though its writing and language remain unidentified.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前1世纪城市形成、公元2世纪前后太阳金字塔与月亮金字塔建成、4至5世纪影响力的高峰、约550年前后的焚毁与人口下降，以及此后阿兹特克人把此地视为圣地。
events.en: Key moments include the city's formation around the first century BCE, the construction of the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon around the second century CE, the peak of its influence in the fourth and fifth centuries, the burning and population decline around 550, and the later Aztec veneration of the site as a sacred place.

value.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎在公元1至5世纪达到鼎盛，人口估计超过十万。
value.en: Teotihuacan peaked between about 100 and 500 CE with an estimated population above 100,000.

value.zh: 太阳金字塔与月亮金字塔沿亡者大道排列，是城市仪式的核心。
value.en: The Pyramids of the Sun and Moon line the Avenue of the Dead and formed the ceremonial core.

value.zh: 约公元550年前后城市遭焚毁并衰落，具体原因仍有争议。
value.en: The city was burned and declined around 550 CE, and the causes remain disputed.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 4 条记录（公元前50 年至公元704 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖约前50年至704年（4 条）；早期兴起阶段与8世纪后的遗迹时期以所列条目为背景。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 4 territory records for this polity (50 BCE to 704 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover about 50 BCE to 704 CE (four records); the earlier rise and the post-eighth-century ruins appear as background from the cited articles.

sources.title: Ancestral Puebloans
supports: The Ancestral Puebloans of the Four Corners region
Chaco Canyon, great houses and road networks
Cliff dwellings such as those at Mesa Verde
Maize agriculture, drought and migration to the Rio Grande

sources.title: 阿那萨吉人
supports: 四角地区的古普韦布洛文化
查科峡谷的大型建筑与道路系统
梅萨维德等崖居遗址
玉米农业、干旱与向格兰德河流域的迁徙

politics.zh: 阿那萨吉人生活在今美国西南部四角地区，约公元850至1150年以查科峡谷为中心形成大型聚落体系，建造多层石砌大屋、圆形基瓦与连接各处的道路。政治组织可能以仪式与交换为纽带，由多个社群共享中心。1150年后重心转向阿兹特克与梅萨维德等地，13世纪末大部分聚落被放弃，人群迁往格兰德河流域与霍皮、祖尼等地。
politics.en: The Ancestral Puebloans lived in the Four Corners region of the present south-western United States. From about 850 to 1150 a system of large settlements centred on Chaco Canyon, with multi-storey masonry great houses, circular kivas and roads linking sites; political organisation probably rested on ritual and exchange rather than a single state. After 1150 the focus shifted to Aztec and Mesa Verde, and by the end of the thirteenth century most settlements were abandoned as people moved to the Rio Grande and to Hopi and Zuni communities.

economy.zh: 经济以玉米、豆类与南瓜种植为主，辅以狩猎和小规模灌溉；查科地区依靠雨水与季节性径流，修建水渠与蓄水池。长距离交换网络输入黑曜石、贝壳、绿松石与鹦鹉羽毛，输出棉布与农产品。13世纪的持续干旱加剧了粮食压力，成为聚落废弃的重要因素之一。
economy.en: The economy centred on maize, beans and squash with hunting and small-scale irrigation; Chaco farming relied on rainfall and seasonal runoff managed with ditches and reservoirs. Long-distance exchange brought in obsidian, shell, turquoise and macaw feathers while cotton cloth and farm produce moved out. A series of droughts in the thirteenth century intensified food stress and contributed to the abandonment of settlements.

culture.zh: 阿那萨吉人以基瓦和仪式建筑为社群生活中心，天文观测与历法指导农时和祭祀，太阳匕首等遗迹显示对至日的观测。陶器、编织与绿松石饰品形成独特风格，岩画记录宗教符号与历史事件。其文化传统由今天的普韦布洛各族延续，口述历史把现代社群与古代遗址联系起来。
culture.en: Kivas and ceremonial buildings were the focus of community life, and astronomical observation and calendars guided farming and ritual, with sun dagger sites recording solstice observations. Pottery, weaving and turquoise ornaments developed distinctive styles, and rock art records religious symbols and events. Pueblo peoples today continue these traditions, and oral histories link modern communities to the ancient sites.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约850年查科体系兴起、11世纪大屋与道路网络的高峰、1130至1150年前后的干旱与查科衰落、13世纪梅萨维德等崖居的繁荣，以及约1300年前后大规模迁徙。
events.en: Key moments include the rise of the Chaco system around 850, the peak of great houses and roads in the eleventh century, the droughts and Chaco decline around 1130-1150, the flourishing of cliff dwellings such as Mesa Verde in the thirteenth century, and the large-scale migration around 1300.

value.zh: 约850至1150年查科峡谷成为区域中心，建有大屋、基瓦与道路网络。
value.en: Chaco Canyon was a regional centre from about 850 to 1150 with great houses, kivas and a road network.

value.zh: 12至13世纪的多次干旱加剧粮食压力，与聚落废弃相关。
value.en: Repeated droughts in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries intensified food stress and are linked to the abandonment of settlements.

value.zh: 13世纪末人群迁往格兰德河流域等地，其传统由今日普韦布洛各族延续。
value.en: People moved to the Rio Grande and elsewhere at the end of the thirteenth century, and Pueblo peoples continue their traditions today.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元850 年至公元1304 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖850—1304年（5 条），分别对应查科与阿兹特克两个区域系统；更早的篮子人时期作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (850 CE to 1304 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover 850-1304 (five records) for the Chaco and Aztec regional systems; the earlier Basketmaker period appears as background.

sources.title: India
supports: Independence and partition in 1947 and the constitution of 1950
Nehru, planned development and the Green Revolution
The 1991 economic reforms and the growth of services
Federalism, multilingual politics and the present republic

sources.title: 印度
supports: 1947年独立与分治、1950年宪法
尼赫鲁、计划发展与绿色革命
1991年经济改革与服务业的增长
联邦制、多语言政治与当代共和国

politics.zh: 印度1947年独立，同时按宗教多数划分与巴基斯坦分治，1950年宪法确立联邦议会制共和国，实行普选。尼赫鲁时期推行国家主导的工业化与不结盟外交，此后国大党长期执政，1975至1977年经历紧急状态。1990年代进入联合政府时期，2014年后印度人民党主导中央。联邦由28个邦与中央直辖区组成，语言与地区认同深刻影响政治。
politics.en: India became independent in 1947 and was partitioned from Pakistan along religious lines; the 1950 constitution set up a federal parliamentary republic with universal suffrage. Nehru's era pursued state-led industrialisation and non-alignment, the Congress party long dominated politics, and an Emergency was imposed from 1975 to 1977. Coalition governments became usual in the 1990s, and the Bharatiya Janata Party has led the centre since 2014. The federation of 28 states and union territories is strongly shaped by language and regional identity.

economy.zh: 独立初期以农业为主，国家通过五年计划发展重工业与基础设施。1960年代的绿色革命推广高产品种与灌溉，提高粮食自给。1991年国际收支危机后推行自由化，服务业与信息技术产业迅速扩张，成为增长与出口的重要部门。农业仍吸纳大量劳动力，非正规就业、城乡与地区差距以及基础设施不足仍是长期议题。
economy.en: Agriculture dominated at independence and five-year plans built heavy industry and infrastructure. The Green Revolution of the 1960s spread high-yielding varieties and irrigation and improved food self-sufficiency. After the balance-of-payments crisis of 1991 liberalisation followed, and services and information technology expanded quickly to become major growth and export sectors. Agriculture still employs many workers, and informal work, rural-urban and regional gaps, and infrastructure deficits remain long-term issues.

culture.zh: 印度有数十个族群与语言，印地语与英语为联邦官方语言，宪法承认22种语言。印度教、伊斯兰教、基督教、锡克教、佛教与耆那教等并存，节庆与朝圣活动遍布各地。电影、古典与流行音乐、舞蹈和文学影响广泛，瑜伽与阿育吠陀等传统实践传播海外；泰姬陵等古迹与众多世界遗产构成文化记忆。
culture.en: India has dozens of ethnic and linguistic communities; Hindi and English are the federal official languages and the constitution recognises 22 languages. Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism and Jainism coexist, with festivals and pilgrimages throughout the country. Cinema, classical and popular music, dance and literature have wide reach, and practices such as yoga and Ayurveda have spread abroad; monuments such as the Taj Mahal and many World Heritage sites form part of its cultural memory.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1947年独立与分治、1950年宪法、1962年中印边界冲突、1965与1971年印巴战争、1971年孟加拉国独立、1975—1977年紧急状态、1991年经济改革，以及2014年后的政治格局。
events.en: Key moments include independence and partition in 1947, the constitution of 1950, the border conflict with China in 1962, the wars with Pakistan in 1965 and 1971, the independence of Bangladesh in 1971, the Emergency of 1975-1977, the economic reforms of 1991, and the political realignment after 2014.

value.zh: 1947年印度独立并与巴基斯坦分治，1950年宪法生效。
value.en: India became independent in 1947 and was partitioned from Pakistan; the constitution took effect in 1950.

value.zh: 1960年代的绿色革命推广高产品种与灌溉，显著提高粮食产量。
value.en: The Green Revolution of the 1960s spread high-yielding varieties and irrigation and sharply raised food output.

value.zh: 1991年国际收支危机后印度推行经济自由化，服务业快速增长。
value.en: After the 1991 balance-of-payments crisis India liberalised its economy and services grew rapidly.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 12 条记录，年份范围为公元1947 年至公元2024 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录自1947年起，未覆盖殖民时期与更早的历史；本条以独立以来的共和国为范围。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 12 territory records for this polity, covering 1947 CE to 2024 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records begin in 1947 and do not cover the colonial or earlier periods; this entry covers the republic since independence.

sources.title: Pakistan
supports: Independence in 1947 and the republic proclaimed in 1956
The 1971 war and the independence of Bangladesh
Military governments, the 1973 constitution and later civilian rule
Agriculture, textiles, remittances and the present federal republic

sources.title: 巴基斯坦
supports: 1947年独立与1956年共和国
1971年战争与孟加拉国独立
军人政府、1973年宪法与后来的民选政府
农业、纺织、侨汇与当代联邦共和国

politics.zh: 巴基斯坦1947年作为英联邦自治领独立，1956年成为伊斯兰共和国，首都初设卡拉奇，后迁至伊斯兰堡。1970年大选后东部危机引发1971年战争，孟加拉国独立。此后军政交替，1973年宪法确立联邦议会制，1999年穆沙拉夫执政，2008年恢复民选政府。联邦由四省与联邦直辖区组成，军方在安全与外交中长期具有影响。
politics.en: Pakistan became independent as a Commonwealth dominion in 1947 and an Islamic republic in 1956, with Karachi as its first capital and later Islamabad. The 1970 election and the crisis in the east led to the 1971 war and the independence of Bangladesh. Military and civilian governments then alternated: the 1973 constitution set up a federal parliamentary system, Musharraf took power in 1999, and elected government returned in 2008. The federation has four provinces and a capital territory, and the army has long influenced security and foreign policy.

economy.zh: 印度河平原的灌溉农业是基础，小麦、棉花、水稻与甘蔗是主要作物。纺织与服装是最大出口部门，水泥、化肥与汽车装配也有规模；海外劳工侨汇是重要外汇来源。能源短缺、税基狭窄与债务问题长期存在，中巴经济走廊带来基础设施投资，城市与农村发展差距明显。
economy.en: Irrigated agriculture on the Indus plain is the base, with wheat, cotton, rice and sugar cane as major crops. Textiles and clothing are the largest export sector, with cement, fertiliser and car assembly also significant, and remittances from workers abroad are a key source of foreign currency. Energy shortages, a narrow tax base and debt problems persist, the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor has brought infrastructure investment, and urban-rural gaps are wide.

culture.zh: 巴基斯坦文化融合印度河、波斯、中亚与伊斯兰传统，乌尔都语为官方语言，旁遮普语、信德语、普什图语与俾路支语等广泛使用。苏非圣陵与音乐传统在各地影响深远，卡瓦利演唱广为人知。文学、诗歌与手工地毯、铜器延续地区工艺，板球是最受关注的运动。
culture.en: Pakistani culture blends Indus, Persian, Central Asian and Islamic traditions. Urdu is the official language while Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto and Balochi are widely spoken, and Sufi shrines and musical traditions remain influential, with qawwali singing well known. Literature, poetry, carpets and metalwork continue regional crafts, and cricket is the most followed sport.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1947年独立、1956年成为共和国、1965与1971年印巴战争、1973年宪法、1998年核试验、1999年军事政变，以及2008年恢复民选政府与之后的政权轮替。
events.en: Key moments include independence in 1947, the republic of 1956, the wars with India in 1965 and 1971, the constitution of 1973, the nuclear tests of 1998, the military takeover of 1999, and the return of elected government in 2008 with alternation since.

value.zh: 1947年8月14日巴基斯坦独立，1956年成为伊斯兰共和国。
value.en: Pakistan became independent on 14 August 1947 and an Islamic republic in 1956.

value.zh: 1971年战争后东巴基斯坦独立为孟加拉国。
value.en: After the 1971 war East Pakistan became the independent state of Bangladesh.

value.zh: 1998年巴基斯坦进行核试验，成为公开的核武器国家。
value.en: Pakistan conducted nuclear tests in 1998 and became a declared nuclear-weapon state.

sources.title: Indus Valley Civilisation
supports: A Bronze Age civilisation of the north-west of South Asia, 3300-1300 BCE
The mature phase of 2600-1900 BCE and cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro
Urban planning, drainage and standardised weights
Trade with Mesopotamia and the undeciphered script

sources.title: 印度河流域文明
supports: 南亚西北部的青铜时代文明，约前3300—前1300年
前2600—前1900年的成熟期与哈拉帕、摩亨佐达罗等城市
城市规化、排水系统与统一度量衡
与美索不达米亚的贸易与未释读的文字

politics.zh: 印度河流域文明存在于约公元前3300至前1300年，成熟期为前2600至前1900年，分布范围覆盖今巴基斯坦大部、印度西北部与阿富汗东北部。哈拉帕与摩亨佐达罗等城市有规划整齐的街区、排水系统与大型公共建筑，但未见明确的王陵或宫殿，政治组织可能由城市机构或地方精英共同管理，尚无定论。
politics.en: The Indus Valley Civilisation existed from about 3300 to 1300 BCE, with its mature phase from 2600 to 1900 BCE, across much of present Pakistan, north-western India and north-eastern Afghanistan. Cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had planned streets, drainage systems and large public buildings, but no clear royal tombs or palaces have been found, so whether power lay with city institutions or local elites remains undetermined.

economy.zh: 经济以印度河冲积平原的农业为基础，种植小麦、大麦、豆类与棉花，并饲养牛、羊和水牛。城市手工业包括制陶、珠饰、贝壳与金属加工，标准化砝码用于贸易。与美索不达米亚的商路经波斯湾与陆路连接，出口棉布、珠饰与木材，进口铜、锡与宝石。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming the Indus alluvial plain, growing wheat, barley, pulses and cotton and herding cattle, sheep and water buffalo. Urban crafts included pottery, beads, shell and metal working, and standardised weights served trade. Routes to Mesopotamia ran through the Persian Gulf and overland, exporting cotton cloth, beads and timber and importing copper, tin and gemstones.

culture.zh: 哈拉帕文明留下印章、陶器、雕像与大型浴池等遗存，印章上的符号文字至今未释读，语言归属不明。宗教图像中可见对动物、树木与可能的女神形象的崇拜，沐浴与洁净设施显示仪式活动的重要性。城市规划与度量衡的高度一致性表明广泛共享的制度与观念。
culture.en: The civilisation left seals, pottery, figurines and large bathing structures. Its sign script remains undeciphered and its language unknown. Religious imagery includes animals, trees and possible goddess figures, and bathing and sanitation facilities point to the importance of ritual purity. The strong uniformity of town planning and weights suggests widely shared institutions and ideas.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约前3300年早期哈拉帕阶段、前2600年前后进入成熟期与大城市兴起、前1900年前后城市体系解体、前1300年前后文明终结，以及20世纪20年代哈拉帕与摩亨佐达罗的考古发现。
events.en: Key moments include the early Harappan phase from about 3300 BCE, the mature phase and rise of large cities around 2600 BCE, the break-up of the urban system around 1900 BCE, the end of the civilisation around 1300 BCE, and the archaeological discovery of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro in the 1920s.

value.zh: 印度河流域文明的成熟期为前2600至前1900年，哈拉帕与摩亨佐达罗是主要城市。
value.en: The mature phase ran from 2600 to 1900 BCE, with Harappa and Mohenjo-daro as its principal cities.

value.zh: 出土印章上的符号文字至今未被释读，语言归属不明。
value.en: The sign script on excavated seals remains undeciphered and its language is unknown.

value.zh: 约前1900年前后城市体系解体，气候变化与河流改道是主要解释之一。
value.en: The urban system broke up around 1900 BCE, with climate change and river shifts among the main explanations.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 8 条记录，年份范围为公元前3000 年至公元前1701 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录覆盖约前3000至前1701年（8 条）；成熟期与晚期的年代以所列条目为准。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 8 territory records for this polity, covering 3000 BCE to 1701 BCE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover about 3000 to 1701 BCE (eight records); the mature and late phases follow the cited articles.

sources.title: Anuradhapura
supports: Anuradhapura as the ancient capital of Sri Lanka
The introduction of Buddhism in the third century BCE
Irrigation reservoirs and the great stupas
The Chola conquest and the shift of the capital to Polonnaruwa

sources.title: 阿努拉德普勒
supports: 阿努拉德普勒是斯里兰卡古都
公元前3世纪佛教传入
灌溉水库与大型佛塔
朱罗征服与迁都波隆纳鲁沃

politics.zh: 阿努拉德普勒是斯里兰卡的古都，僧伽罗王国自约公元前4世纪起以此为中心，公元前3世纪佛教传入后王权与僧团关系密切。国王主持修渠建塔，维贾亚巴胡一世等君主在10世纪抵御朱罗入侵。1017年朱罗军队攻占阿努拉德普勒，王国重心迁往波隆纳鲁沃，古都逐渐荒废。
politics.en: Anuradhapura was the ancient capital of Sri Lanka and the centre of the Sinhalese kingdom from about the fourth century BCE. After Buddhism arrived in the third century BCE the monarchy and the monastic order were closely linked, kings sponsored reservoirs and stupas, and rulers such as Vijayabahu I resisted Chola invasions in the tenth century. In 1017 a Chola army took Anuradhapura and the kingdom's centre moved to Polonnaruwa, leaving the old capital to decline.

economy.zh: 经济以水稻种植为核心，国王与寺院修建水库和渠道，形成复杂的灌溉系统，支撑人口与城市。宝石、珍珠、象牙与香料是重要出口品，与南印度、罗马世界和东南亚有海上贸易联系。寺院拥有土地和劳动力，参与农业与手工业的组织，城市手工业包括金属、石雕与陶器。
economy.en: Rice cultivation was central, and kings and monasteries built reservoirs and canals that formed an elaborate irrigation system supporting population and cities. Gems, pearls, ivory and spices were important exports, and maritime trade linked the island with South India, the Roman world and Southeast Asia. Monasteries held land and labour and helped organise agriculture and crafts, while urban workshops worked metal, stone and pottery.

culture.zh: 佛教是文化核心，摩诃毗诃罗等寺院成为学术中心，巴利文三藏与注疏在此传承。鲁万维利萨亚等大型佛塔与石刻佛像代表建筑与雕塑成就，阿努拉德普勒的圣菩提树至今受朝拜。僧伽罗语文献与编年史《大史》记录了王朝与宗教历史。印度教与本地信仰在多元社会中并存。
culture.en: Buddhism was the core of cultural life: monasteries such as the Mahavihara became centres of learning where the Pali canon and commentaries were transmitted. Great stupas such as Ruwanwelisaya and rock-cut Buddha images represent its architecture and sculpture, and the sacred bodhi tree at Anuradhapura is still venerated. Sinhala texts and the Mahavamsa chronicle record dynastic and religious history, while Hindu and local beliefs coexisted in a plural society.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前4世纪建都、前3世纪佛教传入、前2世纪杜图盖穆努统一与建塔、5世纪佛音长老整理三藏注疏、10世纪抵御朱罗入侵，以及1017年朱罗攻占阿努拉德普勒、迁都波隆纳鲁沃。
events.en: Key moments include the founding of the capital around the fourth century BCE, the arrival of Buddhism in the third century BCE, the unification and stupa building of Dutugemunu in the second century BCE, the compilation of commentaries by Buddhaghosa in the fifth century CE, resistance to Chola invasions in the tenth century, and the Chola capture of Anuradhapura in 1017 that moved the capital to Polonnaruwa.

value.zh: 公元前3世纪佛教传入斯里兰卡，阿努拉德普勒的大寺成为重要学术中心。
value.en: Buddhism reached Sri Lanka in the third century BCE and the Mahavihara at Anuradhapura became a major centre of learning.

value.zh: 王国修建水库与渠道，形成支撑水稻农业的灌溉体系。
value.en: The kingdom built reservoirs and canals that formed an irrigation system supporting rice agriculture.

value.zh: 1017年朱罗军队攻占阿努拉德普勒，王国重心迁往波隆纳鲁沃。
value.en: A Chola army captured Anuradhapura in 1017 and the kingdom's centre shifted to Polonnaruwa.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元前291 年至公元1017 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖前291—1017年（5 条），以阿努拉德普勒为都的僧伽罗王国时期为叙述范围。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (291 BCE to 1017 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover 291 BCE to 1017 CE (five records); the entry covers the Sinhalese kingdom ruled from Anuradhapura.

sources.title: Kashmir
supports: The Kashmir valley as a political centre in the early medieval period
The Karkota dynasty and Lalitaditya's campaigns
Buddhism and Kashmir Shaivism in the valley
The end of Hindu rule and the establishment of the Shah Mir sultanate in 1339

sources.title: 克什米尔
supports: 中世纪早期以克什米尔谷地为中心的政治体
卡尔科塔王朝与拉利塔迪蒂亚的征战
谷地的佛教与克什米尔湿婆教
印度教统治的结束与1339年沙阿米尔苏丹国

politics.zh: 克什米尔谷地在7至14世纪是南亚西北部的政治与文化中心。卡尔科塔王朝的拉利塔迪蒂亚（约724—760在位）向外扩张至旁遮普与中亚方向，此后乌特帕拉等王朝更替。1339年沙阿·米尔建立穆斯林苏丹国，结束印度教王朝的统治。19世纪以后该地区的政治归属变化不在本条范围内。
politics.en: The Kashmir valley was a political and cultural centre in the north-west of South Asia between the seventh and fourteenth centuries. Lalitaditya of the Karkota dynasty (ruled about 724-760) campaigned towards the Punjab and Central Asia, and later dynasties such as the Utpalas followed. In 1339 Shah Mir founded a Muslim sultanate, ending Hindu dynastic rule. Political changes after the nineteenth century lie outside this entry.

economy.zh: 谷地经济以水稻、藏红花、苹果与畜牧业为主，依靠河流灌溉和山地牧场。克什米尔处于印度、中亚与西藏之间的商路要冲，输出披肩、藏红花与手工业品，输入盐、茶与纺织品。手工业中的羊毛织物与木雕长期享有声誉，城市与寺院经济相互支撑。
economy.en: The valley economy centred on rice, saffron, apples and livestock, using river irrigation and mountain pastures. Kashmir lay on routes between India, Central Asia and Tibet, exporting shawls, saffron and crafts and importing salt, tea and textiles. Wool weaving and wood carving earned a long reputation, and town and monastery economies supported each other.

culture.zh: 佛教在早期占重要地位，寺院与佛塔遍布谷地，8世纪后印度教与湿婆教兴盛，克什米尔湿婆教形成系统的哲学与文献传统。梵语学术、历史编纂与建筑在宫廷赞助下发展，《王河》等史书记录王朝谱系。伊斯兰教传入后波斯语与苏非传统逐渐融入，形成多层次的文化面貌。
culture.en: Buddhism was prominent early on, with monasteries and stupas across the valley, while Hinduism and Shaivism flourished after the eighth century and Kashmir Shaivism produced a systematic philosophical and textual tradition. Sanskrit scholarship, historiography and architecture developed under court patronage, and chronicles such as the Rajatarangini record dynastic lines. After Islam arrived, Persian and Sufi traditions were gradually absorbed, producing a layered culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪卡尔科塔王朝兴起、8世纪拉利塔迪蒂亚的扩张、9至10世纪乌特帕拉等王朝更替、11至12世纪湿婆教与梵语文学的兴盛，以及1339年沙阿·米尔建立苏丹国。
events.en: Key moments include the rise of the Karkota dynasty in the seventh century, Lalitaditya's campaigns in the eighth, the succession of dynasties such as the Utpalas in the ninth and tenth centuries, the flourishing of Shaivism and Sanskrit letters in the eleventh and twelfth, and the foundation of the sultanate by Shah Mir in 1339.

value.zh: 8世纪卡尔科塔王朝的拉利塔迪蒂亚向外扩张，克什米尔一度成为地区强权。
value.en: In the eighth century Lalitaditya of the Karkota dynasty expanded outward and Kashmir briefly became a regional power.

value.zh: 克什米尔湿婆教在9至12世纪形成系统的哲学与文献传统。
value.en: Kashmir Shaivism developed a systematic philosophical and textual tradition between the ninth and twelfth centuries.

value.zh: 1339年沙阿·米尔建立穆斯林苏丹国，印度教王朝统治结束。
value.en: Shah Mir founded a Muslim sultanate in 1339, ending Hindu dynastic rule.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 29 条记录，年份范围为公元626 年至公元1343 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录覆盖626—1343年（29 条），叙述限于以克什米尔谷地为中心的历史政体；19世纪以后的政治归属不在本条范围内。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 29 territory records for this polity, covering 626 CE to 1343 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover 626-1343 (29 records); the entry is limited to the historical polities centred on the Kashmir valley and does not cover the post-nineteenth-century dispute.

title.zh: 瞿折罗-普腊蒂哈腊王朝

sources.title: Pratihara dynasty
supports: The Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty and its capital at Kannauj
The tripartite struggle for northern India
Containment of Arab armies east of the Indus
Temple architecture and the dynasty's decline in the tenth century

sources.title: 瞿折罗-普腊蒂哈腊王朝
supports: 瞿折罗-普腊蒂哈腊王朝与曲女城都城
争夺北印度的三国角力
在印度河以东遏制阿拉伯军队
寺庙建筑与10世纪的衰落

politics.zh: 瞿折罗-普腊蒂哈腊王朝由瞿折罗族建立，8世纪起统治印度西北部，816年前后在三方角力中夺取曲女城，成为北印度主要政权。纳伽巴塔一世与二世、米希拉·波阇等君主抵御阿拉伯军队并向东扩张。10世纪后地方势力与拉施特拉库塔、帕拉等竞争加剧，王朝在11世纪初瓦解。
politics.en: The Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty was founded by the Gurjara people and ruled north-western India from the eighth century. It secured Kannauj in the tripartite struggle around 816 and became the leading power in northern India. Rulers such as Nagabhata I and II and Mihira Bhoja resisted Arab armies and expanded eastwards. In the tenth century competition with local powers, the Rashtrakutas and the Palas intensified, and the dynasty broke up in the early eleventh century.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河与亚穆纳河平原的农业为基础，小麦、水稻与豆类是主要作物，灌溉依靠河流与蓄水设施。王朝控制印度河与恒河之间的商路，连接中亚、西北印度与孟加拉湾贸易，城市手工业包括纺织、金属与石雕。寺庙与城市市场是交换的重要场所。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming the Ganges and Yamuna plains, with wheat, rice and pulses as major crops and irrigation from rivers and reservoirs. The dynasty controlled routes between the Indus and the Ganges, linking Central Asia, north-western India and Bay of Bengal trade, and urban crafts included textiles, metalwork and stone carving. Temples and town markets were important places of exchange.

culture.zh: 王朝赞助印度教寺庙与雕塑，奥西安等地神庙、雕刻面板与开放式亭阁式建筑体现其风格。梵语文学与碑铭记录王室谱系与赠地，宫廷吸纳来自各地的学者与工匠。这一时期北印度的宗教生活以印度教为主，佛教与耆那教社群同时存在。
culture.en: The dynasty patronised Hindu temples and sculpture, and the temples, carved panels and open pavilion forms at places such as Osian express its style. Sanskrit literature and inscriptions record royal genealogies and land grants, and the court attracted scholars and craftsmen from many regions. Religious life in northern India was mainly Hindu, with Buddhist and Jain communities also present.

events.zh: 关键节点包括8世纪王朝兴起、约816年夺取曲女城、9世纪米希拉·波阇时期的强盛、10世纪与拉施特拉库塔和帕拉的竞争，以及11世纪初王朝解体。
events.en: Key moments include the dynasty's rise in the eighth century, the seizure of Kannauj around 816, its strength under Mihira Bhoja in the ninth century, competition with the Rashtrakutas and Palas in the tenth, and its break-up in the early eleventh century.

value.zh: 约816年瞿折罗-普腊蒂哈腊王朝在三方角力中夺取曲女城，成为北印度主要政权。
value.en: Around 816 the Gurjara-Pratiharas secured Kannauj in the tripartite struggle and became the leading power in northern India.

value.zh: 纳伽巴塔一世等君主在印度河以东抵御阿拉伯军队的推进。
value.en: Rulers such as Nagabhata I checked the advance of Arab armies east of the Indus.

value.zh: 王朝赞助印度教寺庙与雕刻，奥西安等地建筑体现其风格。
value.en: The dynasty patronised Hindu temples and sculpture, with buildings at Osian expressing its style.
