sources.title: Ghaznavid Empire
supports: The Turkic dynasty founded by Sabuktigin at Ghazna in 977
Mahmud of Ghazni's campaigns into India and the raid on Somnath
A Persianate court and the spread of Persian letters
Loss of the western lands and the end under the Ghurids in 1186

sources.title: 加兹尼王朝
supports: 977年苏布克特勤在加兹尼建立的突厥王朝
马哈茂德对印度的征战与索姆纳特之役
波斯化宫廷与波斯文学的传播
西部领土的丧失与1186年被古尔王朝取代

politics.zh: 加兹尼王朝由萨曼王朝将领阿尔普特勤奠基，其婿苏布克特勤于977年在加兹尼建立政权，马哈茂德在位时（998—1030）自称苏丹，向外扩张至阿姆河、印度河与波斯西部，并多次攻入印度。马苏德一世时期西部领土丧失，王朝退守阿富汗与旁遮普，1186年被古尔王朝灭亡。
politics.en: The Ghaznavid state was founded by Alp Tigin, a former Samanid general, and established at Ghazna by his son-in-law Sabuktigin in 977. Under Mahmud (ruled 998-1030) the dynasty took the title of sultan and expanded to the Amu Darya, the Indus and western Persia, raiding deep into India. Under Mas'ud I the western lands were lost and the dynasty withdrew to Afghanistan and the Punjab before the Ghurids ended it in 1186.

economy.zh: 王朝财政依靠农业税收、过境贸易与对印度的战利品，加兹尼与拉合尔成为行政与商业中心。中亚与印度之间的商路带来布匹、香料、宝石与马匹，城市手工业与铸币业发展。宫廷以白银和黄金铸币支付军队与官僚，赏赐与建筑开支消耗大量资源。
economy.en: Revenue came from agrarian taxes, transit trade and the booty of Indian campaigns, with Ghazni and Lahore as administrative and commercial centres. Routes between Central Asia and India carried cloth, spices, gems and horses, and urban crafts and minting developed. The court paid its army and officials in silver and gold coin, while patronage and building consumed large resources.

culture.zh: 加兹尼宫廷以波斯语为文化语言，聚集菲尔多西、比鲁尼等学者与诗人，波斯文学与史学在此发展。建筑、园林与图书馆体现宫廷赞助，伊斯兰学术与自然科学在天文、地理领域有成果。马哈茂德时期中亚与南亚之间的文化交流加快，波斯化传统对后来的印度王朝影响深远。
culture.en: The Ghaznavid court used Persian as its cultural language and gathered scholars and poets including Ferdowsi and al-Biruni, so Persian literature and historiography developed there. Architecture, gardens and libraries reflect court patronage, and Islamic scholarship produced work in astronomy and geography. Cultural exchange between Central Asia and South Asia accelerated under Mahmud, and the Persianate tradition shaped later Indian dynasties.

events.zh: 关键节点包括977年苏布克特勤在加兹尼建国、998年马哈茂德继位并多次远征印度、1025年攻掠索姆纳特神庙、1030年后西部领土丧失，以及1186年古尔王朝攻占拉合尔、王朝终结。
events.en: Key moments include the founding at Ghazna in 977, Mahmud's accession in 998 and his repeated campaigns into India, the raid on the Somnath temple in 1025, the loss of the western lands after 1030, and the Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 that ended the dynasty.

value.zh: 977年苏布克特勤在加兹尼建立政权，其子马哈茂德自称苏丹并大举扩张。
value.en: Sabuktigin established the state at Ghazna in 977, and his son Mahmud took the title of sultan and expanded it widely.

value.zh: 1025年马哈茂德攻掠古吉拉特的索姆纳特神庙，是其印度远征中最著名的一次。
value.en: Mahmud's raid on the Somnath temple in Gujarat in 1025 was the most famous of his Indian campaigns.

value.zh: 1186年古尔王朝攻占拉合尔，加兹尼王朝灭亡。
value.en: The Ghurids captured Lahore in 1186, ending the Ghaznavid dynasty.

sources.title: Pandya dynasty
supports: The Pandyas as one of the long-lived Tamil kingdoms of South India
Their two imperial periods, the sixth to tenth and thirteenth to fourteenth centuries
Madurai as their centre and rivalry with the Cholas
Trade, temple patronage and the fourteenth-century invasions

sources.title: 潘地亚
supports: 潘地亚是南印度长期存在的泰米尔人国家
以马杜赖为中心并长期与朱罗竞争

politics.zh: 潘地亚王朝是南印度古老的泰米尔政权，以马杜赖为中心，与朱罗、哲罗和帕拉瓦并列为泰米尔地区主要王国。6至10世纪和13至14世纪是其两个强势期，13世纪下半叶的贾塔瓦尔曼·孙达拉·潘地亚一世与马拉瓦尔曼·库拉塞卡拉一世一度控制南印度大部与斯里兰卡北部。14世纪初德里军队入侵后，马杜赖建立苏丹国，潘地亚势力衰落。
politics.en: The Pandya dynasty was an ancient Tamil power centred on Madurai and one of the main kingdoms of the Tamil country alongside the Cholas, Cheras and Pallavas. It had two periods of imperial dominance, in the sixth to tenth centuries and again in the thirteenth and fourteenth, when Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan I and Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I controlled much of South India and northern Sri Lanka. After Delhi's armies invaded in the early fourteenth century and a sultanate was set up at Madurai, Pandya power declined.

economy.zh: 经济以卡韦里河与韦盖河平原的水稻种植为基础，并依靠珍珠、渔业与盐业。潘地亚港口连接印度洋贸易，输出珍珠、象牙、香料与棉布，输入马匹与金属。神庙与城市市场是交换中心，铭文记录了大量土地赠与和商贸行会的活动。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Kaveri and Vaigai plains together with pearls, fisheries and salt. Pandya ports connected Indian Ocean trade, exporting pearls, ivory, spices and cotton cloth and importing horses and metals. Temples and town markets were centres of exchange, and inscriptions record numerous land grants and merchant guild activity.

culture.zh: 王朝赞助印度教寺庙与泰米尔文学，马杜赖的寺庙建筑与雕塑在13世纪达到高峰。泰米尔语诗歌与铭文构成重要文献，湿婆教与毗湿奴教在各地流行。潘地亚宫廷也是南印度音乐、舞蹈与学术的资助者，与斯里兰卡和东南亚有文化往来。
culture.en: The dynasty patronised Hindu temples and Tamil literature, and temple architecture and sculpture at Madurai peaked in the thirteenth century. Tamil poetry and inscriptions form major sources, and Shaiva and Vaishnava worship flourished across the region. The Pandya court also supported music, dance and scholarship and maintained cultural links with Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6至10世纪的第一次强势期、10至11世纪与朱罗的长期战争、13世纪下半叶的第二次扩张、1311年前后德里军队洗劫马杜赖，以及14世纪马杜赖苏丹国的建立。
events.en: Key moments include the first imperial period in the sixth to tenth centuries, the long wars with the Cholas in the tenth and eleventh, the second expansion in the later thirteenth century, the sack of Madurai by Delhi's armies around 1311, and the establishment of the Madurai Sultanate in the fourteenth century.

value.zh: 潘地亚王朝以马杜赖为中心，是泰米尔地区最古老的政权之一。
value.en: The Pandyas were centred on Madurai and were among the oldest powers of the Tamil country.

value.zh: 潘地亚港口参与印度洋贸易，输出珍珠、象牙与香料。
value.en: Pandya ports took part in Indian Ocean trade, exporting pearls, ivory and spices.

value.zh: 14世纪初德里军队入侵南印度，马杜赖随后建立苏丹国。
value.en: Delhi's armies invaded South India in the early fourteenth century and a sultanate was later set up at Madurai.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 9 条记录，年份范围为公元592 年至公元1325 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 中文维基条目仅有一句概述，政体细节主要依据英文条目；本站疆域记录覆盖592—1325年。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 9 territory records for this polity, covering 592 CE to 1325 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The Chinese article is a one-line summary, so the political detail rests mainly on the English article; the territory records cover 592-1325.

sources.title: Kingdom of Mysore
supports: The Wadiyar dynasty and Mysore's rise after the decline of Vijayanagara
Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan in the later eighteenth century
The four Anglo-Mysore wars and the fall of Srirangapatna in 1799
Revenue, military reform and the Mysore rockets

sources.title: 迈索尔王国
supports: 瓦迪亚王朝与维查耶那伽罗衰落后的迈索尔
18世纪后期的海德尔·阿里与提普苏丹
四次英迈战争与1799年斯里兰加帕塔姆陷落
税收、军事改革与迈索尔火箭

politics.zh: 迈索尔王国约1399年由瓦迪亚家族建立，早期是维查耶那伽罗的附庸，1565年维查耶那伽罗衰落中获得独立并扩张。18世纪中叶海德尔·阿里掌权，其后提普苏丹继位，推行集权与军事改革。迈索尔与英国东印度公司进行四次战争，1799年斯里兰加帕塔姆陷落、提普阵亡，瓦迪亚家族在英国保护下复位。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Mysore was founded by the Wadiyar family around 1399 as a vassal of Vijayanagara, became independent as that empire declined after 1565 and expanded. In the mid-eighteenth century Hyder Ali took power and was succeeded by Tipu Sultan, who centralised administration and reformed the army. Mysore fought four wars with the British East India Company, and after the fall of Srirangapatna in 1799 and Tipu's death the Wadiyars were restored under British protection.

economy.zh: 经济以卡纳塔克高原的农业为主，种植水稻、小米、甘蔗与棉花，并利用水库灌溉。国家征收货币与实物税，发展丝绸、檀香木与铁器生产，迈索尔成为南印度重要商业中心。海德尔与提普时期建立国营工场与贸易机构，军事工业包括铸造火炮与火箭。
economy.en: The economy centred on farming the Karnataka plateau, growing rice, millet, sugar cane and cotton with tank irrigation. The state levied taxes in cash and kind, and silk, sandalwood and iron production made Mysore an important commercial centre in South India. Under Hyder and Tipu state workshops and trading institutions were set up, and military industry included cannon and rocket manufacture.

culture.zh: 迈索尔宫廷以卡纳达语与梵语文化为特色，赞助寺庙、文学与音乐，迈索尔绘画与木雕形成地方风格。瓦迪亚王朝在1799年复位后继续支持艺术，克里希纳拉贾·沃德亚尔等君主以音乐与学术著称。印度教节庆如达萨拉节由宫廷主持，延续至今。
culture.en: The Mysore court cultivated Kannada and Sanskrit letters and patronised temples, literature and music, while Mysore painting and wood carving developed local styles. After their restoration in 1799 the Wadiyars continued to support the arts, and rulers such as Krishnaraja Wodeyar became known for music and scholarship. Hindu festivals such as Dasara were celebrated by the court and continue today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约1399年建国、1565年后独立扩张、1761年海德尔·阿里掌权、1782年提普苏丹继位、四次英迈战争，以及1799年斯里兰加帕塔姆陷落与提普阵亡。
events.en: Key moments include the founding around 1399, independence and expansion after 1565, Hyder Ali's rise in 1761, Tipu Sultan's accession in 1782, the four Anglo-Mysore wars, and the fall of Srirangapatna and Tipu's death in 1799.

value.zh: 海德尔·阿里在18世纪中叶掌权，建立中央集权与近代化军队。
value.en: Hyder Ali took power in the mid-eighteenth century and built a centralised state with a modernised army.

value.zh: 提普苏丹1782年继位，继续推行军事与行政改革，并发展火箭武器。
value.en: Tipu Sultan succeeded in 1782, continued military and administrative reform and developed rocket weapons.

value.zh: 1799年第四次英迈战争以斯里兰加帕塔姆陷落、提普阵亡告终。
value.en: The Fourth Anglo-Mysore War ended in 1799 with the fall of Srirangapatna and Tipu's death.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元1572 年至公元1799 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖1572—1799年（5 条），未覆盖1399年建国与1799年后的土邦时期；本条以16至18世纪的迈索尔王国为范围。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (1572 CE to 1799 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover 1572-1799 (five records) and do not cover the founding in 1399 or the later princely state; this entry covers the kingdom of the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries.

sources.title: Nepal
supports: The Gorkha conquest and the unification of Nepal in the later eighteenth century
The 1814-1816 Anglo-Nepalese war and the Sugauli treaty
Rana rule, the 1951 change and the panchayat system
The 1990 constitution, the Maoist insurgency and the republic of 2008

sources.title: 尼泊尔
supports: 18世纪后期廓尔喀征服与尼泊尔统一
1814—1816年英尼战争与苏高利条约
拉纳家族统治、1951年变革与潘查亚特体制
1990年宪法、毛派武装斗争与2008年共和国

politics.zh: 尼泊尔在18世纪后期由廓尔喀王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿统一，建立沙阿王朝。1814至1816年英尼战争后签订苏高利条约，失去部分领土；1846年拉纳家族掌权，国王成为名义元首。1951年拉纳统治结束，1960年实行潘查亚特体制，1990年恢复君主立宪与多党制。1996年起毛派发动武装斗争，2006年结束，2008年制宪会议废除君主制，成立联邦民主共和国，2015年颁布联邦宪法。
politics.en: Nepal was unified in the later eighteenth century by Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha, founding the Shah dynasty. After the Anglo-Nepalese war of 1814-1816 the Sugauli treaty cost it territory, and in 1846 the Rana family took power while the king reigned in name only. Rana rule ended in 1951, a panchayat system was imposed in 1960, and constitutional monarchy with multi-party politics returned in 1990. A Maoist insurgency ran from 1996 to 2006, and in 2008 a constituent assembly abolished the monarchy and created a federal democratic republic, with a federal constitution in 2015.

economy.zh: 经济以农业为主，水稻、玉米、小麦与山地畜牧支撑多数人口，旅游业和海外劳工汇款是重要外汇来源。水力资源丰富但开发有限，工业以纺织、食品加工与水泥为主。加德满都谷地集中行政与服务业，山区交通与就业机会不足，发展依赖印度与中国市场。
economy.en: Agriculture dominates, with rice, maize, wheat and mountain herding supporting most people, while tourism and remittances from workers abroad are key sources of foreign currency. Hydropower potential is large but underdeveloped, and industry centres on textiles, food processing and cement. The Kathmandu valley concentrates administration and services, mountain areas lack transport and jobs, and development depends on the Indian and Chinese markets.

culture.zh: 尼泊尔以印度教与佛教传统并存为特色，加德满都谷地的寺庙、佛塔与宫殿列入世界遗产，蓝毗尼被视为佛陀诞生地。尼瓦尔、塔芒、马嘉、古隆等族群各有语言与节庆，达善节与灯节广泛庆祝。音乐、舞蹈与手工金属、木雕工艺延续传统，登山文化与喜马拉雅山景观构成国家形象的重要部分。
culture.en: Nepal is marked by the coexistence of Hindu and Buddhist traditions; the temples, stupas and palaces of the Kathmandu valley are World Heritage sites and Lumbini is regarded as the Buddha's birthplace. Newar, Tamang, Magar, Gurung and other communities keep their own languages and festivals, and Dashain and Tihar are widely celebrated. Music, dance, metalwork and wood carving continue older crafts, and mountaineering and the Himalayan landscape form part of the national image.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1768年前后完成统一、1814—1816年英尼战争与苏高利条约、1846年拉纳家族执政、1951年结束拉纳统治、1960年潘查亚特体制、1990年恢复多党制、1996—2006年毛派武装斗争，以及2008年废除君主制成立共和国。
events.en: Key moments include unification around 1768, the Anglo-Nepalese war and Sugauli treaty of 1814-1816, the Rana takeover of 1846, the end of Rana rule in 1951, the panchayat system of 1960, the return of multi-party politics in 1990, the Maoist insurgency of 1996-2006, and the abolition of the monarchy and creation of a republic in 2008.

value.zh: 18世纪后期普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿以廓尔喀为中心统一尼泊尔。
value.en: Prithvi Narayan Shah unified Nepal from Gorkha in the later eighteenth century.

value.zh: 1816年苏高利条约结束了英尼战争，尼泊尔失去部分领土。
value.en: The Sugauli treaty of 1816 ended the Anglo-Nepalese war and cost Nepal territory.

value.zh: 2008年制宪会议废除君主制，尼泊尔成为联邦民主共和国。
value.en: In 2008 the constituent assembly abolished the monarchy and Nepal became a federal democratic republic.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 19 条记录，年份范围为公元1775 年至公元2024 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录自1775年起；1768年前后的廓尔喀统一作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 19 territory records for this polity, covering 1775 CE to 2024 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records begin in 1775; the Gorkha unification around 1768 appears as background.

sources.title: Champa
supports: Cham polities along the coast of central and southern Vietnam from the second century CE
Indianised religion, Sanskrit inscriptions and brick temple complexes
The Vijaya period and conflicts with Vietnamese kingdoms
Gradual Vietnamese expansion and the annexation of the last principality

sources.title: 占城
supports: 公元2世纪起在今越南中南部沿海的占人政权
印度化宗教、梵文碑铭与砖塔建筑
毗阇耶时期与越南诸朝的冲突
越南南进与最后公国的兼并

politics.zh: 占城是公元2世纪起在越南中南部沿海形成的占人政权集合，中国史书先后称其为林邑、环王与占城。各邦以港口与河谷为中心，常由不同家族或地区势力分别统治，并非始终统一。9至15世纪以毗阇耶为中心的时期较为强盛，与越南李朝、陈朝和后黎朝长期交战。1471年越南攻陷毗阇耶，占城分裂，最后的公国于1832年被阮朝兼并。
politics.en: Champa was a collection of Cham polities along the coast of central and southern Vietnam from the second century CE, called Linyi, Huanwang and Champa in Chinese records. Each centred on a port and river valley and was often ruled separately, so the country was not always unified. The period centred on Vijaya from the ninth to fifteenth centuries was stronger, with long wars against the Ly, Tran and Later Le dynasties of Vietnam. Vietnamese forces took Vijaya in 1471 and Champa fragmented; the last principality was annexed by the Nguyen dynasty in 1832.

economy.zh: 经济依靠沿海港口与内河农业，水稻、槟榔、沉香与象牙是重要物产。占城位于南海贸易要道，与中国、爪哇、印度和后来的马来港口往来频繁，输出香料、木材与林产品，输入瓷器、丝绸与金属。港口城市与内陆山地之间通过河流与集市连接，海上贸易是政治权力的重要基础。
economy.en: The economy combined coastal ports with riverine agriculture, producing rice, areca, agarwood and ivory. Champa lay on the South China Sea trading routes and dealt with China, Java, India and later Malay ports, exporting aromatics, timber and forest products and importing ceramics, silk and metals. Port cities were linked to the inland hills by rivers and markets, and maritime trade underpinned political power.

culture.zh: 占人文化深受印度影响，湿婆教与佛教并存，梵文碑铭记录王室与宗教事务。砖塔寺庙群如美山与同阳体现独特的占婆建筑，占婆文字用于本地语言书写。音乐、舞蹈与水上仪式延续至今，越南中部的占族社群仍保持自己的语言与宗教传统。
culture.en: Cham culture was strongly Indianised, with Shaivism and Buddhism coexisting and Sanskrit inscriptions recording royal and religious affairs. Brick temple complexes such as My Son and Dong Duong express a distinctive Cham architecture, and Cham script was used for the local language. Music, dance and water rituals continue, and Cham communities in central Vietnam still keep their language and religious traditions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元2至3世纪政权形成、4至8世纪印度化与寺庙建设、9世纪起以毗阇耶为中心、1471年越南攻陷毗阇耶、17世纪起逐步被阮氏控制，以及1832年最后公国被兼并。
events.en: Key moments include the formation of polities in the second and third centuries, Indianisation and temple building from the fourth to eighth, the rise of Vijaya as the centre from the ninth, the Vietnamese capture of Vijaya in 1471, gradual Nguyen control from the seventeenth century, and the annexation of the last principality in 1832.

value.zh: 占城各民族政权自公元2世纪起在越南中南部沿海形成。
value.en: Cham polities formed along the coast of central and southern Vietnam from the second century CE.

value.zh: 1471年越南军队攻陷毗阇耶，占城此后分裂为多个小邦。
value.en: Vietnamese forces captured Vijaya in 1471, after which Champa fragmented into several principalities.

value.zh: 1832年最后一个占城公国被阮朝兼并。
value.en: The last Cham principality was annexed by the Nguyen dynasty in 1832.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 17 territory records for this polity, covering 207 CE to 1652 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Đại Việt
supports: Dai Viet as the official name of Vietnamese monarchies from the tenth to early nineteenth centuries
The Trinh and Nguyen lords and the divided country in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries
The Tay Son rebellion and the reunification under Gia Long
The change of the name to Vietnam in 1804

sources.title: 大越
supports: 大越是10世纪至19世纪初越南诸朝的国号
17至18世纪郑主与阮主的分立
西山起义与嘉隆的统一
1804年改国号为越南

politics.zh: 大越是越南自10世纪至19世纪初使用的国号，1054年李朝正式采用，历经陈朝与后黎朝。17至18世纪郑主控制北方宫廷、阮主统治南方，国家实际分裂。1771年西山起义爆发，先后推翻阮主与郑主并击败清军。1802年阮福映建立阮朝、统一全国，1804年改国号为越南。
politics.en: Dai Viet was the official name of Vietnamese monarchies from the tenth century to the early nineteenth. The Ly dynasty adopted it in 1054 and it continued under the Tran and Later Le. In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the Trinh lords controlled the northern court while the Nguyen lords ruled the south, dividing the country in practice. The Tay Son rebellion broke out in 1771, overthrew both houses and defeated a Qing army. In 1802 Nguyen Phuc Anh founded the Nguyen dynasty and reunified the country, changing the name to Vietnam in 1804.

economy.zh: 经济以红河与湄公河三角洲的水稻种植为基础，国家重视水利与粮仓。17至18世纪对外贸易扩大，会安与后来的河仙、西贡参与中国、日本与东南亚的商路，输出丝绸、陶瓷、糖与香料，输入白银、铜与武器。手工业与矿业在北方发展，货币与税收制度逐步制度化。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Red River and Mekong deltas, and the state invested in water control and granaries. Foreign trade expanded in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, with Hoi An and later Ha Tien and Saigon linked to Chinese, Japanese and Southeast Asian routes, exporting silk, ceramics, sugar and spices and importing silver, copper and weapons. Crafts and mining developed in the north, and coinage and taxation became more systematic.

culture.zh: 越南文化以汉字与后来的喃字为载体，儒学、佛教与道教并存，科举制度选拔官员。宫廷与民间共同维系祖先崇拜与村落节庆，陶瓷、漆器与纺织形成地方特色。18世纪文学与史学著述丰富，阮攸的《金云翘传》等作品成为越南文学的经典。
culture.en: Vietnamese culture used Chinese characters and later the demotic Nom script, with Confucianism, Buddhism and Daoism coexisting and examinations selecting officials. Court and village alike maintained ancestor worship and local festivals, and ceramics, lacquerware and textiles developed regional styles. Literature and historiography flourished in the eighteenth century, and works such as Nguyen Du's Tale of Kieu became classics of Vietnamese letters.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1054年李朝采用大越国号、17世纪郑阮对峙、1771年西山起义、1789年击败清军、1802年阮朝统一，以及1804年改国号为越南。
events.en: Key moments include the adoption of the name Dai Viet by the Ly in 1054, the Trinh-Nguyen standoff of the seventeenth century, the Tay Son rising of 1771, the defeat of the Qing army in 1789, the Nguyen reunification of 1802, and the change of the name to Vietnam in 1804.

value.zh: 大越是1054至1804年越南诸朝的国号，1804年改为越南。
value.en: Dai Viet was the official name of Vietnamese monarchies from 1054 to 1804, when it was changed to Vietnam.

value.zh: 1771年爆发的西山起义推翻阮主与郑主，并在1789年击败清军。
value.en: The Tay Son rebellion that began in 1771 overthrew the Nguyen and Trinh lords and defeated a Qing army in 1789.

value.zh: 1802年阮福映统一全国，建立阮朝。
value.en: Nguyen Phuc Anh reunified the country in 1802 and founded the Nguyen dynasty.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 7 条记录，年份范围为公元1683 年至公元1833 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 大越作为国号使用于1054—1804年，但本站疆域记录只覆盖1683—1833年；本条以后黎朝后期、郑阮对峙、西山起义与阮朝初年为叙述重点。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 7 territory records for this polity, covering 1683 CE to 1833 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. Dai Viet was the official name from 1054 to 1804, but the territory records cover only 1683-1833; the entry focuses on the late Le, the Trinh-Nguyen rivalry, the Tay Son rising and the early Nguyen dynasty.

sources.title: Chenla
supports: Chenla as the Chinese name for the pre-Angkorian period of Cambodian history
The late sixth to early ninth century and the inheritance from Funan
Ishanapura and the temple complex at Sambor Prei Kuk
Debate over whether Chenla was a unified kingdom or a loose group of polities

sources.title: 真腊
supports: 真腊是柬埔寨前吴哥时期的汉文名称
6世纪末至9世纪初，继承扶南
伊奢那城与三博波雷古寺庙群
真腊是统一王国还是松散政权的学术争论

politics.zh: 真腊是汉文文献对6世纪末至9世纪初柬埔寨地区的称呼，取代扶南并在此后让位于吴哥王朝。汉文记载称其为统一王国，但多数现代研究者认为真腊由若干松散小国或地方政权组成，王权随地区势力变化。伊奢那跋摩一世以伊奢那城（今三博波雷古）为中心扩张，8世纪出现陆真腊与水真腊之分。802年阇耶跋摩二世在库伦山自立，被视为吴哥时期的开端。
politics.en: Chenla is the Chinese name for the Cambodian region between the late sixth and early ninth centuries, succeeding Funan and preceding the Angkor empire. Chinese accounts describe a unified kingdom, but most modern historians regard Chenla as a loose group of small states or local powers whose rulers rose and fell. Ishanavarman I expanded from Ishanapura, today's Sambor Prei Kuk, and in the eighth century the terms Land Chenla and Water Chenla appear. In 802 Jayavarman II declared himself ruler on the Kulen mountain, which is taken as the start of the Angkor period.

economy.zh: 经济以湄公河与洞里萨湖平原的水稻种植为基础，并利用季节性的洪水与蓄水。真腊处于连接中国、印度与东南亚的海陆商路上，输出稻米、林产品、象牙与香料，输入瓷器、金属与纺织品。寺庙与地方首领掌握土地和劳动力，碑铭记录了土地赠与与免税安排。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Mekong and Tonle Sap plains, using seasonal floods and stored water. Chenla lay on land and sea routes linking China, India and Southeast Asia, exporting rice, forest products, ivory and aromatics and importing ceramics, metals and textiles. Temples and local chiefs controlled land and labour, and inscriptions record land grants and tax exemptions.

culture.zh: 真腊的宗教以印度教为主，湿婆与毗湿奴崇拜并存，佛教也有传播。三博波雷古的砖塔与雕刻体现前吴哥建筑风格，梵文与古高棉文碑铭记录王室与宗教活动。当地信仰与印度神祇结合，形成后来吴哥文化的宗教基础。
culture.en: Hinduism dominated, with Shaiva and Vaishnava worship alongside some Buddhism. The brick towers and sculpture of Sambor Prei Kuk express the pre-Angkorian style, and Sanskrit and Old Khmer inscriptions record royal and religious activity. Local beliefs merged with Indian deities and formed the religious base of the later Angkor culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6世纪末真腊取代扶南、7世纪伊奢那跋摩一世以伊奢那城为中心扩张、8世纪陆真腊与水真腊的分立，以及802年阇耶跋摩二世自立、吴哥时期开始。
events.en: Key moments include the replacement of Funan by Chenla at the end of the sixth century, the expansion of Ishanavarman I from Ishanapura in the seventh, the division into Land and Water Chenla in the eighth, and Jayavarman II's declaration of 802 that began the Angkor period.

value.zh: 真腊是汉文对柬埔寨前吴哥时期（约6世纪末至9世纪初）的称呼。
value.en: Chenla is the Chinese name for the pre-Angkorian period of Cambodian history, from the late sixth to the early ninth century.

value.zh: 伊奢那城（今三博波雷古）是真腊的重要中心，2017年列入世界遗产。
value.en: Ishanapura, today's Sambor Prei Kuk, was an important centre of Chenla and became a World Heritage site in 2017.

value.zh: 802年阇耶跋摩二世在库伦山自立，被视为吴哥时期的开端。
value.en: Jayavarman II's declaration on the Kulen mountain in 802 is taken as the beginning of the Angkor period.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 14 territory records for this polity, covering 555 CE to 805 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Funan
supports: Funan as a network of Indianised states in mainland Southeast Asia from the first to seventh centuries
Its centre in the Mekong delta and the port site of Oc Eo
Indian religion, Sanskrit and early state formation
Its replacement by Chenla and the scarcity of local written sources

sources.title: 扶南
supports: 1至7世纪中南半岛的印度化政权网络
以湄公河三角洲为中心与奥埃奥港口遗址
印度宗教、梵文与早期国家形成
被真腊取代与本地文献稀缺

politics.zh: 扶南是1至7世纪存在于中南半岛的印度化政权网络，中心位于湄公河三角洲一带，汉文文献称其为扶南，是东南亚最早为人所知的王国之一。其政治结构可能是若干中心共享王权的松散联合，王号与都城记载主要来自中国使节记录。6世纪后扶南逐渐被真腊取代，本地几乎没有留下自己的政权名称。
politics.en: Funan was a network of Indianised states in mainland Southeast Asia from the first to the seventh centuries, centred on the Mekong delta and known from Chinese records as one of the earliest kingdoms in the region. Its political structure was probably a loose union of centres sharing royal authority, and the names of kings and capitals come mainly from Chinese missions. After the sixth century Chenla replaced it, and almost no local record of its own name survives.

economy.zh: 经济依托湄公河三角洲的水稻种植、渔业与海上贸易，奥埃奥等港口遗址出土罗马、印度与中东风格的珠子、印章与器物，显示其连接印度洋与南海的贸易网络。国家通过港口征税与王室贸易获得收入，内陆产品包括稻米、林产与象牙，交换瓷器、金属与玻璃制品。
economy.en: The economy relied on rice farming, fishing and maritime trade in the Mekong delta. Port sites such as Oc Eo have yielded beads, seals and objects of Roman, Indian and Middle Eastern style, showing a network linking the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea. The state drew revenue from port taxes and royal trade, exchanging inland rice, forest produce and ivory for ceramics, metals and glass.

culture.zh: 扶南文化受印度深刻影响，湿婆与毗湿奴崇拜流行，梵文用于碑铭与王室称号。考古发现的雕像、金饰与建筑构件显示印度艺术与本地传统的结合。中国使者康泰、朱应的记载描述了宫廷仪式与文字使用，成为研究扶南的主要文献之一。
culture.en: Funan's culture was deeply Indianised, with Shaiva and Vaishnava worship and Sanskrit used in inscriptions and royal titles. Sculpture, gold ornaments and architectural pieces show Indian art combined with local traditions. The reports of the Chinese envoys Kang Tai and Zhu Ying describe court ritual and the use of writing and remain among the main sources for Funan.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1世纪政权形成、2至3世纪与中国和印度建立使节与贸易关系、4至5世纪印度化加深与港口繁荣、6世纪起被真腊取代，以及7世纪后不再见于汉文记载。
events.en: Key moments include the formation of the state in the first century, missions and trade with China and India in the second and third, deeper Indianisation and busy ports in the fourth and fifth, its replacement by Chenla from the sixth century, and its disappearance from Chinese records after the seventh.

value.zh: 奥埃奥等港口遗址出土印度、罗马与中东风格器物，显示扶南的海上贸易网络。
value.en: Port sites such as Oc Eo have yielded Indian, Roman and Middle Eastern objects, showing Funan's maritime trade network.

value.zh: 扶南的宗教、文字与王号受印度影响，湿婆与毗湿奴崇拜流行。
value.en: Funan's religion, writing and royal titles were Indianised, with Shaiva and Vaishnava worship widespread.

value.zh: 6世纪后扶南逐渐被真腊取代，其自身名称的本地记载几乎不存。
value.en: Chenla replaced Funan from the sixth century, and almost no local record of Funan's own name survives.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 4 条记录（公元51 年至公元640 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录仅4条（51—640年），覆盖很薄；扶南的年代与政治结构主要依据中国史书与考古研究，叙述以所列条目为准。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 4 territory records for this polity (51 CE to 640 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The atlas holds only four territory records for Funan (51-640), a thin coverage; its dates and political structure rest mainly on Chinese accounts and archaeology as given in the cited articles.

sources.title: Sunda Kingdom
supports: The Sunda Kingdom as a Hindu kingdom of western Java
Its shifting capitals between Galuh and Pakuan Pajajaran
Sri Baduga Maharaja and the kingdom at its height
Trade, pepper and the arrival of European powers

sources.title: 巽他王國
supports: 巽他王国是西爪哇的印度教王国
在加卢与巴库安帕查查兰之间迁都
斯里巴杜加·马哈拉查与王国鼎盛期
贸易、胡椒与欧洲势力到来

politics.zh: 巽他王国是西爪哇的印度教王国，约7世纪兴起，都城在加卢与巴库安帕查查兰之间迁移。斯里巴杜加·马哈拉查在位期间（1482—1521）国势鼎盛，与满者伯夷、马六甲及后来的葡萄牙人保持往来。1522年与葡萄牙签订协议试图借助外力对抗兴起的地方势力，但1527年巴库安被攻陷，王国衰落，1579年前后终结。
politics.en: The Sunda Kingdom was a Hindu kingdom of western Java that emerged around the seventh century, with its capital moving between Galuh and Pakuan Pajajaran. It reached its height under Sri Baduga Maharaja (ruled 1482-1521), who dealt with Majapahit, Malacca and later the Portuguese. In 1522 a treaty with Portugal sought outside support against rising local powers, but Pakuan fell in 1527, the kingdom declined and it ended around 1579.

economy.zh: 经济以水稻种植、胡椒与香料出口以及港口贸易为主。万丹与巽他卡拉巴等港口连接印度洋与南海商路，输出胡椒、稻米与林产，输入纺织品、瓷器与金属。内陆通过河流与集市连接，王室与地方首领分享贸易收益和土地收入。
economy.en: The economy centred on rice farming, pepper and spice exports and port trade. Ports such as Banten and Sunda Kelapa linked Indian Ocean and South China Sea routes, exporting pepper, rice and forest products and importing textiles, ceramics and metals. Rivers and markets connected the interior, and the crown shared trade revenue and land income with local chiefs.

culture.zh: 巽他文化以印度教—佛教传统与本地信仰结合为特征，古巽他语与卡维文用于碑铭和文献。布姜加·马尼克手抄本记载了王统与习俗，是研究巽他历史的重要资料。哇扬皮影、甘美兰音乐与稻作仪式延续至今，巴杜伊人等社群仍保留传统生活方式。
culture.en: Sundanese culture combined Hindu-Buddhist traditions with local beliefs, and Old Sundanese and Kawi were used in inscriptions and texts. The Bujangga Manik manuscript records royal lines and customs and is a key source for Sundanese history. Wayang puppet theatre, gamelan music and rice rituals continue today, and communities such as the Baduy keep older ways of life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪前后建国、14世纪满者伯夷压力下的调整、1482—1521年斯里巴杜加·马哈拉查的鼎盛期、1522年与葡萄牙订立协议、1527年巴库安陷落，以及1579年前后王国终结。
events.en: Key moments include the kingdom's emergence around the seventh century, adjustments under Majapahit pressure in the fourteenth, the peak under Sri Baduga Maharaja from 1482 to 1521, the treaty with Portugal in 1522, the fall of Pakuan in 1527, and the end of the kingdom around 1579.

value.zh: 巽他王国的都城在加卢与巴库安帕查查兰之间迁移，后者又称巴查查兰。
value.en: The Sunda capital moved between Galuh and Pakuan Pajajaran, the latter also known as Pajajaran.

value.zh: 胡椒与香料出口及港口贸易是王国财政的重要来源。
value.en: Pepper and spice exports and port trade were major sources of royal revenue.

value.zh: 1527年巴库安被攻陷，王国此后衰落并于1579年前后终结。
value.en: Pakuan fell in 1527, after which the kingdom declined and ended around 1579.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 13 territory records for this polity, covering 674 CE to 1578 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Sultanate of Brunei (1368–1888)
supports: The sultanate's rise in the fifteenth century and expansion along Borneo and the Philippines
Its decline in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries
The British protectorate of 1888 and the residential system
Oil, the 1959 constitution and independence in 1984

sources.title: 汶莱
supports: 15世纪苏丹国兴起与在婆罗洲、菲律宾沿海的扩张
17至18世纪的衰落
1888年英国保护国与驻扎官制度
石油、1959年宪法与1984年独立

politics.zh: 汶莱苏丹国于15世纪成为独立政权，马六甲1511年陷落后扩大对婆罗洲沿海与菲律宾部分地区的控制。17至18世纪因内部纷争与欧洲势力竞争而衰落，领土被砂拉越与北婆罗洲逐步分割。1888年成为英国保护国，实行驻扎官制度；1959年获得内部自治，1984年完全独立，实行君主制与马来伊斯兰君主制（MIB）理念。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Brunei became a sovereign state in the fifteenth century and expanded along the coasts of Borneo and parts of the Philippines after Malacca fell in 1511. Internal disputes and European competition caused decline in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries as Sarawak and North Borneo took over territory. Brunei became a British protectorate under a residential system in 1888, gained internal self-government in 1959 and full independence in 1984, and is a monarchy guided by the Malay Islamic Monarchy concept.

economy.zh: 历史上经济依靠婆罗洲北岸的港口贸易，输出樟脑、胡椒、林产与后来的石油。1929年诗里亚发现油田后，石油与天然气成为经济核心，占国内生产总值和出口的绝大部分，国家以此提供免费医疗、教育与社会福利。经济多元化有限，政府推动伊斯兰金融与下游产业。
economy.en: Historically the economy depended on port trade along the northern coast of Borneo, exporting camphor, pepper and forest products and later oil. After oil was found at Seria in 1929 petroleum and gas became the core of the economy, providing most output and exports and funding free health care, education and welfare. Diversification is limited and the state promotes Islamic finance and downstream industries.

culture.zh: 汶莱社会以马来穆斯林文化为主，马来语为官方语言，伊斯兰教为国教，苏丹兼任宗教领袖。宫廷礼仪、传统服饰与水上村落（甘榜阿耶）构成文化标志，华人等社群保留自己的语言与节庆。马来武术、音乐与手工艺在国家庆典中展示，伊斯兰价值观写入国家意识形态。
culture.en: Bruneian society is mainly Malay Muslim, with Malay as the official language, Islam as the state religion and the sultan as religious leader. Court ceremony, traditional dress and the water village of Kampong Ayer are cultural markers, while Chinese and other communities keep their own languages and festivals. Malay martial arts, music and crafts appear in national celebrations, and Islamic values are written into the state ideology.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪苏丹国兴起、1511年马六甲陷落后的扩张、17至18世纪的领土丧失、1888年成为英国保护国、1929年发现石油、1959年内部自治，以及1984年完全独立。
events.en: Key moments include the rise of the sultanate in the fifteenth century, expansion after the fall of Malacca in 1511, territorial losses in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, the British protectorate of 1888, the discovery of oil in 1929, internal self-government in 1959, and full independence in 1984.

value.zh: 马六甲1511年陷落后，汶莱苏丹国扩大对婆罗洲沿海与菲律宾部分地区的控制。
value.en: After Malacca fell in 1511 the Bruneian Sultanate expanded along the coasts of Borneo and parts of the Philippines.

value.zh: 1929年诗里亚发现油田，石油与天然气此后成为经济核心。
value.en: Oil was discovered at Seria in 1929, after which petroleum and gas became the core of the economy.

value.zh: 汶莱1959年获得内部自治，1984年1月1日完全独立。
value.en: Brunei gained internal self-government in 1959 and full independence on 1 January 1984.

The territory records cover 1363-2024, including the protectorate period and the modern state after independence in 1984.

亚齐战争、伦理政策与20世纪初的扩张
1942—1945年日本占领与1949年主权移交

politics.zh: 荷属东印度是1800年巴达维亚共和国接管荷兰东印度公司后建立的殖民地。19世纪荷兰通过爪哇战争、亚齐战争等逐步扩大控制，1900年代初占领西新几内亚，达到最大范围。殖民政府设总督，与本地王公签订条约并保留部分自治。1942年日本占领，1945年印度尼西亚宣布独立，1949年荷兰在圆桌会议上移交主权。
politics.en: The Dutch East Indies was the colony created in 1800 when the Batavian Republic took over the Dutch East India Company. In the nineteenth century the Dutch expanded control through the Java and Aceh wars and other campaigns, reaching their greatest extent with the occupation of Western New Guinea in the early twentieth century. A governor-general ruled, concluding treaties with local rulers who kept limited autonomy. Japan occupied the colony in 1942, Indonesia declared independence in 1945, and the Netherlands transferred sovereignty at the 1949 round table conference.

economy.zh: 殖民经济以种植制度为核心，强迫种植咖啡、甘蔗、靛蓝与香料，19世纪后期转为私人种植园与橡胶、烟草、石油和锡矿开发。爪哇成为糖与稻米产区，苏门答腊与婆罗洲输出烟草、橡胶与石油，巴达维亚、泗水与三宝垄是港口与商业中心。铁路与港口建设服务于出口，本地小农经济与货币税并存。
economy.en: The colonial economy centred on the Cultivation System, which forced the growing of coffee, sugar, indigo and spices, and shifted to private plantations and rubber, tobacco, oil and tin later in the nineteenth century. Java produced sugar and rice, Sumatra and Borneo exported tobacco, rubber and oil, and Batavia, Surabaya and Semarang were port and commercial centres. Railways and harbours served exports, and smallholder farming coexisted with money taxes.

culture.zh: 殖民社会由荷兰官员、欧亚混血、华人、阿拉伯裔与本地各族群构成，等级与种族分层明显。荷兰语与马来语并行，马来语成为跨族群通用语。伊斯兰组织、华人社团与本地教育机构推动现代政治与文化运动，报刊、文学与民族主义思想在20世纪初兴起。
culture.en: Colonial society comprised Dutch officials, Eurasians, Chinese, Arabs and many local communities with clear racial and status hierarchies. Dutch and Malay were both used, and Malay became the inter-ethnic lingua franca. Islamic organisations, Chinese associations and local schools helped drive modern political and cultural movements, and newspapers, literature and nationalist ideas emerged in the early twentieth century.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1800年国家接管、1830年起实行种植制度、1873—1904年亚齐战争、1901年起推行伦理政策、1900年代初占领西新几内亚、1942年日本占领、1945年印度尼西亚宣布独立，以及1949年主权移交。
events.en: Key moments include the state takeover of 1800, the Cultivation System from 1830, the Aceh war of 1873-1904, the ethical policy from 1901, the occupation of Western New Guinea in the early twentieth century, the Japanese occupation of 1942, Indonesia's declaration of independence in 1945, and the transfer of sovereignty in 1949.

value.zh: 1800年荷兰东印度公司解散，国家接管其领地，建立荷属东印度。
value.en: The Dutch East India Company was dissolved in 1800 and the state took over its possessions, creating the Dutch East Indies.

value.zh: 1830年起殖民政府推行种植制度，强迫种植出口经济作物。
value.en: From 1830 the colonial government imposed the Cultivation System of forced export crops.

value.zh: 1949年荷兰在海牙圆桌会议上向印度尼西亚移交主权。
value.en: The Netherlands transferred sovereignty to Indonesia at the 1949 round table conference in The Hague.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 36 条记录，年份范围为公元1800 年至公元1949 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 36 territory records for this polity, covering 1800 CE to 1949 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Indonesia
supports: Independence proclaimed in 1945 and sovereignty transferred in 1949
Sukarno, guided democracy and the 1965 transition to Suharto
The New Order and the 1998 reform era
Decentralisation, resources and the present republic

sources.title: 印度尼西亚
supports: 1945年宣布独立与1949年主权移交
苏加诺、有领导的民主与1965年转向苏哈托
新秩序时期与1998年改革
地方分权、资源与当代共和国

politics.zh: 印度尼西亚1945年宣布独立，经过独立战争后于1949年获得主权。苏加诺时期实行总统制与“有领导的民主”，1965年政局剧变后苏哈托执政，新秩序政府集中权力并发展经济。1998年苏哈托辞职，改革时代开启，实行多党选举与地方分权，2001年起扩大省级自治。国家由约1.7万个岛屿组成，中央与地方、军队与文官的关系持续调整。
politics.en: Indonesia proclaimed independence in 1945 and gained sovereignty in 1949 after a war of independence. Under Sukarno the state combined a presidential system with guided democracy, and after the political upheaval of 1965 Suharto took power; the New Order centralised authority and pursued development. Suharto resigned in 1998, opening the reform era with multi-party elections and decentralisation, and provincial autonomy was widened from 2001. The state comprises some 17,000 islands, and relations between centre and regions and between the military and civilians keep changing.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、矿业与制造业为主，石油、天然气、煤炭、棕榈油、橡胶与镍是重要出口品，制造业集中在爪哇。服务业与数字经济在近二十年扩张，雅加达是金融与商业中心，旅游业在巴厘等地占重要地位。国家推动下游加工与迁都计划，地区发展不均、基础设施与就业仍是主要议题。
economy.en: Agriculture, mining and manufacturing dominate. Oil, gas, coal, palm oil, rubber and nickel are major exports and manufacturing is concentrated on Java, while services and the digital economy have expanded over the past two decades. Jakarta is the financial and commercial centre and tourism matters in Bali and elsewhere. The state promotes downstream processing and a new capital, while uneven regional development, infrastructure and jobs remain major issues.

culture.zh: 印度尼西亚有数百个族群与语言，印度尼西亚语为通用官方语言，伊斯兰教为多数宗教，基督教、印度教与佛教社群并存。爪哇、巽他、巴厘与马来等文化传统通过宫廷、寺庙与村落仪式延续，哇扬皮影、甘美兰音乐与蜡染工艺具有代表性。文学、电影与流行音乐在地区内影响广泛。
culture.en: Indonesia has hundreds of ethnic and linguistic communities, Indonesian serves as the common official language, Islam is the majority religion and Christian, Hindu and Buddhist communities also exist. Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese and Malay traditions continue through courts, temples and village ritual, with wayang puppet theatre, gamelan music and batik as representative arts. Literature, film and popular music reach the wider region.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1945年宣布独立、1949年主权移交、1955年万隆会议、1965年政局转折、1966年起的新秩序、1998年苏哈托辞职与改革，以及2001年以来的地方分权。
events.en: Key moments include the proclamation of 1945, the transfer of sovereignty in 1949, the Bandung conference of 1955, the political turning point of 1965, the New Order from 1966, Suharto's resignation and reform in 1998, and decentralisation since 2001.

value.zh: 1945年印度尼西亚宣布独立，1949年荷兰移交主权。
value.en: Indonesia proclaimed independence in 1945 and the Netherlands transferred sovereignty in 1949.

value.zh: 1966年苏哈托上台，新秩序政府执政至1998年。
value.en: Suharto came to power in 1966 and the New Order governed until 1998.

value.zh: 1998年苏哈托辞职后进入改革时代，实行多党选举与地方分权。
value.en: After Suharto resigned in 1998 Indonesia entered the reform era with multi-party elections and decentralisation.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 9 条记录，年份范围为公元1946 年至公元2024 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录自1946年起；1945年宣布独立与独立战争作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 9 territory records for this polity, covering 1946 CE to 2024 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records begin in 1946; the 1945 proclamation and the independence struggle appear as background.

sources.title: Philippines
supports: Independence in 1946 and the post-war republic
The Marcos years and the 1986 people power transition
Post-1986 democracy, elections and decentralisation
Services, remittances, agriculture and the present republic

sources.title: 菲律宾
supports: 1946年独立与战后共和国
马科斯时期与1986年人民力量革命
1986年后的民主、选举与地方自治
服务业、侨汇、农业与当代共和国

politics.zh: 菲律宾1946年独立，建立总统制共和国，战后经历多党政治与土地改革尝试。1965年马科斯执政，1972年实施戒严，1986年人民力量革命迫其下台，科拉松·阿基诺就任总统并恢复宪政。此后政权通过选举轮替，地方政府与家族政治影响显著。南部棉兰老岛长期存在武装冲突，2019年设邦萨摩洛自治区。
politics.en: The Philippines became independent in 1946 as a presidential republic and experienced multi-party politics and attempts at land reform. Marcos took office in 1965 and imposed martial law in 1972; the 1986 people power revolution forced him out and Corazon Aquino restored constitutional government. Elections have alternated power since, with strong local government and family politics. Armed conflict persisted in Mindanao, where a Bangsamoro autonomous region was created in 2019.

economy.zh: 经济以服务业为主，海外劳工汇款与业务流程外包是重要外汇来源，农业种植水稻、玉米、椰子与甘蔗。制造业包括电子元件与食品加工，马尼拉都会区集中金融与商业。基础设施、能源价格与自然灾害影响增长，贫富与城乡差距长期存在。
economy.en: Services dominate, with remittances from overseas workers and business process outsourcing as key sources of foreign currency, while agriculture grows rice, maize, coconut and sugar. Manufacturing includes electronics and food processing, and Metro Manila concentrates finance and commerce. Infrastructure, energy prices and natural disasters affect growth, and income and rural-urban gaps persist.

culture.zh: 菲律宾文化融合马来、华人、西班牙与美国影响，他加禄语为基础的菲律宾语与英语同为官方语言，天主教徒占多数，南部穆斯林社群保留伊斯兰传统。节庆、音乐与饮食体现多元来源，文学与电影关注移民、家庭与社会议题，海外社群也维系文化联系。
culture.en: Filipino culture blends Malay, Chinese, Spanish and American influences. Filipino, based on Tagalog, and English are both official, Catholics form the majority and Muslim communities in the south keep Islamic traditions. Festivals, music and food reflect these mixed origins, literature and film address migration, family and social issues, and overseas communities maintain cultural ties.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1946年独立、1972年戒严、1986年人民力量革命、1992年美军基地关闭、1998年与2010年的政权轮替，以及2019年邦萨摩洛自治区成立。
events.en: Key moments include independence in 1946, martial law in 1972, the people power revolution of 1986, the closure of US bases in 1992, changes of government in 1998 and 2010, and the creation of the Bangsamoro region in 2019.

value.zh: 菲律宾1946年7月4日独立，建立共和国。
value.en: The Philippines became independent on 4 July 1946 and established a republic.

value.zh: 1986年人民力量革命迫使马科斯下台，恢复宪政。
value.en: The 1986 people power revolution forced Marcos out and restored constitutional government.

value.zh: 2019年棉兰老岛穆斯林地区成立邦萨摩洛自治区。
value.en: The Bangsamoro autonomous region was created in the Muslim areas of Mindanao in 2019.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 2 条记录（公元1947 年至公元2024 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录仅2条（1947—2024年），覆盖很薄；叙述依据所列条目，不能据疆域记录推断其疆域变化。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 2 territory records for this polity (1947 CE to 2024 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The atlas holds only two territory records for the Philippines (1947-2024), a thin coverage; the essay follows the cited articles and the records cannot support claims about territorial change.

sources.title: Lan Xang
supports: The Lao kingdom founded by Fa Ngum in 1353
Luang Prabang and the move of the capital to Vientiane in 1560
Theravada Buddhism and the Phra Bang palladium
The seventeenth-century crisis and the division into separate kingdoms

sources.title: 澜沧王国
supports: 1353年法昂建立的佬族王国
琅勃拉邦与1560年迁都万象
上座部佛教与帕邦佛像
17世纪危机与分裂为若干王国

politics.zh: 澜沧王国由法昂于1353年建立，是今天老挝地域上第一个统一王国，都城在琅勃拉邦，1560年赛塔提拉迁都万象。王国以湄公河为轴，控制河谷与山地之间的贸易和人口，与暹罗、越南、缅甸和高棉保持朝贡与战争关系。17世纪末因继承争端陷入内乱，1696年后分裂为万象、琅勃拉邦等王国。
politics.en: Lan Xang was founded by Fa Ngum in 1353 and was the first unified kingdom in the area of present-day Laos, with its capital at Luang Prabang until Setthathirath moved it to Vientiane in 1560. The kingdom was organised along the Mekong, controlling trade and people between the river valleys and the hills, and it maintained tributary and military relations with Siam, Vietnam, Burma and Cambodia. Dynastic disputes at the end of the seventeenth century led to division after 1696 into the kingdoms of Vientiane, Luang Prabang and others.

economy.zh: 经济以湄公河沿岸的水稻种植为基础，山地居民从事刀耕火种、采集与畜牧。王国征收稻米、象牙、紫胶、香料与林产品，与暹罗、越南和中国进行贸易，输出黄金、象牙与林产，输入布匹、金属与瓷器。河流是主要交通线，寺庙与王室掌握仓储与交换网络。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming along the Mekong, while upland peoples practised shifting cultivation, gathering and herding. The kingdom levied rice, ivory, lac, aromatics and forest products and traded with Siam, Vietnam and China, exporting gold, ivory and forest goods and importing cloth, metals and ceramics. Rivers were the main arteries, and temples and the court controlled storage and exchange networks.

culture.zh: 上座部佛教是国教，帕邦佛像成为王国象征，寺院承担教育与社会服务，琅勃拉邦与万象的佛塔寺庙构成建筑遗产。老挝语与佬族习俗在河谷传播，同时保留众多山地族群的语言与传统。文学、音乐与节庆融合佛教与本地信仰，国家认同延续至今。
culture.en: Theravada Buddhism was the state religion and the Phra Bang image became the kingdom's palladium. Monasteries provided education and welfare, and the stupas and temples of Luang Prabang and Vientiane form an architectural heritage. The Lao language and lowland customs spread along the valleys while many upland communities kept their own languages and traditions. Literature, music and festivals combine Buddhist and local beliefs, and the kingdom remains the base of Lao national identity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1353年建国、16世纪抵抗缅甸入侵与1560年迁都万象、17世纪中期的繁荣、1696年分裂，以及18世纪初形成万象、琅勃拉邦等独立王国。
events.en: Key moments include the founding in 1353, resistance to Burmese invasions in the sixteenth century and the move to Vientiane in 1560, prosperity in the mid-seventeenth century, the division of 1696, and the emergence of separate kingdoms such as Vientiane and Luang Prabang in the early eighteenth century.

value.zh: 1353年法昂建立澜沧王国，为老挝历史上第一个统一王朝。
value.en: Fa Ngum founded Lan Xang in 1353, the first unified kingdom in Lao history.

value.zh: 1560年赛塔提拉将都城由琅勃拉邦迁至万象。
value.en: Setthathirath moved the capital from Luang Prabang to Vientiane in 1560.

value.zh: 1696年后王国因继承争端分裂为万象、琅勃拉邦等王国。
value.en: After 1696 dynastic disputes split the kingdom into Vientiane, Luang Prabang and others.

sources.title: Australia
supports: Federation in 1901 and the early Commonwealth
The world wars, immigration and post-war expansion
Indigenous rights, the 1967 referendum and land rights
Mining, services and the present federation

sources.title: 澳大利亚
supports: 1901年联邦成立与早期联邦政府
两次世界大战、移民与战后发展
原住民权利、1967年公投与土地权
矿业、服务业与当代联邦

politics.zh: 澳大利亚1901年由六个殖民地组成联邦，实行议会制君主立宪与联邦制，首都设于堪培拉。早期推行限制移民政策，两次世界大战后大规模接收移民。1967年公投承认原住民计入人口并授权联邦立法，此后土地权与和解进程推进。联邦与州分权，工党与自由党—国家党联盟长期轮流执政。
politics.en: Australia federated in 1901 from six colonies as a parliamentary constitutional monarchy with a federal system and its capital at Canberra. Early governments restricted immigration, and after the two world wars the country took in large numbers of migrants. The 1967 referendum counted Indigenous Australians in the population and allowed federal legislation, after which land rights and reconciliation advanced. Powers are divided between the Commonwealth and the states, and Labor and the Liberal-National coalition have long alternated in office.

economy.zh: 经济以服务业为主，矿业和农业是重要出口部门，铁矿石、煤炭、天然气、黄金与农产品面向亚洲市场。制造业在战后占比较高，20世纪80年代后关税下降与金融改革推动结构调整。悉尼与墨尔本是金融与商业中心，人口集中在沿海城市，内陆地区人口稀少。
economy.en: Services dominate the economy, with mining and agriculture as major export sectors: iron ore, coal, gas, gold and farm products go mainly to Asian markets. Manufacturing was larger after the war, and tariff cuts and financial reform from the 1980s restructured the economy. Sydney and Melbourne are the financial and commercial centres, population concentrates in coastal cities, and the interior is sparsely settled.

culture.zh: 澳大利亚原住民与托雷斯海峡岛民拥有数万年的历史与文化，1788年后的英国殖民与后来的多元移民塑造了当代社会。英语为通用语言，移民带来多种语言与宗教。体育、海滩文化、电影与文学形成国家形象，原住民艺术与土地观念在公共文化中日益重要。
culture.en: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples have tens of thousands of years of history and culture, and British colonisation after 1788 together with later migration shaped contemporary society. English is the common language and migrants brought many languages and religions. Sport, beach culture, film and literature form part of the national image, and Indigenous art and connections to country are increasingly prominent in public culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1901年联邦成立、1915年加里波利战役、1945年后的移民计划、1967年公投、1970年代白澳政策终结与土地权立法，以及1999年共和制公投未获通过。
events.en: Key moments include federation in 1901, the Gallipoli campaign of 1915, the post-1945 migration programme, the 1967 referendum, the end of the White Australia policy and land rights legislation in the 1970s, and the unsuccessful republic referendum of 1999.

value.zh: 1901年澳大利亚六个殖民地组成联邦，成为自治领。
value.en: Australia's six colonies federated in 1901 as a self-governing dominion.

value.zh: 1967年公投通过，原住民被计入人口并纳入联邦立法权限。
value.en: The 1967 referendum counted Indigenous Australians in the population and brought them under federal legislative power.

value.zh: 二战后澳大利亚推行大规模移民计划，人口与社会结构显著变化。
value.en: After the Second World War Australia ran a large migration programme that changed its population and society.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 6 territory records for this polity, covering 1905 CE to 2024 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records begin in 1905; federation in 1901 and the earlier colonial period appear as background.

sources.title: New Zealand
supports: Dominion status and the adoption of the Statute of Westminster in 1947
The post-war welfare state, Maori urbanisation and the 1975 Waitangi Tribunal
Economic reform from the 1980s and the present parliamentary system
Biculturalism, immigration and the South Pacific relationship

sources.title: 新西兰
supports: 自治领地位与1947年采用威斯敏斯特法令
战后福利国家、毛利人城市化与1975年怀唐伊法庭
1980年代经济改革与当代议会制
双文化、移民与南太平洋关系

politics.zh: 新西兰1907年成为自治领，1947年采用威斯敏斯特法令获得完整立法权，实行一院制议会与混合成员比例选举制。1840年怀唐伊条约是毛利与英国王室关系的基础，1975年设立怀唐伊法庭处理历史索赔。战后福利制度扩展，1980年代进行经济与行政改革。毛利选区与政策安排使双文化议题长期居于政治中心。
politics.en: New Zealand became a dominion in 1907 and adopted the Statute of Westminster in 1947, gaining full legislative power under a unicameral parliament with mixed-member proportional elections. The Treaty of Waitangi of 1840 underpins relations between Maori and the crown, and the Waitangi Tribunal was set up in 1975 to hear historical claims. The post-war welfare state expanded and economic and administrative reforms followed in the 1980s. Maori seats and policy arrangements keep bicultural issues at the centre of politics.

economy.zh: 经济以农业及相关出口为主，乳制品、肉类、木材与水果面向国际市场，服务业和旅游业占重要地位。1980年代取消补贴、开放市场并改革税制，货币政策独立。渔业与电影、科技产业提供多样化就业，人口集中于奥克兰等北部城市。
economy.en: Agriculture and related exports dominate, with dairy, meat, timber and fruit sold internationally, while services and tourism are important. In the 1980s subsidies were removed, markets opened and the tax system reformed, with an independent monetary policy. Fisheries, film and technology provide more varied employment, and population concentrates in Auckland and other northern cities.

culture.zh: 毛利文化是国家认同的核心，毛利语与英语同为官方语言，怀唐伊条约原则写入法律与公共政策。移民来自太平洋岛国、亚洲与欧洲，形成多元社会。橄榄球、户外生活与电影制作具有国际影响，毛利艺术、雕刻与战舞在公共仪式中广泛呈现。
culture.en: Maori culture is central to national identity, Maori and English are both official, and the principles of the Treaty of Waitangi are written into law and public policy. Migrants from the Pacific, Asia and Europe make up a diverse society. Rugby, outdoor life and film-making have international reach, and Maori art, carving and the haka appear widely in public ceremony.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1840年怀唐伊条约、1907年成为自治领、1947年采用威斯敏斯特法令、1975年设立怀唐伊法庭、1980年代经济改革，以及1996年引入混合成员比例选举制。
events.en: Key moments include the Treaty of Waitangi in 1840, dominion status in 1907, adoption of the Statute of Westminster in 1947, the creation of the Waitangi Tribunal in 1975, the economic reforms of the 1980s, and the introduction of mixed-member proportional elections in 1996.

value.zh: 1947年新西兰采用威斯敏斯特法令，获得完整立法独立。
value.en: New Zealand adopted the Statute of Westminster in 1947, gaining full legislative independence.

value.zh: 1975年设立怀唐伊法庭，审理毛利对历史土地与权利的主张。
value.en: The Waitangi Tribunal was created in 1975 to hear Maori claims over historical land and rights.

value.zh: 1996年新西兰首次采用混合成员比例选举制。
value.en: New Zealand first used mixed-member proportional elections in 1996.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 2 条记录（公元1948 年至公元2024 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录仅2条（1948—2024年），覆盖很薄；1840年怀唐伊条约与更早历史作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 2 territory records for this polity (1948 CE to 2024 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The atlas holds only two territory records for New Zealand (1948-2024), a thin coverage; the Treaty of Waitangi of 1840 and earlier history appear as background.

sources.title: Hawaiian Kingdom
supports: Unification under Kamehameha I from 1795 and full unification in 1810
The constitutional monarchy, the Great Mahele and the sugar economy
The 1887 constitution, the 1893 overthrow and the republic of 1894
Hawaiian language, Christianity and land tenure

sources.title: 夏威夷王國
supports: 1795年起卡美哈梅哈一世统一，1810年全岛统一
君主立宪、大土地分配与蔗糖经济
1887年宪法、1893年政变与1894年共和国
夏威夷语、基督教与土地制度

politics.zh: 夏威夷王国由卡美哈梅哈一世自1795年起逐步统一群岛，1810年完成全岛统一。19世纪逐步建立君主立宪体制，1840年与1852年颁布宪法，设立议会与法院。1887年宪法削弱王权，1891年利留卡拉尼女王继位后试图恢复权力，1893年被推翻，1894年成立共和国，1898年被美国兼并。
politics.en: The Hawaiian Kingdom was unified by Kamehameha I from 1795, completing the union of the islands in 1810. A constitutional monarchy developed in the nineteenth century with constitutions in 1840 and 1852, a legislature and courts. The 1887 constitution curtailed royal power, and when Queen Liliuokalani tried to restore it after 1891 she was overthrown in 1893; a republic followed in 1894 and the United States annexed the islands in 1898.

economy.zh: 经济先后以檀香木、捕鲸和蔗糖为支柱。19世纪中期土地制度 reform 使土地可以买卖，甘蔗种植园与制糖业依赖外来劳工，来自中国、日本、葡萄牙和菲律宾的移民改变了群岛人口结构。与美国签订互惠条约后蔗糖出口迅速增长，珍珠港成为重要港口。
economy.en: Sandalwood, whaling and then sugar underpinned the economy. Mid-nineteenth-century land reform allowed land to be bought and sold, and sugar plantations depended on immigrant labour from China, Japan, Portugal and the Philippines, changing the islands' population. A reciprocity treaty with the United States boosted sugar exports, and Pearl Harbor became an important port.

culture.zh: 夏威夷语与草裙舞、航海与土地观念构成原住民文化核心，19世纪传教士带来基督教与文字教育，夏威夷语成为书写语言并用于报纸与法律。王室赞助音乐与舞蹈，卡美哈梅哈家族与卡拉卡瓦家族留下宫廷传统。多元移民文化形成今天的夏威夷地方认同。
culture.en: The Hawaiian language, hula, navigation and land concepts form the core of Native Hawaiian culture. Missionaries brought Christianity and literacy in the nineteenth century, and Hawaiian became a written language used in newspapers and law. The monarchy patronised music and dance, and the Kamehameha and Kalakaua houses left court traditions. Immigrant cultures together shaped today's local Hawaiian identity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1795年起统一进程、1810年全岛统一、1840与1852年宪法、1848年大土地分配、1876年与美国的互惠条约、1887年宪法、1893年政变，以及1894年共和国成立。
events.en: Key moments include the unification process from 1795, full unification in 1810, the constitutions of 1840 and 1852, the Great Mahele of 1848, the reciprocity treaty with the United States in 1876, the constitution of 1887, the coup of 1893, and the republic of 1894.

value.zh: 卡美哈梅哈一世自1795年起统一群岛，1810年完成全岛统一。
value.en: Kamehameha I unified the islands from 1795 and completed the union in 1810.

value.zh: 1848年大土地分配使土地可以买卖，改变了土地制度。
value.en: The Great Mahele of 1848 made land alienable and transformed land tenure.

value.zh: 1893年利留卡拉尼女王被推翻，1894年成立共和国。
value.en: Queen Liliuokalani was overthrown in 1893 and a republic was established in 1894.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元1791 年至公元1894 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖1791—1894年（5 条）；1893年政变与1898年并入美国作为后续写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (1791 CE to 1894 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover 1791-1894 (five records); the 1893 coup and the 1898 annexation appear as aftermath.

sources.title: Bali Kingdom
supports: A series of Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms on Bali from the early tenth century
Balinese court culture combining ancestral reverence and Hindu influence
Rice terraces, the subak irrigation system and trade
The Gelgel period and later division among Balinese kingdoms

sources.title: 巴厘王国
supports: 10世纪初起巴厘岛上的印度教—佛教王国
祖先崇拜与印度教影响结合的宫廷文化
水稻梯田、苏巴克灌溉系统与贸易
格勒格尔时期与后来诸王国的分立

politics.zh: 巴厘岛王国指10世纪初至20世纪初统治巴厘及其邻近岛屿的一系列印度教—佛教王国。10世纪瓦尔马德瓦王朝的碑铭记录了早期王权，14世纪满者伯夷的影响加强，16世纪格勒格尔王国成为重要中心。此后巴厘分裂为多个小王国，彼此竞争并保持与爪哇、龙目和东部群岛的联系。
politics.en: The Bali Kingdom refers to a series of Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms that ruled Bali and neighbouring islands from the early tenth to the early twentieth centuries. Inscriptions of the Warmadewa dynasty record early royal power in the tenth century, Majapahit influence grew in the fourteenth, and Gelgel became an important centre in the sixteenth. Bali then divided into several smaller kingdoms that competed and kept links with Java, Lombok and the eastern islands.

economy.zh: 经济以水稻梯田农业为基础，苏巴克灌溉协会管理水源与用水分配，至今仍在运作。贸易输出稻米、棉布、牲畜与奴隶，输入铜、瓷器与纺织品。港口连接爪哇、龙目与更远的群岛商路，王室与寺庙通过土地和贸易获得收入。
economy.en: Rice terrace farming was the base, with subak irrigation associations managing water and its allocation, as they still do. Trade exported rice, cotton cloth, livestock and slaves and imported copper, ceramics and textiles. Ports linked Bali to Java, Lombok and wider island routes, and the courts and temples drew income from land and trade.

culture.zh: 巴厘文化把祖先崇拜与印度教、佛教元素结合，寺庙、家庙与村落组织构成社会框架。哇扬皮影、甘美兰音乐、舞蹈与雕刻具有独特风格，火葬仪式与历法节庆延续传统。梵文与古爪哇语影响巴厘语文献，文学与法律文本保存在棕榈叶抄本中。
culture.en: Balinese culture combines ancestral reverence with Hindu and Buddhist elements, and temples, family shrines and village organisation frame society. Wayang puppet theatre, gamelan music, dance and sculpture have distinctive styles, and cremation rituals and calendar festivals continue older traditions. Sanskrit and Old Javanese influenced Balinese texts, and literature and law were preserved on palm-leaf manuscripts.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪瓦尔马德瓦王朝的碑铭、14世纪满者伯夷影响加强、16世纪格勒格尔王国兴起、17世纪诸王国分立，以及19世纪起荷兰逐步介入。
events.en: Key moments include the Warmadewa inscriptions of the tenth century, growing Majapahit influence in the fourteenth, the rise of Gelgel in the sixteenth, the division into several kingdoms in the seventeenth, and increasing Dutch intervention from the nineteenth century.

value.zh: 10世纪瓦尔马德瓦王朝的碑铭记录了巴厘早期的王权与灌溉管理。
value.en: Inscriptions of the tenth-century Warmadewa dynasty record early royal power and irrigation management on Bali.

value.zh: 苏巴克灌溉协会管理水稻梯田的水源分配，延续至今。
value.en: Subak irrigation associations manage water allocation for the rice terraces and still operate today.

value.zh: 16世纪格勒格尔成为巴厘重要的政治与宫廷文化中心。
value.en: Gelgel became an important political and courtly centre in the sixteenth century.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 7 territory records for this polity, covering 922 CE to 1686 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Elam
supports: Elam as an ancient civilisation in south-western Iran with its capital at Susa
The Old, Middle and Neo-Elamite phases and the dynasty of Shimashki
Chogha Zanbil and Elamite religion and architecture
Conflicts with Mesopotamia and the Assyrian conquest in 639 BCE

sources.title: 埃蘭
supports: 埃兰是伊朗西南部的古代文明，首都苏萨
古埃兰、中埃兰与新埃兰阶段及西马什基王朝
恰高占比尔与埃兰宗教、建筑
与两河流域的冲突及前639年被亚述征服

politics.zh: 埃兰是伊朗西南部的古代文明，以苏萨为中心，约公元前2700年起见于文献，历经古埃兰、中埃兰与新埃兰阶段。西马什基与苏萨诸王朝与两河流域的城邦长期交往和交战，中埃兰时期在苏萨与安善建立强势王权。新埃兰时期与亚述冲突不断，前639年亚述巴尼拔攻陷苏萨，埃兰国家灭亡。
politics.en: Elam was an ancient civilisation in south-western Iran centred on Susa, attested from about 2700 BCE and divided into Old, Middle and Neo-Elamite phases. Dynasties based at Shimashki and Susa traded and fought with the Mesopotamian city-states, and in the Middle Elamite period a strong kingship ruled from Susa and Anshan. The Neo-Elamite period was marked by conflict with Assyria, and in 639 BCE Ashurbanipal captured Susa, ending the Elamite state.

economy.zh: 经济以卡伦河与卡尔黑河流域的灌溉农业为基础，种植大麦、小麦与椰枣，并经营畜牧业。埃兰位于伊朗高原与美索不达米亚之间的商路上，输出金属、木材、马匹与手工业品，输入纺织品、白银与奢侈品。苏萨等城市是行政与商业中心，王室与神庙掌控土地和仓储。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming in the Karun and Karkheh plains, growing barley, wheat and dates along with herding. Elam lay on routes between the Iranian plateau and Mesopotamia, exporting metals, timber, horses and crafts and importing textiles, silver and luxuries. Cities such as Susa were administrative and commercial centres, and the crown and temples controlled land and storage.

culture.zh: 埃兰语使用楔形文字书写，与苏美尔、阿卡德语文献并存，王室铭文记录建筑与宗教活动。宗教崇拜以因舒希纳克等神祇为中心，恰高占比尔的塔庙与神庙群是建筑代表。埃兰艺术中的雕塑、印章与金属器融合本地与两河流域元素，对后来的波斯文化有影响。
culture.en: Elamite was written in cuneiform alongside Sumerian and Akkadian texts, and royal inscriptions record building and religious activity. Worship centred on deities such as Inshushinak, and the ziggurat and temples at Chogha Zanbil represent its architecture. Sculpture, seals and metalwork combine local and Mesopotamian elements and influenced later Persian culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约前2700年埃兰国家见于文献、前2000年前后西马什基王朝兴起、中埃兰时期恰高占比尔的建造、前12世纪对巴比伦的进攻，以及前639年亚述攻陷苏萨、埃兰灭亡。
events.en: Key moments include the appearance of Elamite states in the record around 2700 BCE, the rise of the Shimashki dynasty around 2000 BCE, the building of Chogha Zanbil in the Middle Elamite period, the attack on Babylon in the twelfth century BCE, and the Assyrian capture of Susa in 639 BCE that ended Elam.

value.zh: 苏萨是埃兰的政治与宗教中心，也是后来阿契美尼德帝国的都城之一。
value.en: Susa was Elam's political and religious centre and later one of the Achaemenid capitals.

value.zh: 中埃兰时期建造的恰高占比尔塔庙与神庙群是埃兰建筑的代表。
value.en: The ziggurat and temple complex at Chogha Zanbil, built in the Middle Elamite period, represent Elamite architecture.

value.zh: 前639年亚述巴尼拔攻陷苏萨，埃兰国家灭亡。
value.en: Ashurbanipal captured Susa in 639 BCE, ending the Elamite state.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 17 territory records for this polity, covering 3200 BCE to 601 BCE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Assyria
supports: Assyria from the Old Assyrian trading colonies to the Middle Assyrian kingdom
Ashur as the religious capital and the god Ashur
Middle Assyrian expansion under Shalmaneser I and Tukulti-Ninurta I
The transition to the Neo-Assyrian empire after 900 BCE

sources.title: 亚述
supports: 从古亚述商业殖民地到中亚述王国
阿舒尔城与阿舒尔神
沙尔马纳塞尔一世与图库尔蒂-尼努尔塔一世时期的中亚述扩张
前900年后向新亚述帝国的过渡

politics.zh: 亚述兴起于底格里斯河上游的阿舒尔城，古亚述时期以商业殖民地网络著称，商人在安纳托利亚建立卡鲁姆进行贸易。中亚述时期在沙尔马纳塞尔一世与图库尔蒂-尼努尔塔一世等君主统治下扩张，控制上美索不达米亚并短暂支配巴比伦。前900年后进入新亚述阶段，最终形成横跨西亚的帝国，都城先后设于阿舒尔、尼姆鲁德、霍尔萨巴德与尼尼微。
politics.en: Assyria emerged around the city of Ashur on the upper Tigris. In the Old Assyrian period it was known for a network of trading colonies, with merchants running karum settlements in Anatolia. In the Middle Assyrian period rulers such as Shalmaneser I and Tukulti-Ninurta I expanded into Upper Mesopotamia and briefly controlled Babylon. After 900 BCE the Neo-Assyrian phase began and grew into an empire across West Asia, with capitals at Ashur, Nimrud, Khorsabad and Nineveh.

economy.zh: 经济以底格里斯河两岸的农业为基础，种植大麦、小麦与芝麻，并经营羊毛和牲畜。古亚述商人以锡、纺织品换取安纳托利亚的银与铜，中亚述时期国家通过税收、战利品与强制迁徙获取资源。灌溉、道路与驿站支持行政与军事，王室与神庙掌握大量土地和工匠。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming along the Tigris, growing barley, wheat and sesame and raising sheep for wool. Old Assyrian merchants exchanged tin and textiles for Anatolian silver and copper, and in the Middle Assyrian period the state drew resources from taxes, booty and forced resettlement. Irrigation, roads and relay stations supported administration and war, and the crown and temples held much land and many craftsmen.

culture.zh: 阿舒尔神是国家主神，神庙与祭祀构成政治合法性的核心。亚述使用阿卡德语与楔形文字，王室铭文、法律与行政文书数量庞大，图书馆与档案保存了文学、宗教与科学文本。建筑以神庙、宫殿与城墙著称，浮雕与雕像用于宣扬王权，中亚述法律汇编反映社会与家庭制度。
culture.en: The god Ashur was the national deity, and temple ritual underpinned political legitimacy. Assyrians wrote Akkadian in cuneiform, producing royal inscriptions, laws and administrative records, while libraries and archives preserved literary, religious and scientific texts. Architecture featured temples, palaces and city walls, and reliefs and statues projected royal power; the Middle Assyrian laws reflect social and family institutions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前20至前19世纪古亚述商业殖民地、前14世纪中亚述国家扩张、前13世纪沙尔马纳塞尔一世与图库尔蒂-尼努尔塔一世的征伐、前12世纪对巴比伦的短暂控制，以及前900年后新亚述帝国的兴起。
events.en: Key moments include the Old Assyrian trading colonies of the twentieth and nineteenth centuries BCE, Middle Assyrian expansion in the fourteenth, the campaigns of Shalmaneser I and Tukulti-Ninurta I in the thirteenth, brief control of Babylon in the twelfth, and the rise of the Neo-Assyrian empire after 900 BCE.

value.zh: 古亚述商人在安纳托利亚建立卡鲁姆贸易殖民地，以锡和纺织品换取银与铜。
value.en: Old Assyrian merchants set up karum trading colonies in Anatolia, exchanging tin and textiles for silver and copper.

value.zh: 前13世纪沙尔马纳塞尔一世与图库尔蒂-尼努尔塔一世扩张中亚述的版图。
value.en: Shalmaneser I and Tukulti-Ninurta I expanded the Middle Assyrian kingdom in the thirteenth century BCE.

value.zh: 前900年后亚述进入新亚述阶段，尼尼微等城市后来成为帝国都城。
value.en: After 900 BCE Assyria entered its Neo-Assyrian phase, and cities such as Nineveh later became imperial capitals.

sources.title: Babylonia
supports: Babylonia as an Akkadian-speaking state centred on Babylon from about 1894 BCE
Hammurabi and the Old Babylonian kingdom
Kassite and later dynasties, and the rivalry with Assyria
The Neo-Babylonian empire and the fall of Babylon in 539 BCE

sources.title: 巴比伦
supports: 约前1894年起以巴比伦为中心的阿卡德语国家
汉谟拉比与古巴比伦王国
加喜特等王朝与和亚述的竞争
新巴比伦帝国与前539年巴比伦陷落

politics.zh: 巴比伦尼亚是以巴比伦城为中心的阿卡德语国家，约公元前1894年由阿摩利人建立，汉谟拉比在位时统一两河流域南部并颁布法典。此后加喜特人、伊辛第二王朝等相继统治，与北方的亚述长期竞争。前7世纪末迦勒底人建立新巴比伦帝国，尼布甲尼撒二世时期势力鼎盛，前539年波斯军队攻占巴比伦，帝国灭亡。
politics.en: Babylonia was an Akkadian-speaking state centred on the city of Babylon, founded by Amorite rulers around 1894 BCE. Hammurabi unified southern Mesopotamia and issued his law code. Kassite and later Isin II dynasties followed, in long rivalry with Assyria to the north. At the end of the seventh century BCE the Chaldeans founded the Neo-Babylonian empire, which peaked under Nebuchadnezzar II before Persian forces took Babylon in 539 BCE and ended it.

economy.zh: 经济依靠幼发拉底河与底格里斯河的灌溉农业，种植大麦、小麦与椰枣，并经营羊毛、纺织与渔业。河流与运河是运输干线，城市市场与神庙经济并存，借贷、契约与利息记录保存在泥板文书中。巴比伦是区域贸易枢纽，输出纺织品、粮食与椰枣，输入金属、木材与奢侈品。
economy.en: The economy depended on irrigation farming along the Euphrates and Tigris, growing barley, wheat and dates and producing wool, textiles and fish. Rivers and canals carried transport, urban markets operated alongside temple estates, and loans, contracts and interest rates survive in clay tablets. Babylon was a regional trade hub, exporting textiles, grain and dates and importing metals, timber and luxuries.

culture.zh: 巴比伦尼亚以马尔杜克为主神，神庙与新年节庆是宗教生活的中心。楔形文字用于法律、文学、天文与数学，汉谟拉比法典、吉尔伽美什史诗与天文观测记录是重要遗产。学者在神庙与宫廷中整理占星、医学与数学知识，对后世西亚与希腊科学有影响。
culture.en: Marduk was the chief deity and temples and the New Year festival were central to religious life. Cuneiform served law, literature, astronomy and mathematics; the Code of Hammurabi, the Epic of Gilgamesh and astronomical records are major legacies. Scholars in temples and at court organised astrology, medicine and mathematics in ways that influenced later West Asian and Greek science.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约前1894年巴比伦成为独立城邦、前18世纪汉谟拉比统一南部、前16世纪古巴比伦灭亡与加喜特王朝兴起、前7世纪末新巴比伦帝国建立，以及前539年巴比伦陷落于波斯。
events.en: Key moments include Babylon becoming an independent city-state around 1894 BCE, Hammurabi's unification of the south in the eighteenth century, the fall of the Old Babylonian kingdom and rise of the Kassites in the sixteenth, the founding of the Neo-Babylonian empire at the end of the seventh, and the Persian capture of Babylon in 539 BCE.

value.zh: 汉谟拉比在公元前18世纪统一两河流域南部，并颁布成文法典。
value.en: Hammurabi unified southern Mesopotamia in the eighteenth century BCE and issued a written law code.

value.zh: 古巴比伦灭亡后加喜特人统治巴比伦尼亚数百年。
value.en: After the Old Babylonian kingdom fell, the Kassites ruled Babylonia for several centuries.

value.zh: 前539年波斯军队攻占巴比伦，新巴比伦帝国灭亡。
value.en: Persian forces captured Babylon in 539 BCE, ending the Neo-Babylonian empire.

sources.title: Phoenicia
supports: Phoenician city-states along the Levantine coast, mainly in present-day Lebanon
Maritime trade and colonisation from Cyprus to the Maghreb and Iberia
Tyre, Sidon and the alphabet that influenced later scripts
The Persian period and the Hellenistic successor kingdoms

sources.title: 腓尼基
supports: 地中海东岸的腓尼基城邦，主要在今黎巴嫩
从塞浦路斯到马格里布与伊比利亚的航海贸易与殖民
推罗、西顿与影响后世文字的腓尼基字母
波斯时期与希腊化继任王国

politics.zh: 腓尼基是地中海东岸的一系列独立城邦，主要位于今黎巴嫩沿海，以推罗、西顿、比布鲁斯和阿尔瓦德为主要中心。各城邦由王室与商人贵族共同治理，彼此竞争也共享宗教与文字传统。公元前一千纪前期它们在地中海建立殖民地，迦太基即由推罗人所建。前6世纪后先后臣属于波斯与希腊化王国。
politics.en: Phoenicia was a group of independent city-states along the Levantine coast, mainly in present-day Lebanon, with Tyre, Sidon, Byblos and Arwad as leading centres. Kings governed together with merchant elites, and the cities competed while sharing religious and writing traditions. In the early first millennium BCE they founded colonies across the Mediterranean, including Carthage, established by Tyre. From the sixth century BCE they were subject in turn to Persia and the Hellenistic kingdoms.

economy.zh: 经济以航海贸易为核心，输出雪松木、紫色染料、玻璃、葡萄酒与手工业品，输入金属、粮食与奢侈品。腓尼基商人连接埃及、美索不达米亚、希腊与西地中海，建立港口与商站网络。造船、纺织与金属加工是重要行业，殖民地为母邦提供原料与市场。
economy.en: Maritime trade was central: cedar timber, purple dye, glass, wine and crafts were exported while metals, grain and luxuries were imported. Phoenician merchants linked Egypt, Mesopotamia, Greece and the western Mediterranean through a network of ports and trading posts. Shipbuilding, textiles and metalwork were major industries, and colonies supplied raw materials and markets to the mother cities.

culture.zh: 腓尼基人使用二十二个字母的辅音文字，后来演变为希伯来、希腊与拉丁字母，是字母文字的重要源头。宗教崇拜巴力、阿斯塔特等神祇，祭祀与神庙分布于各城邦与殖民地。艺术融合埃及、美索不达米亚与本地风格，象牙雕刻与石棺工艺精美，文献多以纸草书写而少有留存。
culture.en: The Phoenicians used a twenty-two letter consonantal script that developed into the Hebrew, Greek and Latin alphabets and is a key source of alphabetic writing. They worshipped gods such as Baal and Astarte, with temples and offerings in the cities and colonies. Art combined Egyptian, Mesopotamian and local styles, with fine ivory carving and sarcophagi, while most texts written on papyrus have not survived.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前12至前11世纪城邦体系的形成、前9至前8世纪推罗在地中海建立殖民地、前8世纪起受亚述影响、前6世纪臣属波斯，以及前4世纪后被希腊化王国统治。
events.en: Key moments include the formation of the city-state system in the twelfth and eleventh centuries BCE, Tyrian colonisation across the Mediterranean in the ninth and eighth, Assyrian pressure from the eighth, subjection to Persia in the sixth, and rule by Hellenistic kingdoms after the fourth century BCE.

value.zh: 腓尼基字母共22个辅音符号，是希伯来、希腊与拉丁字母的重要源头。
value.en: The Phoenician alphabet had twenty-two consonantal signs and is a key source of the Hebrew, Greek and Latin alphabets.

value.zh: 推罗人于前9世纪在北非建立迦太基，成为西地中海的重要势力。
value.en: Tyre founded Carthage in North Africa in the ninth century BCE, and it became a major power in the western Mediterranean.

value.zh: 前6世纪起腓尼基城邦先后臣属波斯与希腊化王国。
value.en: From the sixth century BCE the Phoenician cities were subject first to Persia and then to Hellenistic kingdoms.

sources.title: Parthian Empire
supports: The Arsacid dynasty founded by Arsaces I in the mid-third century BCE
Mithridates I and the conquest of Mesopotamia from the Seleucids
Rule over the Silk Road between Rome and Han China
Decentralised government, feudatories and the wars with Rome

sources.title: 安息帝國
supports: 前3世纪中叶阿尔沙克一世建立的阿尔沙克王朝
米特里达梯一世从塞琉古手中夺取美索不达米亚
控制罗马与汉朝之间的丝绸之路
地方分权、藩属与对罗马的战争

politics.zh: 安息帝国由帕尼部落首领阿尔沙克一世于公元前3世纪中叶建立，取代塞琉古在伊朗东北部的统治。米特里达梯一世在位时夺取米底与美索不达米亚，定都泰西封，疆域西至幼发拉底河、东抵阿姆河。帝国由王室、贵族与地方藩属共同治理，中央权力有限。与罗马长期交战，224年被萨珊王朝取代。
politics.en: The Parthian Empire was founded in the mid-third century BCE by Arsaces I, leader of the Parni, replacing Seleucid rule in north-eastern Iran. Mithridates I took Media and Mesopotamia and made Ctesiphon a capital, extending the empire from the Euphrates to the Amu Darya. The king ruled with nobles and local vassals, and central authority was limited. Wars with Rome were frequent until the Sasanians replaced the Arsacids in 224 CE.

economy.zh: 经济以伊朗高原与美索不达米亚的灌溉农业为基础，种植谷物、椰枣与葡萄，并经营畜牧。帝国位于丝绸之路要道，连接中国、印度与地中海，输出丝绸、香料与宝石，收取过境税。城市如泰西封、哈特拉与尼萨是贸易与手工业中心，铸币与商队贸易支撑财政。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming on the Iranian plateau and in Mesopotamia, growing grain, dates and grapes and raising livestock. The empire lay on the Silk Road linking China, India and the Mediterranean, exporting silk, spices and gems and taxing transit. Cities such as Ctesiphon, Hatra and Nisa were centres of trade and craft, and coinage and caravan trade supported the treasury.

culture.zh: 安息文化融合伊朗、希腊与两河流域传统，宫廷使用希腊语与帕提亚语，艺术中的正面人物雕像与骑马图像具有特色。宗教上祆教、密特拉崇拜与地方信仰并存，尼萨的象牙角杯与泥板文书反映宫廷生活。文学与口述传统后来被萨珊时期的文献整理保存。
culture.en: Parthian culture combined Iranian, Greek and Mesopotamian traditions. The court used Greek and Parthian, and art is marked by frontal figures and mounted imagery. Zoroastrianism, Mithraism and local cults coexisted, and the ivory rhytons and ostraca of Nisa reflect court life. Oral and literary traditions were later collected and preserved in Sasanian texts.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前247年前后阿尔沙克一世建国、前2世纪米特里达梯一世夺取美索不达米亚、前53年卡莱战役击败罗马、1至2世纪与罗马的反复战争，以及224年霍尔木兹甘战役后萨珊取代安息。
events.en: Key moments include the founding by Arsaces I around 247 BCE, Mithridates I's conquest of Mesopotamia in the second century BCE, the defeat of Rome at Carrhae in 53 BCE, repeated wars with Rome in the first and second centuries CE, and the Sasanian replacement of the Arsacids after Hormozdgan in 224 CE.

value.zh: 阿尔沙克一世于公元前3世纪中叶建立安息帝国，取代塞琉古在伊朗东北部的统治。
value.en: Arsaces I founded the Parthian Empire in the mid-third century BCE, replacing Seleucid rule in north-eastern Iran.

value.zh: 前53年安息军在卡莱战役中击败罗马军队。
value.en: Parthian forces defeated a Roman army at Carrhae in 53 BCE.

value.zh: 安息控制罗马与汉朝之间的丝绸之路中段，收取过境贸易收益。
value.en: The Parthians controlled the middle section of the Silk Road between Rome and Han China and taxed transit trade.

sources.title: Sasanian Empire
supports: The empire founded by Ardashir I in 224 and its official name Eranshahr
Centralised administration, taxation and the Zoroastrian church
Wars with Rome and Byzantium and the conquests of Khosrow II
The Arab conquest and the end of the dynasty in 651

sources.title: 萨珊王朝
supports: 224年阿尔达希尔一世建立帝国，国号伊朗国
中央集权行政、税收与祆教教会
与罗马、拜占庭的战争与库思老二世的扩张
阿拉伯征服与651年王朝终结

politics.zh: 萨珊王朝由阿尔达希尔一世于224年建立，取代安息帝国，国号伊朗国。国王以祆教与波斯传统确立合法性，建立中央集权的官僚与税收体系。沙普尔一世与库思老一世等君主多次与罗马、拜占庭交战，库思老二世时期一度占领埃及与黎凡特。7世纪阿拉伯军队入侵，651年末代君主伊嗣俟三世被杀，帝国灭亡。
politics.en: The Sasanian Empire was founded by Ardashir I in 224, replacing the Parthians, and was officially named Eranshahr. Kings drew legitimacy from Zoroastrianism and Persian tradition and built a centralised bureaucracy and tax system. Rulers such as Shapur I and Khosrow I fought Rome and Byzantium repeatedly, and under Khosrow II the empire briefly held Egypt and the Levant. Arab armies invaded in the seventh century and the last king, Yazdegerd III, was killed in 651, ending the dynasty.

economy.zh: 经济以美索不达米亚与伊朗的灌溉农业为基础，种植大麦、小麦、水稻与棉花，并经营丝绸、纺织与金属加工。国家整修坎儿井与灌溉网，征收土地税与人头税。波斯湾与陆路商道连接印度、中国与地中海，泰西封、苏萨与设拉子是商业中心，银币流通广泛。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming in Mesopotamia and Iran, growing barley, wheat, rice and cotton and producing silk, textiles and metalwork. The state repaired qanats and irrigation networks and levied land and poll taxes. Persian Gulf and overland routes linked India, China and the Mediterranean, Ctesiphon, Susa and Shiraz were commercial centres, and silver coin circulated widely.

culture.zh: 祆教是国教，祭司阶层与火庙享有特权，同时犹太教、基督教与摩尼教社群并存。中古波斯语用于行政与文学，翻译与编纂活动保存了印度、希腊与波斯的知识，医学、天文与数学研究在贡德沙普尔等地发展。建筑以拱顶宫殿、火庙与岩雕著称，塔克·基斯拉与纳克什·鲁斯塔姆浮雕是代表。
culture.en: Zoroastrianism was the state religion and the priesthood and fire temples held privileges, while Jewish, Christian and Manichaean communities also existed. Middle Persian served administration and literature, and translation and compilation preserved Indian, Greek and Persian learning, with medicine, astronomy and mathematics studied at places such as Gundeshapur. Vaulted palaces, fire temples and rock reliefs define its architecture, represented by Taq Kasra and the reliefs at Naqsh-e Rostam.

events.zh: 关键节点包括224年阿尔达希尔一世建国、3世纪沙普尔一世对罗马的战争与俘获瓦勒良、6世纪库思老一世的改革、602至628年与拜占庭的大战、636年卡迪西亚战役，以及651年伊嗣俟三世死亡、帝国终结。
events.en: Key moments include the founding by Ardashir I in 224, Shapur I's wars with Rome and the capture of Valerian in the third century, the reforms of Khosrow I in the sixth, the great war with Byzantium from 602 to 628, the battle of al-Qadisiyyah in 636, and the death of Yazdegerd III in 651 that ended the empire.

value.zh: 224年阿尔达希尔一世击败安息末代君主，建立萨珊王朝。
value.en: Ardashir I defeated the last Parthian ruler in 224 and founded the Sasanian Empire.

value.zh: 260年前后沙普尔一世在埃德萨战役中俘获罗马皇帝瓦勒良。
value.en: Around 260 Shapur I captured the Roman emperor Valerian at Edessa.

value.zh: 651年萨珊末代君主伊嗣俟三世死亡，阿拉伯征服完成。
value.en: The last Sasanian king, Yazdegerd III, died in 651, completing the Arab conquest.
