sources.title: Seleucid Empire
supports: The empire founded by Seleucus I Nicator in 312 BCE
Rule from Seleucia and Antioch over the Near East
Wars with the Ptolemies and the loss of the eastern satrapies
Roman intervention and annexation in 63 BCE

sources.title: 塞琉古王朝
supports: 前312年塞琉古一世建立的帝国
以塞琉西亚与安条克为中心统治近东
与托勒密的战争与东部行省的丧失
罗马干预与前63年被兼并

politics.zh: 塞琉古帝国由马其顿将领塞琉古一世于公元前312年建立，继承亚历山大帝国在近东的大部分领土，以塞琉西亚与安条克为中心。前3世纪与托勒密王朝争夺科艾莱叙利亚，同时面临东部行省分离与帕提亚、巴克特里亚的兴起。前2世纪后版图缩小到叙利亚一带，前63年被罗马的庞培兼并。
politics.en: The Seleucid Empire was founded by the Macedonian general Seleucus I Nicator in 312 BCE, inheriting most of Alexander's Near Eastern territories and ruling from Seleucia and Antioch. In the third century BCE it fought the Ptolemies over Coele-Syria while eastern provinces broke away and Parthia and Bactria rose. After the second century its territory shrank to Syria, and Pompey annexed it for Rome in 63 BCE.

economy.zh: 经济以叙利亚与美索不达米亚的农业为基础，种植谷物、橄榄与葡萄，并经营手工业与贸易。安条克与塞琉西亚是地中海与东方商路的枢纽，连接印度、中亚与希腊世界。王室通过土地授予、税收与铸币管理经济，希腊移民城市成为行政与商业中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in Syria and Mesopotamia, growing grain, olives and grapes, with crafts and trade alongside. Antioch and Seleucia were hubs linking the Mediterranean to routes towards India and Central Asia and to the Greek world. The crown managed the economy through land grants, taxation and coinage, and Greek settler cities became administrative and commercial centres.

culture.zh: 塞琉古王朝推行希腊化政策，建立希腊式城市、剧场与体育场，同时承认本地神庙与习俗。希腊语成为行政与文学语言，巴比伦与叙利亚的学术传统继续发展，天文观测与楔形文字文书延续。艺术与宗教出现希腊与近东元素的混合，王室崇拜与地方神祇并存。
culture.en: The Seleucids promoted Hellenistic institutions, founding Greek-style cities, theatres and gymnasia while recognising local temples and customs. Greek served administration and literature, and Babylonian and Syrian scholarly traditions continued, including astronomical observation and cuneiform records. Art and religion mixed Greek and Near Eastern elements, and ruler cult coexisted with local deities.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前312年建国、前3世纪与托勒密的叙利亚战争、前3世纪中叶东部行省分离、前2世纪罗马介入，以及前63年被罗马兼并。
events.en: Key moments include the founding in 312 BCE, the Syrian wars with the Ptolemies in the third century, the loss of the eastern provinces in the mid-third century, Roman intervention in the second, and annexation by Rome in 63 BCE.

value.zh: 塞琉古一世于前312年建立塞琉古帝国，继承亚历山大在近东的大部分领土。
value.en: Seleucus I founded the Seleucid Empire in 312 BCE, inheriting most of Alexander's Near Eastern territory.

value.zh: 前3世纪塞琉古与托勒密围绕科艾莱叙利亚进行多次战争。
value.en: In the third century BCE the Seleucids and Ptolemies fought repeated wars over Coele-Syria.

value.zh: 前63年罗马的庞培兼并塞琉古残余领土，王朝终结。
value.en: Pompey annexed the remaining Seleucid territory for Rome in 63 BCE, ending the dynasty.

sources.title: Kingdom of Armenia (antiquity)
supports: The Kingdom of Greater Armenia from the fourth century BCE
The Orontid, Artaxiad and Arsacid dynasties
Tigranes the Great and his short-lived empire
Conversion to Christianity and the partition between Rome and Iran

sources.title: 亞美尼亞王國
supports: 公元前4世纪起的大亚美尼亚王国
奥龙特、阿尔塔克夏与阿尔萨息王朝
提格兰二世的短暂帝国
皈依基督教与罗马、伊朗之间的分割

politics.zh: 大亚美尼亚王国位于亚美尼亚高原，存在于公元前4世纪至公元428年，历经奥龙特、阿尔塔克夏与阿尔萨息三个王朝，多数时期是罗马与伊朗之间的属国。提格兰二世在前1世纪一度建立从里海到地中海的短暂帝国，后被罗马击败。301年前后接受基督教，428年被罗马与萨珊分割，王国终结。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Greater Armenia lay on the Armenian highlands and existed from the fourth century BCE to 428 CE under the Orontid, Artaxiad and Arsacid dynasties, for most of that time a client of Rome and Iran. Tigranes the Great briefly built an empire from the Caspian to the Mediterranean in the first century BCE before Rome defeated him. Christianity was adopted around 301, and in 428 the kingdom was partitioned between Rome and the Sasanians.

economy.zh: 经济以高原农业与畜牧为基础，种植谷物、葡萄与果树，并经营马匹和矿产。亚美尼亚位于连接黑海、里海与美索不达米亚的商路上，输出金属、马匹、葡萄酒与手工业品，输入纺织品与奢侈品。城市如阿尔塔沙特与瓦加尔沙帕特是行政与商业中心，贵族家族掌握土地与地方权力。
economy.en: The economy rested on highland farming and herding, growing grain, grapes and fruit and raising horses, with mining as well. Armenia lay on routes between the Black Sea, the Caspian and Mesopotamia, exporting metals, horses, wine and crafts and importing textiles and luxuries. Cities such as Artaxata and Vagharshapat were administrative and commercial centres, and noble families held land and local power.

culture.zh: 亚美尼亚在301年前后成为最早以基督教为国教的国家之一，教会与修道院后来成为文化与教育的中心。亚美尼亚语在5世纪由梅斯罗普·马什托茨创制字母，用于翻译圣经与本地文献。前基督教时期的祆教与本地神祇崇拜留下遗迹，建筑、石雕与手抄本装饰形成独特传统。
culture.en: Armenia became one of the first states to adopt Christianity as its religion around 301, and churches and monasteries later became centres of culture and education. The Armenian alphabet was created by Mesrop Mashtots in the fifth century for translating the Bible and local texts. Pre-Christian Zoroastrian and local cults left traces, and architecture, stone carving and manuscript illumination formed a distinctive tradition.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前4世纪奥龙特王朝、前189年阿尔塔克夏王朝建立、前1世纪提格兰二世的扩张与被罗马击败、301年前后皈依基督教，以及428年王国被罗马与萨珊分割。
events.en: Key moments include the Orontid dynasty in the fourth century BCE, the establishment of the Artaxiad dynasty in 189 BCE, Tigranes the Great's expansion and defeat by Rome in the first century BCE, the adoption of Christianity around 301, and the partition of the kingdom between Rome and the Sasanians in 428.

value.zh: 提格兰二世在前1世纪建立从里海到地中海的短暂帝国，后被罗马击败。
value.en: Tigranes the Great briefly built an empire from the Caspian to the Mediterranean in the first century BCE before Rome defeated him.

value.zh: 亚美尼亚在301年前后接受基督教，是最早以基督教为国教的国家之一。
value.en: Armenia adopted Christianity around 301, among the first states to make it the state religion.

value.zh: 5世纪梅斯罗普·马什托茨创制亚美尼亚字母，用于圣经翻译与本地文献。
value.en: Mesrop Mashtots created the Armenian alphabet in the fifth century for Bible translation and local texts.

sources.title: Xiongnu
supports: The Xiongnu confederation on the eastern Eurasian steppe from the third century BCE
Modu Chanyu and the empire centred on the Mongolian plateau
Relations with the Han dynasty, tribute and the Silk Road
The split into southern and northern groups after 48 CE

sources.title: 匈奴
supports: 前3世纪起东欧亚草原的匈奴联盟
冒顿单于与以蒙古高原为中心的帝国
与汉朝的关系、和亲与丝绸之路
公元48年后南北分裂

politics.zh: 匈奴是公元前3世纪起活动于东欧亚草原的游牧联盟，冒顿单于在公元前209年后统一诸部，建立以蒙古高原为中心的政权。单于之下设左右贤王等官职，分东西两翼管理部众。与汉朝长期和战交替，既有和亲与岁币，也有大规模战争。公元48年分裂为南匈奴与北匈奴，此后势力衰落。
politics.en: The Xiongnu were a nomadic confederation on the eastern Eurasian steppe from the third century BCE. Modu Chanyu unified the tribes after 209 BCE and built a state centred on the Mongolian plateau, with the chanyu ruling through left and right wings and appointed officials. Relations with the Han dynasty alternated between marriage alliances and tribute and large-scale war. In 48 CE the confederation split into southern and northern groups and its power declined.

economy.zh: 经济以游牧畜牧为主，饲养马、牛、羊与骆驼，兼营狩猎和有限农业。匈奴通过与汉朝的贸易、赏赐和战争获取粮食、丝绸、铁器与铜钱，并向西域诸国征收贡赋。马匹是军事与交换的核心资源，草原通道连接中原、西域与中亚。
economy.en: The economy was mainly pastoral, herding horses, cattle, sheep and camels with hunting and limited farming. Through trade, gifts and war with the Han the Xiongnu obtained grain, silk, iron tools and coins, and they levied tribute on oasis states to the west. Horses were the key military and exchange resource, and steppe routes linked China, the western regions and Central Asia.

culture.zh: 匈奴实行部落联盟与贵族议事制度，王族挛鞮氏世代担任单于，贵族联姻与盟誓维系联盟。丧葬习俗包括木椁墓与随葬品，诺彦乌拉等墓葬出土丝织品、毛毡与金银器，反映与汉地和中亚的交流。萨满信仰与自然崇拜见于史料，语言归属仍有争议。
culture.en: The Xiongnu combined tribal confederation with noble councils; the Luandi clan supplied the chanyu and marriage alliances and oaths held the union together. Burial customs included timber-chamber tombs with grave goods, and tombs such as Noin-Ula have yielded silk, felt and gold and silver objects showing exchange with China and Central Asia. Shamanic and nature beliefs appear in the sources, and the language affiliation remains disputed.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前209年冒顿单于统一诸部、前200年白登之围与和亲、前2世纪与汉朝的战争与贸易、前1世纪分裂与呼韩邪单于归汉，以及公元48年南北匈奴分裂。
events.en: Key moments include Modu Chanyu's unification after 209 BCE, the siege of Baideng and the marriage alliance of 200 BCE, wars and trade with the Han in the second century BCE, division and the submission of one chanyu in the first century BCE, and the split into southern and northern Xiongnu in 48 CE.

value.zh: 冒顿单于在公元前209年后统一匈奴诸部，建立草原帝国。
value.en: Modu Chanyu unified the Xiongnu tribes after 209 BCE and founded the steppe empire.

value.zh: 匈奴与汉朝长期和战交替，既有和亲岁币也有大规模战争。
value.en: Relations with the Han dynasty alternated between marriage alliances and tribute and large-scale war.

value.zh: 公元48年匈奴分裂为南匈奴与北匈奴，此后势力衰落。
value.en: In 48 CE the Xiongnu split into southern and northern groups and their power declined.

sources.title: Chu (state)
supports: Chu as a Zhou-era state in the Yangtze valley
Its growth into one of the strongest states of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods
Kings such as Zhuang of Chu and the title of king from 704 BCE
Conquest by Qin in 223 BCE and Chu culture

sources.title: 楚国
supports: 楚国是长江流域的周代诸侯国
春秋战国时期最强大的诸侯国之一
楚庄王与公元前704年称王
前223年被秦所灭与楚文化

politics.zh: 楚国是周代位于长江中游的诸侯国，国君芈姓熊氏，初居丹阳，后迁郢。春秋时期楚武王于前704年自立为王，楚庄王一度成为中原霸主；战国时期楚国疆域西起大巴山、东至海、南达五岭，是七雄中面积最大者。前223年被秦所灭。
politics.en: Chu was a Zhou-era state in the middle Yangtze valley. Its rulers bore the clan name Mi and the lineage name Xiong, first at Danyang and later at Ying. In the Spring and Autumn period King Wu of Chu took the royal title in 704 BCE and King Zhuang briefly became hegemon in the Central Plains; in the Warring States period Chu stretched from the Daba mountains to the sea and south to the Five Ridges, the largest of the seven powers, until Qin conquered it in 223 BCE.

economy.zh: 经济以长江与汉水流域的水稻种植为基础，兼营渔业、林业与矿产。楚国铜矿与冶铸业发达，曾铸造蚁鼻钱等货币，漆器、丝织与青铜器工艺精良。江汉平原与南阳盆地是粮食产区，水路交通连接巴蜀、吴越与中原，商业城市如郢、陈、寿春繁荣。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Yangtze and Han river valleys with fishing, forestry and mining. Chu had rich copper mines and metalworking, minted coin such as the ant-nose money and produced fine lacquerware, silk and bronzes. The Jianghan plain and Nanyang basin produced grain, waterways linked Sichuan, Wu and Yue and the Central Plains, and commercial cities such as Ying, Chen and Shouchun flourished.

culture.zh: 楚文化以巫觋传统、浪漫文学与漆器艺术著称，屈原的《离骚》与楚辞是代表作。楚人崇奉东皇太一、湘君等神祇，墓葬出土的帛画、编钟与镇墓兽显示独特的宗教与艺术面貌。楚文字与中原文字同源而有地方特点，曾侯乙编钟等发现反映音乐成就。
culture.en: Chu culture is known for its shamanic traditions, romantic literature and lacquer art, with Qu Yuan's Li Sao and the Chu ci as its best-known works. The people worshipped deities such as Donghuang Taiyi and the Xiang goddesses, and tomb finds of silk paintings, bronze bells and tomb guardian figures show a distinctive religion and art. Chu script shared origins with Central Plains writing but had local features, and discoveries such as the Marquis Yi bells reflect its music.

events.zh: 关键节点包括西周初年受封、前704年楚武王称王、前7至前6世纪楚庄王争霸、前278年秦军攻陷郢都、前223年被秦灭国，以及此后楚地文化对汉朝的影响。
events.en: Key moments include the enfeoffment in the early Western Zhou, the royal title taken by King Wu in 704 BCE, the hegemony of King Zhuang in the seventh and sixth centuries BCE, the Qin capture of Ying in 278 BCE, the extinction of the state in 223 BCE, and the later influence of Chu culture on the Han dynasty.

value.zh: 前704年楚武王自立为王，是春秋时期较早称王的诸侯。
value.en: King Wu of Chu took the royal title in 704 BCE, among the earliest rulers to do so in the Spring and Autumn period.

value.zh: 前278年秦军攻陷楚都郢，楚国被迫东迁。
value.en: Qin forces captured the Chu capital Ying in 278 BCE, forcing the state to move east.

value.zh: 前223年楚国被秦所灭，其地并入秦朝。
value.en: Chu was conquered by Qin in 223 BCE and its territory was absorbed into the Qin empire.

sources.title: Tibetan Empire
supports: The Yarlung dynasty and the empire formed under Songtsen Gampo in the seventh century
Expansion under Trisong Detsen and Tritsuk Detsen
Relations with Tang China, Nepal and Central Asia
The collapse of the empire in the mid-ninth century

sources.title: 吐蕃
supports: 雅隆王朝与7世纪松赞干布时期的帝国形成
赤松德赞与赤祖德赞时期的扩张
与唐朝、尼泊尔和中亚的关系
9世纪中叶帝国崩溃

politics.zh: 吐蕃是7世纪初至9世纪中叶存在于青藏高原的藏人帝国，由雅隆王朝的松赞干布在7世纪统一诸部并建都逻些（今拉萨）。他创制文字、制定法律并与唐朝、尼泊尔联姻。赤松德赞与赤祖德赞时期疆域扩展至帕米尔、云南与印度北部，一度攻入长安。9世纪中叶因继承争端与内乱崩溃。
politics.en: The Tibetan Empire existed on the plateau from the early seventh to the mid-ninth centuries. Songtsen Gampo of the Yarlung dynasty unified the tribes, made Lhasa his capital, created a script, issued laws and married into the Tang and Nepalese royal houses. Under Trisong Detsen and Tritsuk Detsen the empire expanded towards the Pamirs, Yunnan and northern India and briefly occupied Chang'an. Dynastic disputes and internal conflict brought it down in the mid-ninth century.

economy.zh: 经济以高原畜牧与河谷农业为基础，饲养牦牛、绵羊与马，雅鲁藏布江河谷种植青稞、小麦与豆类。吐蕃控制青藏高原的商路，与唐朝、中亚和南亚进行茶马、丝绸、麝香与金银贸易。王室与寺院占有土地和牧场，驿站制度支持军政与贸易。
economy.en: The economy combined highland herding of yaks, sheep and horses with valley farming of barley, wheat and pulses in the Yarlung Tsangpo valley. Tibet controlled routes across the plateau, trading tea, horses, silk, musk and precious metals with Tang China, Central Asia and South Asia. The crown and monasteries held land and pasture, and a relay-station system supported administration, war and trade.

culture.zh: 松赞干布时期创制藏文，佛教在赤松德赞时期由印度与汉地传入并建立桑耶寺，译经事业开始。苯教与佛教并存，王室赞助佛教与译师，形成藏传佛教早期传统。建筑、绘画与金属工艺融合印度、尼泊尔与汉地风格，敦煌文献记录了吐蕃时期的语言与行政。
culture.en: A Tibetan script was created in Songtsen Gampo's time, and under Trisong Detsen Buddhism arrived from India and China with the founding of Samye and the start of translation work. Bon and Buddhism coexisted while the court patronised Buddhism and translators, forming the early tradition of Tibetan Buddhism. Architecture, painting and metalwork combined Indian, Nepalese and Chinese styles, and the Dunhuang documents record the language and administration of the period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪初松赞干布统一与建都拉萨、641年与唐朝文成公主联姻、8世纪赤松德赞时期扩张与建桑耶寺、763年一度攻入长安，以及9世纪中叶朗达玛死后帝国崩溃。
events.en: Key moments include Songtsen Gampo's unification and the move of the capital to Lhasa in the early seventh century, the marriage alliance with the Tang princess Wencheng in 641, expansion and the founding of Samye under Trisong Detsen in the eighth century, the brief occupation of Chang'an in 763, and the collapse of the empire after the death of Langdarma in the mid-ninth century.

value.zh: 松赞干布在7世纪统一青藏高原诸部，建都逻些并创制藏文。
value.en: Songtsen Gampo unified the plateau tribes in the seventh century, made Lhasa his capital and created a Tibetan script.

value.zh: 8世纪赤松德赞时期佛教正式传入并建立桑耶寺。
value.en: Buddhism was formally established under Trisong Detsen in the eighth century with the founding of Samye.

value.zh: 9世纪中叶继承争端与内乱导致帝国崩溃。
value.en: Dynastic disputes and internal conflict brought the empire down in the mid-ninth century.

sources.title: Western Xia
supports: The Tangut state founded in 1038 with its capital at Xingqing, today's Yinchuan
Tangut script and a mixed Tangut, Han and Tibetan administration
Wars and diplomacy with the Song, Liao and Jin
Destruction by the Mongols in 1227

sources.title: 西夏
supports: 1038年建立的党项政权，都城兴庆（今银川）
西夏文字与党项、汉、藏并用的行政
与宋、辽、金的战争与外交
1227年被蒙古所灭

politics.zh: 西夏是1038年由党项首领李元昊建立的政权，国号大夏，都城兴庆（今银川），控制黄河上游与河西走廊。官制兼采唐宋制度与党项旧俗，设中书、枢密等机构，同时保留部落军事组织。西夏与宋、辽、金长期和战，1227年被蒙古军队灭亡。
politics.en: Western Xia was founded in 1038 by the Tangut leader Li Yuanhao under the name Great Xia, with its capital at Xingqing, today's Yinchuan, controlling the upper Yellow River and the Hexi corridor. Its government combined Tang and Song institutions with Tangut custom, with central bureaus alongside tribal military organisation. It warred and negotiated with the Song, Liao and Jin until Mongol armies destroyed it in 1227.

economy.zh: 经济以河套与河西走廊的灌溉农业为基础，种植小麦、水稻与大麦，并经营畜牧业。西夏位于丝绸之路东段，控制中西贸易并征收过境税，输出马匹、盐、毛皮与药材，输入丝绸、茶叶与瓷器。黑水城等城市是商业与行政中心，出土文书反映其经济管理。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming in the Hetao and Hexi corridor, growing wheat, rice and barley, along with herding. Western Xia controlled the eastern Silk Road and taxed transit trade, exporting horses, salt, furs and medicines and importing silk, tea and ceramics. Cities such as Khara-Khoto were commercial and administrative centres, and excavated documents show its economic administration.

culture.zh: 西夏创制了自己的文字，用于公文、佛经与法律文书，同时使用汉文与藏文。佛教是国家宗教，寺院与译经事业发达，黑水城与敦煌出土大量西夏文佛典。建筑、绘画与印刷技术融合汉、藏与中亚元素，西夏文佛经是现存最早的活字印刷实物之一。
culture.en: Western Xia created its own script for official documents, Buddhist texts and law while also using Chinese and Tibetan. Buddhism was the state religion and monasteries and translation projects flourished, with many Tangut Buddhist texts found at Khara-Khoto and Dunhuang. Architecture, painting and printing combined Chinese, Tibetan and Central Asian elements, and Tangut Buddhist prints are among the earliest surviving movable-type materials.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1038年李元昊称帝建夏、1040年代与宋的战争与和议、12世纪与金朝并立、1205年起蒙古多次进攻，以及1227年西夏灭亡。
events.en: Key moments include Li Yuanhao's proclamation of the empire in 1038, the wars and peace with the Song in the 1040s, coexistence with the Jin in the twelfth century, repeated Mongol attacks from 1205, and the destruction of Western Xia in 1227.

value.zh: 1038年李元昊称帝，国号大夏，以兴庆为都。
value.en: Li Yuanhao proclaimed the Great Xia empire in 1038 with Xingqing as its capital.

value.zh: 西夏创制本民族文字，用于公文与佛经，同时使用汉文和藏文。
value.en: Western Xia created its own script for documents and Buddhist texts while also using Chinese and Tibetan.

value.zh: 1227年蒙古军队灭亡西夏。
value.en: Mongol armies destroyed Western Xia in 1227.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 8 territory records for this polity, covering 990 CE to 1226 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Jin dynasty (1115–1234)
supports: The Jurchen state founded by Wanyan Aguda in 1115
The conquest of the Liao in 1125 and of northern Song China in 1127
Rule over northern China, the move to Zhongdu and administration
The Mongol conquest and the fall of the dynasty in 1234

sources.title: 金朝
supports: 1115年完颜阿骨打建立的女真政权
1125年灭辽与1127年灭北宋
统治华北、迁都中都与行政制度
蒙古征服与1234年王朝覆灭

politics.zh: 金朝由女真首领完颜阿骨打于1115年建立，国号大金，都会宁府。1125年灭辽，1127年攻灭北宋，占领华北并迁都中都（今北京）。金朝采用汉制设尚书省与科举，同时保留猛安谋克等女真军事组织。与南宋长期对峙，1211年起蒙古入侵，1234年在蒙古与南宋夹击下灭亡。
politics.en: The Jin dynasty was founded by the Jurchen leader Wanyan Aguda in 1115 with its capital at Huining. It destroyed the Liao in 1125 and northern Song China in 1127, occupied northern China and moved its capital to Zhongdu, today's Beijing. The court adopted Chinese institutions such as the secretariat and examinations while keeping Jurchen military units. It faced the Southern Song for a century until Mongol invasions from 1211 ended it in 1234 under Mongol and Song attack.

economy.zh: 经济以华北平原的农业为基础，种植小麦、粟与水稻，并经营纺织、陶瓷与冶铁。金朝发行纸币交钞，征收田赋与商税，控制与南宋和中亚的贸易。中都、开封等城市商业繁荣，河东盐池与北方铁矿是重要资源，女真贵族在中原占有大量土地。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming the north China plain, growing wheat, millet and rice, with textiles, ceramics and ironworking. The Jin issued paper money, levied land and commercial taxes and controlled trade with the Southern Song and Central Asia. Cities such as Zhongdu and Kaifeng were commercially active, the Hedong salt pools and northern iron mines were key resources, and Jurchen nobles held much land in the plains.

culture.zh: 金朝在制度与文化上兼采汉、女真与契丹传统，女真文字用于官方文书，汉文文学与科举继续发展。戏曲与说唱在都市兴起，元好问等文人记录了这一时期的文学成就。佛教、道教与民间信仰并存，建筑与雕塑延续宋辽风格并形成北方特点。
culture.en: Jin institutions and culture combined Han, Jurchen and Khitan traditions. Jurchen script served official documents while Chinese literature and examinations continued, drama and storytelling grew in the cities, and writers such as Yuan Haowen recorded the period's literary achievement. Buddhism, Daoism and popular religion coexisted, and architecture and sculpture continued Song and Liao styles with northern features.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1115年建国、1125年灭辽、1127年灭北宋与占领华北、1153年迁都中都、1211年起蒙古入侵，以及1234年蔡州陷落、金朝灭亡。
events.en: Key moments include the founding in 1115, the destruction of the Liao in 1125, the fall of northern Song China in 1127 and occupation of the north, the move of the capital to Zhongdu in 1153, Mongol invasions from 1211, and the fall of Caizhou in 1234 that ended the dynasty.

value.zh: 1115年完颜阿骨打建立金朝，都会宁府。
value.en: Wanyan Aguda founded the Jin dynasty in 1115 with its capital at Huining.

value.zh: 1127年金朝攻灭北宋，占领华北，与南宋长期对峙。
value.en: The Jin destroyed northern Song China in 1127, occupied the north and faced the Southern Song for a century.

value.zh: 1234年金朝在蒙古与南宋夹击下灭亡。
value.en: The dynasty fell in 1234 under combined Mongol and Southern Song attack.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据仅收录该政体 5 条记录（公元1126 年至公元1235 年），覆盖很薄，叙述以所列维基百科条目为主要依据，不能据本站疆域记录推断其疆域变化。 本站疆域记录覆盖1126—1235年（5 条），覆盖很薄；1115年建国至1125年的阶段作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds only 5 territory records for this polity (1126 CE to 1235 CE), a thin coverage: the essay rests mainly on the listed Wikipedia articles and the territory records here cannot support claims about territorial change. The territory records cover 1126-1235 (five records), a thin coverage; the years from the founding in 1115 to 1125 appear as background.

sources.title: Polis
supports: The polis as a self-governing city-state with its own constitution
The Archaic and Classical periods, colonisation and the Persian wars
Athenian democracy, Sparta and the Peloponnesian war
The Hellenistic period and Roman conquest

sources.title: 古希腊
supports: 城邦是有宪法与公民义务的自治政治体
古风与古典时期、殖民与波希战争
雅典民主、斯巴达与伯罗奔尼撒战争
希腊化时期与罗马征服

politics.zh: 希腊城邦是公元前9世纪后重新兴起的自治政治体，以卫城、市集与公民大会为中心，各有宪法与神祇。公元前5世纪初雅典与斯巴达领导城邦联军在波希战争中击败波斯，雅典民主制度在此时发展。伯罗奔尼撒战争后城邦体系衰弱，前4世纪被马其顿支配，前2世纪起受罗马控制。
politics.en: The Greek poleis were self-governing political communities that re-emerged after the ninth century BCE, centred on an acropolis, an agora and an assembly of citizens, each with its own constitution and cults. In the early fifth century BCE Athens and Sparta led the Greek alliance against Persia, and Athenian democracy developed in this period. After the Peloponnesian War the system weakened, Macedon dominated in the fourth century and Rome took control from the second.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、橄榄与葡萄种植为基础，手工业与矿业提供陶器、金属器和白银。城邦通过殖民在地中海与黑海沿岸建立农业与贸易据点，交换谷物、木材、金属与奴隶。比雷埃夫斯等港口连接区域市场，神庙与城邦金库参与信贷与货币发行，货币经济在古典时期扩展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, olives and vines, with crafts and mining producing pottery, metalwork and silver. Through colonisation the poleis established farming and trading settlements around the Mediterranean and Black Sea, exchanging grain, timber, metals and slaves. Ports such as Piraeus connected regional markets, temples and city treasuries took part in credit and minting, and the money economy expanded in the Classical period.

culture.zh: 城邦文化以神话、竞技、戏剧与哲学为核心，德尔斐与奥林匹亚是跨城邦的宗教中心。雅典的剧场、学园与公共建筑体现了公民生活的公开性，雕塑与建筑形成古典风格。历史、医学与自然哲学在城邦环境中发展，希腊语与字母文字传播到地中海各地。
culture.en: Civic culture centred on myth, athletics, drama and philosophy, with Delphi and Olympia as Panhellenic religious centres. The theatres, schools and public buildings of Athens expressed the public character of citizen life, and sculpture and architecture defined the Classical style. History, medicine and natural philosophy developed in the poleis, and Greek language and script spread across the Mediterranean.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前8至前6世纪的殖民与僭主时期、前508年前后雅典民主改革、前490与前480年波希战争、前431—404年伯罗奔尼撒战争、前338年喀罗尼亚战役，以及前2世纪罗马征服希腊。
events.en: Key moments include colonisation and tyranny from the eighth to the sixth centuries BCE, the Athenian democratic reforms around 508 BCE, the Persian wars of 490 and 480, the Peloponnesian War of 431-404, the battle of Chaeronea in 338, and the Roman conquest of Greece in the second century BCE.

value.zh: 城邦拥有自己的宪法与神祇，要求公民的最高忠诚。
value.en: Each polis had its own constitution and cults and demanded the supreme loyalty of its citizens.

value.zh: 前508年前后雅典推行民主改革，公民大会与抽签制度逐步形成。
value.en: Athenian democracy took shape after the reforms around 508 BCE, with an assembly and selection by lot.

value.zh: 前338年喀罗尼亚战役后，马其顿取得对希腊城邦的主导权。
value.en: After the battle of Chaeronea in 338 BCE Macedon dominated the Greek poleis.

editorialNotes.zh: 本站疆域数据收录该政体 53 条记录，年份范围为公元前800 年至公元83 年，本条目断代与这些记录一致；叙述依据所列维基百科条目。 本站疆域记录覆盖前800—前83年；此前的迈锡尼与黑暗时代作为背景写入。
editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 53 territory records for this polity, covering 800 BCE to 83 CE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover 800-83 BCE; the Mycenaean period and the Dark Age appear as background.

sources.title: Roman Republic
supports: The republic traditionally dated from 509 BCE to 27 BCE
The senate, magistrates and the contest between patricians and plebeians
Expansion across Italy and the Mediterranean, and the Punic wars
The civil wars of the first century BCE and the rise of Augustus

sources.title: 罗马共和国
supports: 传统上从前509年至前27年的共和国
元老院、官职体系与贵族平民之争
意大利与地中海扩张、布匿战争
前1世纪内战与奥古斯都的兴起

politics.zh: 罗马共和国传统上始于公元前509年王政被推翻，由元老院、执政官与公民大会共同治理，官职一年一任并设同僚制。经过贵族与平民的斗争，平民保民官与法律逐步确立。共和国通过同盟体系控制意大利，并在布匿战争中击败迦太基，征服地中海各地。前1世纪内战频发，前27年奥古斯都建立元首制，共和国体制终结。
politics.en: The Roman Republic traditionally began in 509 BCE when the monarchy was overthrown. The senate, consuls and citizen assemblies governed together, with annual magistracies held in pairs. Conflict between patricians and plebeians produced tribunes and written law. Through alliances Rome controlled Italy, defeated Carthage in the Punic wars and conquered the Mediterranean. Civil wars in the first century BCE ended with Augustus establishing the principate in 27 BCE.

economy.zh: 经济以意大利的农业为基础，共和后期大庄园与奴隶劳动扩张，葡萄与橄榄种植面向市场。行省税收、战争战利品与奴隶贸易带来巨额财富，罗马与奥斯提亚是消费与转运中心。道路、港口与货币体系支持地中海贸易，骑士阶层从事包税与金融活动。
economy.en: The economy rested on Italian agriculture; in the late Republic large estates and slave labour expanded, with vines and olives grown for the market. Provincial taxation, war booty and the slave trade brought great wealth, and Rome and Ostia were centres of consumption and transshipment. Roads, ports and coinage supported Mediterranean trade, and the equestrian order engaged in tax farming and finance.

culture.zh: 共和国文化融合拉丁、伊特鲁里亚与希腊元素，法律、修辞与史学著述发达。神庙、广场与道路体现公共建筑传统，希腊哲学与艺术在征服后被引入并改造。拉丁语在西地中海传播，公民权逐步扩大，为后来的帝国文化奠定基础。
culture.en: Republican culture combined Latin, Etruscan and Greek elements, and law, rhetoric and historiography flourished. Temples, fora and roads express its public architecture, while Greek philosophy and art were adopted and adapted after conquest. Latin spread in the western Mediterranean and citizenship gradually widened, laying the base for imperial culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前509年建立共和国、前264—146年布匿战争、前133年起格拉古兄弟改革、前49年凯撒渡卢比孔河、前44年凯撒遇刺，以及前27年奥古斯都建立元首制。
events.en: Key moments include the founding of the republic in 509 BCE, the Punic wars of 264-146, the Gracchan reforms from 133, Caesar crossing the Rubicon in 49, his assassination in 44, and Augustus establishing the principate in 27 BCE.

value.zh: 罗马共和国传统上建立于前509年，王政被推翻后由元老院与执政官治理。
value.en: The Roman Republic is traditionally dated to 509 BCE, when the monarchy was replaced by rule through the senate and consuls.

value.zh: 前264至前146年的布匿战争后，罗马击败迦太基并控制西地中海。
value.en: After the Punic wars of 264-146 BCE Rome defeated Carthage and controlled the western Mediterranean.

value.zh: 前27年奥古斯都建立元首制，共和国时期结束。
value.en: Augustus established the principate in 27 BCE, ending the republican period.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 50 territory records for this polity, covering 500 BCE to 32 BCE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles.

sources.title: Macedonia (ancient kingdom)
supports: The ancient kingdom of Macedon in northern Greece
Philip II, the army reforms and the domination of Greece
Alexander the Great's conquest of the Persian Empire
The wars of the successors and the Hellenistic kingdoms

sources.title: 馬其頓王國
supports: 希腊北部的古代马其顿王国
腓力二世的军事改革与对希腊的控制
亚历山大大帝征服波斯帝国
继业者战争与希腊化诸王国

politics.zh: 马其顿王国位于希腊北部，公元前4世纪中叶腓力二世进行军事改革，建立常备军与方阵，前338年喀罗尼亚战役后主导希腊城邦。其子亚历山大大帝于前334年东征，灭波斯帝国，疆域西起巴尔干、东至印度河。前323年亚历山大去世后，将领们展开继业者战争，帝国分裂为托勒密、塞琉古等希腊化王国。
politics.en: The kingdom of Macedon lay in northern Greece. In the mid-fourth century BCE Philip II reformed the army with a standing force and phalanx and, after Chaeronea in 338, dominated the Greek poleis. His son Alexander campaigned east from 334, destroyed the Persian Empire and ruled from the Balkans to the Indus. After Alexander's death in 323 his generals fought the wars of the successors and the empire split into Hellenistic kingdoms such as Ptolemaic Egypt and the Seleucid realm.

economy.zh: 经济以农业与畜牧业为基础，平原出产谷物，山地提供木材与矿产。马其顿拥有潘盖翁山金矿与银矿，为军事扩张提供财政支持。港口如安菲波利斯与后来的亚历山大里亚连接爱琴海与东方贸易，征服后波斯国库与商路带来巨额财富。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding: the plains produced grain and the mountains supplied timber and minerals. The gold and silver mines of Mount Pangaion funded military expansion. Ports such as Amphipolis and later Alexandria linked the Aegean to eastern trade, and after the conquest the Persian treasury and trade routes brought great wealth.

culture.zh: 马其顿宫廷吸收希腊文化，赞助诗人、医生与哲学家，亚里士多德曾任亚历山大之师。王室墓葬的金器与壁画显示工艺与艺术成就，都城佩拉与埃盖是政治与文化中心。东征后希腊语与希腊城市制度传播到西亚与埃及，形成希腊化文化。
culture.en: The Macedonian court absorbed Greek culture and patronised poets, physicians and philosophers, with Aristotle tutoring Alexander. The goldwork and wall paintings of the royal tombs show its craft and art, and the capitals at Pella and Aigai were political and cultural centres. After the conquest Greek language and civic institutions spread across West Asia and Egypt, forming Hellenistic culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括前359年腓力二世即位与军事改革、前338年喀罗尼亚战役、前336年腓力遇刺与亚历山大即位、前334年起东征、前323年亚历山大去世，以及随后的继业者战争。
events.en: Key moments include Philip II's accession and army reform in 359 BCE, the battle of Chaeronea in 338, Philip's assassination and Alexander's accession in 336, the eastern campaign from 334, Alexander's death in 323, and the wars of the successors that followed.

value.zh: 腓力二世在前4世纪中叶改革军队，前338年喀罗尼亚战役后主导希腊。
value.en: Philip II reformed the army in the mid-fourth century BCE and dominated Greece after Chaeronea in 338.

value.zh: 亚历山大大帝前334年起东征，灭亡波斯帝国，疆域抵达印度河。
value.en: Alexander campaigned east from 334 BCE, destroyed the Persian Empire and reached the Indus.

value.zh: 前323年亚历山大去世后，继业者战争导致帝国分裂为若干希腊化王国。
value.en: After Alexander's death in 323 BCE the wars of the successors split the empire into several Hellenistic kingdoms.

editorialNotes.en: This atlas holds 34 territory records for this polity, covering 675 BCE to 292 BCE; the entry scope matches those records and the essay follows the listed Wikipedia articles. The territory records cover 675-292 BCE; the later empire and the wars of the successors appear as background.

sources.title: Ancient Carthage
supports: Carthage as a Phoenician colony founded around 814 BCE that became independent
Naval power and control of the western Mediterranean
Trade networks, agriculture and the Punic wars with Rome
The destruction of Carthage in 146 BCE

sources.title: 古迦太基
supports: 约前814年建立的腓尼基殖民地并走向独立
海上力量与对西地中海的控制
贸易网络、农业与对罗马的布匿战争
前146年迦太基被毁

politics.zh: 古迦太基约于公元前814年由推罗商人建立，前7世纪独立后成为西地中海的主要势力。国家由两位年度执政官（苏菲特）与元老院治理，另有公民大会与军事将领。迦太基控制北非沿海、撒丁尼亚、科西嘉、西西里西部与伊比利亚南部。与罗马进行三次布匿战争，前146年被罗马攻灭，城市被毁。
politics.en: Ancient Carthage was founded around 814 BCE by merchants from Tyre and became independent in the seventh century BCE as the leading power of the western Mediterranean. Two annual suffetes and a senate governed, with a citizens' assembly and military commanders. Carthage controlled the North African coast, Sardinia, Corsica, western Sicily and southern Iberia. It fought three Punic wars with Rome and was destroyed in 146 BCE.

economy.zh: 经济以海上贸易为核心，迦太基港口连接北非、伊比利亚、西西里与地中海东部，输出农产品、金属、纺织品与奴隶。北非内陆的橄榄、葡萄与谷物种植由庄园经营，使用奴隶与本地劳工。手工业包括造船、陶器与金属加工，货币与商站网络支撑远程贸易。
economy.en: Maritime trade was central: Carthaginian ports linked North Africa, Iberia, Sicily and the eastern Mediterranean, exporting farm produce, metals, textiles and slaves. Estates in the North African hinterland grew olives, vines and grain with slave and local labour. Crafts included shipbuilding, pottery and metalwork, and coinage and trading posts supported long-distance commerce.

culture.zh: 迦太基文化源于腓尼基，使用布匿语与字母文字，宗教崇拜巴力·哈蒙与塔尼特，祭祀与神庙遍布各地。艺术与建筑融合腓尼基、希腊与北非元素，港口与城墙规模宏大。文献多已散失，今人对迦太基的了解部分依赖希腊罗马作者的记述与考古发现。
culture.en: Carthaginian culture came from Phoenicia: Punic was written in an alphabetic script and religion centred on Baal Hammon and Tanit, with temples and offerings across the territory. Art and architecture combined Phoenician, Greek and North African elements, and its harbours and walls were on a large scale. Most texts are lost, so knowledge of Carthage depends partly on Greek and Roman writers and on archaeology.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约前814年建城、前7世纪独立、前264—241年第一次布匿战争、前218—201年汉尼拔战争、前149—146年第三次布匿战争及迦太基被毁。
events.en: Key moments include the founding around 814 BCE, independence in the seventh century, the First Punic War of 264-241, Hannibal's war of 218-201, and the Third Punic War of 149-146 that ended with the destruction of Carthage.

value.zh: 迦太基约于前814年由推罗商人建立，前7世纪脱离母邦独立。
value.en: Carthage was founded around 814 BCE by merchants from Tyre and became independent in the seventh century BCE.

value.zh: 前218年汉尼拔率军越过阿尔卑斯山进攻意大利，是第二次布匿战争的转折。
value.en: In 218 BCE Hannibal crossed the Alps into Italy in the Second Punic War.

value.zh: 前146年罗马攻灭迦太基并毁城。
value.en: Rome destroyed Carthage in 146 BCE.

sources.title: Francia
supports: The Frankish kingdom founded by Clovis I and ruled by the Merovingians
The Carolingian rise, Charlemagne and the imperial coronation of 800
Counts, marches and the feudal order
The division of the empire and the treaties of Verdun and Meerssen

sources.title: 法兰克王国
supports: 克洛维一世建立、墨洛温王朝统治的法兰克王国
加洛林王朝的兴起、查理曼与800年称帝
伯爵、边区与封建秩序
帝国分割与凡尔登、梅尔森条约

politics.zh: 法兰克王国由克洛维一世在5世纪末统一法兰克诸部并扩张到高卢，墨洛温王朝随后衰落。8世纪加洛林家族掌权，查理·马特与矮子丕平奠定基础，查理曼在位时征服萨克森、伦巴德与巴伐利亚，800年加冕为皇帝。其子路易死后帝国按843年凡尔登条约分割，870年梅尔森条约进一步划定边界。
politics.en: The Frankish kingdom was created when Clovis I united the Frankish tribes at the end of the fifth century and expanded into Gaul; the Merovingian dynasty later declined. In the eighth century the Carolingians took power, with Charles Martel and Pepin the Short preparing the way, and Charlemagne conquered the Saxons, Lombards and Bavarians and was crowned emperor in 800. After his son Louis died the empire was divided by the Treaty of Verdun in 843 and further by the Treaty of Meerssen in 870.

economy.zh: 经济以农业为基础，庄园制与领主土地经营逐渐扩展，谷物、葡萄与畜牧是主要生产。贸易在北欧、地中海与斯拉夫地区之间进行，第纳尔银币与后来的德涅尔银币流通。王室与教会拥有大片土地，修道院参与开垦、手工业生产与地方市场组织。
economy.en: The economy rested on agriculture, with manors and lordly estates expanding and grain, vines and livestock as the main products. Trade ran between the North Sea, the Mediterranean and Slavic lands, using silver deniers. The crown and the church held large estates, and monasteries took part in clearance, craft production and the organisation of local markets.

culture.zh: 法兰克王国推行基督教化，教会与修道院成为书写与教育的中心，拉丁文用于行政与宗教文献。加洛林文艺复兴整理古典文本、改进书写字体，宫廷学校与修道院学校培养教士与官员。建筑以教堂与修道院为代表，加洛林式建筑影响后来欧洲的罗马式风格。
culture.en: The kingdom promoted Christianisation, and churches and monasteries became centres of writing and education, with Latin used for administration and religious texts. The Carolingian revival copied classical texts, reformed the script and trained clergy and officials in palace and monastic schools. Churches and monasteries define its architecture, and Carolingian building influenced the later Romanesque style in Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪末克洛维统一法兰克人、732年图尔战役、751年丕平称王、800年查理曼加冕、843年凡尔登条约分割帝国，以及870年梅尔森条约。
events.en: Key moments include Clovis uniting the Franks at the end of the fifth century, the battle of Tours in 732, Pepin becoming king in 751, Charlemagne's coronation in 800, the division of the empire by the Treaty of Verdun in 843, and the Treaty of Meerssen in 870.

value.zh: 克洛维一世在5世纪末统一法兰克诸部并扩张到高卢。
value.en: Clovis I united the Frankish tribes at the end of the fifth century and expanded into Gaul.

value.zh: 800年查理曼在罗马加冕为皇帝，法兰克王国达到极盛。
value.en: Charlemagne was crowned emperor in Rome in 800, at the height of the Frankish kingdom.

value.zh: 843年凡尔登条约将帝国分为三部分，奠定后来法国与德国的雏形。
value.en: The Treaty of Verdun of 843 divided the empire into three parts, foreshadowing later France and Germany.

sources.title: Republic of Venice
supports: The maritime republic centred on the Venetian lagoon
The doge, the Great Council and oligarchic government
Trade with Byzantium, the Levant and the eastern Mediterranean
The terraferma, the wars with Genoa and the end in 1797

sources.title: 威尼斯共和国
supports: 以威尼斯潟湖为中心的海上共和国
总督、大议会与寡头政治
与拜占庭、黎凡特和东地中海的贸易
陆地领地、与热那亚的战争与1797年终结

politics.zh: 威尼斯共和国以潟湖岛屿为中心，传统上建于7世纪，由总督与后来的大议会治理。13世纪起大议会封闭成员范围，形成商人贵族寡头体制，元老院与十人委员会处理政务。共和国在亚得里亚海与东地中海建立海上帝国，15世纪起兼有意大利陆地领地，1797年被拿破仑终结。
politics.en: The Republic of Venice was centred on the lagoon islands and traditionally founded in the seventh century, governed by a doge and later by the Great Council. From the thirteenth century the council closed its membership, creating a merchant-oligarchic system in which the senate and the Council of Ten handled affairs. The republic built a maritime empire in the Adriatic and eastern Mediterranean, acquired mainland territories in Italy from the fifteenth century and was ended by Napoleon in 1797.

economy.zh: 经济以海上贸易与造船为核心，威尼斯兵工厂批量建造船只，商船队连接君士坦丁堡、亚历山大里亚、黎凡特与西欧。共和国经营香料、丝绸、玻璃、盐和粮食贸易，建立商站与领事网络。里亚尔托银行与债券市场支持商业融资，陆地领地提供农产品与税收。
economy.en: The economy centred on maritime trade and shipbuilding: the Arsenale produced ships in series and the merchant fleet linked Constantinople, Alexandria, the Levant and western Europe. The republic traded spices, silk, glass, salt and grain through a network of trading posts and consuls. Banks and the bond market at the Rialto supported commercial finance, and the mainland territories supplied farm produce and taxes.

culture.zh: 威尼斯文化融合拜占庭、哥特与文艺复兴元素，圣马可大教堂、总督宫与运河城市景观是代表。印刷业在15至16世纪发达，阿尔杜斯出版社出版希腊与拉丁经典；绘画以贝利尼、提香、丁托列托等画家闻名。音乐、歌剧与玻璃工艺影响欧洲，共和国也以档案与外交制度著称。
culture.en: Venetian culture combined Byzantine, Gothic and Renaissance elements, represented by St Mark's Basilica, the Doge's Palace and the canal cityscape. Printing flourished in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, with the Aldine press issuing Greek and Latin classics, and painting is known through Bellini, Titian and Tintoretto. Music, opera and glassmaking influenced Europe, and the republic was also known for its archives and diplomatic system.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪建城传统、1204年第四次十字军攻陷君士坦丁堡、13至14世纪与热那亚的战争、15世纪陆地领地的扩张、16世纪勒班陀海战，以及1797年共和国终结。
events.en: Key moments include the traditional founding in the seventh century, the Fourth Crusade's capture of Constantinople in 1204, the wars with Genoa in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, the expansion into the mainland in the fifteenth, the battle of Lepanto in the sixteenth, and the end of the republic in 1797.

value.zh: 威尼斯共和国由总督与大议会治理，13世纪后形成商人贵族寡头体制。
value.en: The republic was governed by a doge and the Great Council, becoming a merchant-oligarchic system after the thirteenth century.

value.zh: 威尼斯兵工厂批量建造船只，支撑共和国的海上贸易与海军。
value.en: The Venetian Arsenale built ships in series and supported the republic's maritime trade and navy.

value.zh: 1797年拿破仑军队进入威尼斯，共和国终结。
value.en: Napoleon's army entered Venice in 1797, ending the republic.

sources.title: Dutch Republic
supports: The Union of Utrecht of 1579 and the Act of Abjuration of 1581
A confederation of seven provinces with stadholders and a pensionary
The Dutch East India Company, trade and the Golden Age
The Patriot movement and the Batavian revolution of 1795

sources.title: 荷蘭共和國
supports: 1579年乌得勒支同盟与1581年脱离西班牙
七省联合体、执政与议长大臣
荷兰东印度公司、贸易与黄金时代
爱国者运动与1795年巴达维亚革命

politics.zh: 荷兰共和国由七个尼德兰省份在1579年乌得勒支同盟基础上形成，1581年宣布脱离西班牙。国家是省际联合体，各省保留自治与税收权，三级会议处理共同事务，奥兰治家族多任执政。17世纪为荷兰黄金时代，共和国内部存在省权与执政权的长期张力，1795年法国入侵后建立巴达维亚共和国。
politics.en: The Dutch Republic emerged from the Union of Utrecht of 1579, when seven Netherlandish provinces declared independence from Spain in 1581. It was a confederation in which each province kept autonomy and tax powers, the States General handled common affairs and the House of Orange usually supplied the stadholder. The seventeenth century was the Dutch Golden Age, with lasting tension between provincial and stadholder power, until the French invasion of 1795 created the Batavian Republic.

economy.zh: 经济以海上贸易、渔业、造船与金融为核心，阿姆斯特丹是欧洲的货物与资本市场。荷兰东印度公司与西印度公司经营亚洲与美洲贸易，波罗的海谷物、鲱鱼、糖与香料贸易带来巨额利润。围海造田与农业改良提高产出，纺织、酿酒与出版业发达。
economy.en: Maritime trade, fisheries, shipbuilding and finance were central, with Amsterdam as Europe's commodity and capital market. The Dutch East and West India companies traded in Asia and the Americas, and Baltic grain, herring, sugar and spice trades generated large profits. Land reclamation and farming improvements raised output, and textiles, brewing and publishing flourished.

culture.zh: 共和国文化以宗教宽容、城市自治与印刷出版为特色，大学与拉丁学校培养学者，绘画以伦勃朗、维米尔等为代表。科学、地图学与法学研究活跃，格劳秀斯与惠更斯等人在国际法、光学与天文学上有贡献。运河城市建筑、市民团体肖像与室内画反映商业社会的生活面貌。
culture.en: Republican culture was marked by religious toleration, urban self-government and printing. Universities and Latin schools trained scholars, and painting is represented by Rembrandt and Vermeer. Science, cartography and law were active, with Grotius and Huygens contributing to international law, optics and astronomy. Canal-city architecture, civic group portraits and domestic interiors reflect the life of a commercial society.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1579年乌得勒支同盟、1581年脱离西班牙、1602年东印度公司成立、1648年威斯特伐利亚和约承认独立、1672年灾难年，以及1795年巴达维亚共和国建立。
events.en: Key moments include the Union of Utrecht in 1579, the declaration of independence from Spain in 1581, the founding of the East India Company in 1602, recognition of independence in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648, the disaster year of 1672, and the creation of the Batavian Republic in 1795.

value.zh: 1579年七省签订乌得勒支同盟，1581年宣布脱离西班牙独立。
value.en: The seven provinces formed the Union of Utrecht in 1579 and declared independence from Spain in 1581.

value.zh: 1602年成立的荷兰东印度公司经营亚洲贸易，成为共和国海上力量的核心。
value.en: The Dutch East India Company, founded in 1602, ran Asian trade and was central to the republic's maritime power.

value.zh: 1795年法国军队入侵，巴达维亚共和国取代荷兰共和国。
value.en: The French invasion of 1795 replaced the Dutch Republic with the Batavian Republic.
